'ag gtam dmar rjen ma/a rig lwaspyar med kyes brtsams/

sngon du btang ba'i skad cha rdog po 'ga'/phra na rang lo dgu nas bcu bdun bar grwa pa byas kyang tshogs kyi 'don rta dbyangs gsum gyi pa na nas sod skad yig gi sum rtags dag gsum la sbyangs myong med cing / bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi rgya mtsho las gting zab pa'i mche'i gzhung lugs khag la'ang sbyangs myong ched/ de ni ma gzhi nas nga 'grog dgon chung chung zhig nas 'ong stabs rtsab mai 'ju bar rtse mor 'ju ba dang / gzhung lugs mi sbyangs nga/ra blo rgyugs gtso 'dzin byed stabs/ ngas rnam rig ha cang rgod pa 'i dus skabs de'ang tshogs kyi 'don rta dbyangs gsum cam la sba ngas te dus 'dang bar byas/ nga thog mar bal yul sne len khang du 'gyor skabs sterā na 'i sa khyod kyi chos lugs gang red ces dris par/ ngas nang nga yin zhes 'a/na btabs/nga rang nyid kyi ngos thad nas/ bshad na/ grwa pa log ste sbir su dzā bod khyim du 'gro skal ldan pa /de lha)/nges/therga shāje/95 lag chen lag shāje lag tshog /rtse) rig ྅sdod rig nga 'a 'a chas bangad thabs mad nga / chas ran thang dang sa yad du nga ba' rtsa che'i dus tshod dang go skabs de red/ su dzā bod khyim slob grwa nas da gzod ngas snya gu sar btsugs shing rtsom yig 'bre mgo brtsams/ rang dang na tshod ma nyam nga/'i slob grogs skor zhig dang mnyam du bod kyi rtso ma yig gi skor la dbyings zhugs/ de nas bzung dbyin yi/ga slob tshan skabs su'ang bod yig gi deb la lkog lta byas stabs 'dzin grwa nas phyi la 'phu da myong la/ dbyin yig gi srog snying thogs pa'i dge slob skor zhig gis kho dbyin yig ma shes na lto mi reg )pa'i bslab bya ci cam gnang ya/nga rna rgyab tu bskyu ra/thod lta phyi ra 'dang zhig brgyab na nga'i mi kto gsum ring gi slo ba grwa'i shes yon gnas tshul

gdang / me 'e/pha bzhi lnga 'i ring shes sku(na dang 'brel ba'i las ka byas/ pa'i nyams spyo1nga mnyam du bsdo mas na'ang / nga la nang don rig pa dang srid don reg pa / skad yig rig pa dang sa rtsa'i/ rig pa sesgogs gang du'ang gzhi long tshugs pa'i shes bya sna gcig kyang med tseted/ rang snyad kyi dga' kha 'khyer phyogs ltar rtsom yig 'thar 'jur re yig thog tu dbab thub tsam byung ba ni/nga rang nyid kyi rgyal kha che sgordzos dang rang gi snying nas brtseba'i dren can a ma dang / ma yum su ja slob grwar drin gso ba'i ched du phul ba'i lag skyes su bdag gis 'dod/gang lta ra tsha/ sngon ma'i da lta 'i dus tshod 'dir ngas rang nyid lajeg rten 'der yo/nga nas spe yul la bzhag pa 'i ches thog ma'i rtsom deb ( gleng mol/ ) zhes nga dpar du bskrun pa dang / da lta ngas dpyad brjod rtsom deb gnyis thi smyo 'khyig gtem dmar rjen ma/ de khyed cag klog pa bo dag gi spyan sngar bshams thub pa sding sta bas/ dga' spro sa/ rab tu pyose sku da/'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma ni de sngon ngas 'od spi tshogs dus deb steng bkod zin pa'i rtsom yig lag cig rmang gzhir byas thog 20rsha/ sgyu/'i 'otho mjug tu sbel skamab gzhis chags su zla gcig gi gung seng zhus ring bris shing / de nas bzung da bar las zhor du bcos sgrig dang snan 'phri byas te legs pa ra grub pa'i da byad brjod deb chung zhig yin/deb chung 'di'i nang du gtso bo nga rang nyid kyis dngos yod spyi tshogs 'tsho bar bzung ba'i rin thang rnya tshul tsam brjod pa gtso gnad du bzung ba tsam 'a sa/ gong zhus ltar ngas nang don rig pa mi shes nga sa nang don rig pa'i skor bris med la/ srid don rig pa mi shes pa sa de ya/nga nga lnga bu zhig gis gleng gzhi min pa sa bzhag nas na nga rang nyid kyi sems 'gyu ngo ma dang dga' khe 'khyer phyogs lta ra/ 'jig rten khyim pa po mo rnams kyis/ 'tsho ba rol stangs dang mi tshe bca' stongs/ dngos ma da py-i tshogs 'tsho ba dang bde srid 'tsho bar ngos 'dzin byed stangs sogs brjod yod la/ de ni nga rang nyid khyim pa ba rnazlo ma zhig bya 'dod pa sa me tshad/ khyod kyang da nas bzung rang gi chung mar brtsezhing bu phru ga la byams pa/ ya/ rabs bzang sbyo da ldan nga/'i khyim pa ba rnal ma zhig byed pa ra sku' snying 'dod pa sa yin/yang ldog ste bshad na/ bcan byol py-i tshogs khrod du rtseg shes mi shes gnyi gas bod

twayig la che mthong med pa'i sdug skad rgyag bzhin sku da la/ klog pa bo mi reg pa'i dka' khag rgyun du 'phrad kyin yo/da mod/ chos lugs dang chab srid skor gyi dbya da rtsom re dang snyan ngag ge deb re 'don pa'i phan nas/ sad skad yig thog gi dpe deb rnams sna ladzoms rang bzhen can du bsar rgyu'i ngal ba mi bsten par brten/ ngas da ji yan du bris pa mang bo zhig de nyi ra klorgi pa bor bstun ci thurbe byas pa yin la/ deb 'di ni ched du klog pa bo'i khor yug dang dga' kha 'khyer pyogs dmigs 'ben du bzung ste bris/ nga zhig kyang yin/gang lta ra ngas bsam na nga tsho'i da lta'i na gzhon rnams kyi bsam blo dus rabs kyi rjes snyeg gin pa dang / dus rabs rang bzhin gyi mi'i dga' kha 'khyer phyogs dang dus rabs dang 'tsham pa 'i mi'i 'gu'/ skyod la phyogs yo/da na'ang / nga tsho'i da lta'i bod skad yig steng gi brtsams chos khag gis khong tshor sna 'dzoms rang bzhin gyi bsam blo'i rgyags phye zhig ston thub kyi sped/ brtsams chos yod tshad nang don rig pa dang sred don rig pa/ skad yig rig pa dang sga rtsal rig pa sogs kyi steng du yod la/ dngos yod spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i snang brnyan gasgroni po dang khyim pa pho mo'i tsho'i dga' kha 'khyer phyogs ngo ma mtshon pa'i brtsams chos nyung nyung yin/ der brten zhakhrig gtam/ 'khrig las skor gyi gtam tshun chad yig thog tu phabs te dus rabs gsar ba'i bod regs na gzhon klog pa sa rnams la/ stod skad yig steng gi dpe/ deb sna ladzoms can du gtong rgyu de yang nga tsho snag thogs pa yongs kyi 'gan 'khre ru 'dod yod/ 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma'i nang du /ri/ 〈snag pa 'o mtho dman bar ma su'ang la mkho gal che ba'i shes bya zheg 'chad thub pre da kyang / bod skad yig gi ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i dpe deb dag sna 'dzoms can du 'gyur bar ram 'degs cung tsam re thob pa'i re 'dun bcangs skusnad/rtsom pa sos/ phyi lo 2010 lo'i zla 5 tshes 7nyin gyi dgong mor bris sete/ /

myo //dkar chaga'aḥṭā ba'i lam yigabaza' zla bdams nor 31ra 'dug 2rigs rus la gdon du lta ba'i bsam/ blo rgyang 'phu da/ 8rang gi bza' zla la sabang ra med pa gnang rogs/ 12brtse dung gi ming gzhi ngo ma nee yed ches yin/ 16pha na tshun la bsam shes dang sems 'khur mang tsam bya rogs/ 21bzang tshang gi rtsod nyog chung sa nas che sar 'pho ba yin/ 28btson ma lta bu'i khyo ga 32gra sgrig yod pa gnang rogs/ 35gal srid bza' 'thor byung na/ 40brtsedung ldan pa'i me'i bya 5 da ngo ma ci lta bu zhig yi/na nam/ 44

ga/// kun dga' ba'i gtam/'jig rten pa 'i gtam rgyud/ 50'khrig pa'i skabs kye gtam thor bu ma/ 63gceg spyod ga dus red dam/ 70gzeg nga 'i skor gyi rgyun shes sgong rogs/ 75'khreg pa'i sngon 'gro'i rgyu b.ragad pa/ 78khyod kyis nga'i gsang gnas shig rnyed byung / 82bud sped kyi 'a/nga tsho'i me tog la dngos gnas rin thang de lta bu zhig ldan rnam/ 85ma jug mtha'i slob tshan thun gcig dang tshe gcig gi lag byang / 90bud med tsho/ chos/ nyed go ldog ma byed ang / 96〈 snal rgyab kyi bud med 69'e sems gshis// 106mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba ci 111sbra 'dabs kyi mtshan mo/'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ 126

bza' zla bdams mor skor bog /'tsho ba'i lam yigabartso 'ong zar sme dzo ho lko hang tsa byogaslo has hang 0haha ho rang smyong rdzo shug tshol 4 7 tho da dzo dartseha (4 ha hang yo rdzo 'azlogayo bar ṅgā sme ha nyal 4ha sa tsho sme na 8( las tso dzog rehānyag par 'o rnam haha he brtse 'ong 3ra sme dzo na nyaha hang pho 5ge myo chags teng 'ong rdzo 7 sher 737 gems lhan rpā ha ( slo nga lhan 81 tus rtsan loha 3ha 7rdzo la'ang9 bal 'aho rtse tsho tse 774 rehā

2 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/bza' zla bdams nor shor 'dugaphyi lo 2009 lo'i zla 10 tshes 22 nyin gyi phyi dror nga la grogs po zhig gi kha par 'gror/ ngas khong gi skad gdangs las gtam bzang zhig bshad rgyu yin pa tshor byung /khong gis gsungs don/ tshongs chang sa rgyag gi yin/ nye char rang thag gcod byas pa yin la zla gcig gi rjes red/ ces zer/ skad cha de dngos gnas bkra shis pa'i gtam bzang rang red la ngas khong la bkra shis bde legs zhus pa yin/ yin na'ang / ngas khong la de'i skor zhib kyis dres pa dang gzab kyis nyan dus khong gi gtam bzang des nga la brjod mi shes pa'i phangs sems sheg skye ru bcug kho nga gis gsungs pa ltar na/ khong gis gsar du rnyed pa'i bu mo de khong las lo bco lnga tsam gyis chung ba dang 'dzin rim bcu ba thon rjes mu mthud slob grwar song mi 'dug /rnam pa de tsam bzang rgyu mi 'dug kyang gtso bo zhabs gsar ma ( bu mo spe tog ma'i don/ ) zhig red/ ces zer/ khong gis da dung thengs 'der kho mo'i lang tsho'i na tog len pa'i go skabs de shar ma song la thengs gcig phan tshun mthong ba tsam las da lta'i char 'brel ba gzhan med ces kyang zer/nga dngos gnas thang chad song / nga'i grogs po'i skad cha de ri rgyal lhun po bzhin nga'i sems ngogs su yun ring rtag brtan du gnas shing / rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ji bzhin nga'i bsam gzhig gi sgo mo shugs kyis rdung gin 'dug khong la mtshon na dge rgan gyi

bza' zla bdams nor shor 'dug 3phyag las gnang mkhan zhig yin la dgung lerdzo yang sum cu serdzo grangs zin tshar ba'i mi shes sku(na can zhig yin mosnad/ shes 'byun pa zhig gi lngarngos nas bsam na mi tshe gcig ge don dag de 'di ltar ja kha chang kha nas thag gcod byed stangs 'di las lhag pa'i thabs sdug pa zhig sku(da dam/gang ltar yang khong gis nga la lag skyes su khyer yong ba'i gtam bzang des nga la sdug bsngal dang yid mi skyid pa'i tshor ba drag po zhig skye ru bcug cing / tag tag ngas 'di'i skor la yang dang bskyar du bsam gzhig byed dgos byung / ngas khong la tsho khyod kyis bu resna zhig gi lang tsho'i me rtasnag gcig pur bsams nas tshe gcig gi ngethon dag bca' ba las lhag pa'i thabs sdug gi bya ba zhig gang na ma/thod/ des khyod 'a/ tha na 'khrig sperdzod brten sa bzang mi bzang gi khyad par tsam yang ra spyod thub ki ma red/ ma gzhi nas byed rang mi lo du ma'i ring dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang myong mkhan zhig dang shes rgya can zhig gi dzom nas de ltar byed pa blo yul las 'das song / sogs rang blos dpog tshod kyi sa go rgyu yod pa'i skad cha 'ga' bshad na'ang / khong gis de la do snang byed kyi mi 'dugared/ nga tshos chang sa rgyag skabs bu mo spe tog ma zhig 'dems ki red/ lha ga par du btsan byol sri tshogs dang sod gzhis kyi rong phyogs sa khul khag tu de ltar 'dems ki red/ bu mo ngatshos kyang rang gi ches thog ma'i brtseb ster sa dang mi tshe gcig gi bza' zlar rang gi bad kyis ma khyer ba'i lang tsho de 'bul bar brtson gi red/ yin na'ang / 'a/nga tsho'i spe tog gcig pur de lta'i rin thang zhig dngos gnas ldan nam/ (bud med kyi lang tsho'i me tog la dngos gnas rin thang de lta bu zhig ldan nam/ zhes pa'i rtsom yig gzhan du gsal yod/) bza' zla zer ba ni zhogs pa yar langs pa nas dgong mo mar ma

4 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ anig 'gyur med kyis brtsams /nyal ba'i bar gyi nyin dkar gyi las ka mtha' dag la phan tshun bstun shes dang nyan shes/bsam shes byed dgos khar/ dgong mo mar nyal ba nas gnyid ma khug pa'i bar gyi 'a/sa kun la'ang lta tshul dang 'dod phyogs mthun dgos pas/ bza' tshang zer ba ni kha sang ngo shes nas de ring mnyam du 'dug tshastog tshasnag cig min/bza' zla zer ba ni khyo ga zhes pa'i ming tshig 'di'i steng la skyes dman bzhag na/bza' zla zer ba'i ming tshig 'di grub pa de tshang mas shes mod/ don dngos thog khyo ga'i bde skyid kyi steng la chung ma'i dgod sgra de bsnan ge dang / chung ma'i dka' sdug dang kyag kyog gi lam bur khyo ga'i dpung rogs dang rgyab skyor bsnan/ chung ra/'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba'i steng 〈sna gas bkra shis pa'i ri dzesto 'bri 'os pa zhig yin stabs/ ma mthar yang phan tshun la rgyus 'ordzon gsal sa dbosnas pa red la lta tshul mthun min ni gnad don gtso 'o de yin par 'dod/khyed cag gis soms dang / bza' tshang gi bde skyid rgyu nor longs sgod kyis nyo mi thub la/ thob dang go sas kyang sbyin mi nus pa ma yin rnom/ skabs 'dir dros bskar du lo du ma'i yar sngon du nga la grogs po zhig gis brjod myong ba'i skad cha zhig dran cheX /de ni nga dang zur bsten dga' bo sgrig myong ba'i bud sped cig a rir phyin rjes red/ nged gnyis su yin yang phan tshun la dga' bo yod kyang dus dbang gis gnas skabs ring nged gnyis dang mnyapa du med sta bas/ dus thung zhig nang nged gnyis zur bsten dga' sa bsgrigs pa yin/ gang ltar yang ngas/ khong mo a rir las gi yod skor zhig grogs po che ge resna zhig la brjod skabs/ khormeng gis nga la/ lkugs pa/ lam sang chang sa rgyag dbosgos pa red/ ces zed khong gis de'i don ni gzhug phyogs ngasang a rir 'gro thub gi red zer ba de red/

bza' zla bdams nor shor 'dug 5yin na'ang / a rir 'gro ba'i ched du ngas kho mor chang sa rgyag pa ni mig 'phad bzhin du g.yang la mchong ba rang ma yin nam/ spyir btang a ri ste bod mi tshos nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su ngos 'dzin pa 'i kha sang de ring gi sre tshogs 'der ngas a rir 'gro ba'i ched du chang sa mi rgyag la/ a ri na nga'i tshe 'ardo'i bde skod dang ma 'ongs pa'i dmigs 'dun med zer na su gcig gis kyang snang bar 'gro gi ༵ red/dngos gnas red/ bod mi tshos a ri na bde skyid yod bsam yod/ ngas kyang rang gi da lta'i gnas bab la bsam na rgya gar las phyogs gang ci'i thad nas a rir phyin pas dga' ba sped 'gro bsam gyin yod pas/ dus nam zhig nga yang a rer 'gro srid pa red/yin na'ang / ngas khyed tshor gsal bor zhu 'dod pa ni/ nga tsho 'gro ba mi'i 'tsho gnas khrod du dpal 'gyor dang rgyu nor ni 'tsho rten du gyur yod pas na/ de don du gnyer bar bdag 'thad kyang / de don du gnyer ched rang gi tshe gcig gi bza' zla'ang ci mi snyam par rigs rus dang pho mo rgan gzhon/ lhag par du brtsedung med pa'i mi dang chang sa rgyag par ma zad/ phyis/ 'byung gi 'tsho gnas la yid rton mi rung ba shes bzhin du chang sa rgyag pa bcas la bdag mi 'thad zer ba de'o/ /ngas bsam na dpa' mdzangs kyi snying stobs dang la rgya'i rtsal shugs/ rgyas pa 'i sod gangs can gye spun zla yo ngas kyis de lta bu'i don snying rtogs yod/ khyed tshos soms dang / nga tshori smu a rir 'gro ched bu mo gzhon nu ma tshos skro yi 'dabs ma dkar bor gyur ba'i rgas 'khodzegs tsho dang chang sa rgyag la/ a rir 'a11 ched gsar bu tshos ar resna che chung rgan gzhon med nga ra brtseb dang phugs bsam sar ba'i chang sa rgyag de bzhin bod rigs yin yang phan tshun la brtse dung gi brgyud rim med pa dang phyi sa 'byung gi 'tsho gnas la yid rton med par chang sa rgyag pa sogs ni thabs skyo ba'i byed stangs rkyang ma

6 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/red dam/ dper na/ gong gi dpe mtshon ltar/ gal srid ngas rang gi gnas skabs ring gi mdza' mo de a rir phyin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas chang sa brgyab na dza'i 'byung 'gyur gyi 'tsho ba de mun khrod du brdzangs pa yin la/ nga yang a rir 'gro rgyu tsam 'a/sa rnam dag gi brtsedung mi dbothos pa'i mi zhig tu grub zin pa yin/der brten chang sa rgyag skabs nges par du rgyu dngos dang dbang shugs/ chol kha dang chos lugs/ tha na yag btsog dang rigs rus dbye 'byed sogs gang yang med par rang gi tshe gcig gi bza' zla ma nor bar gdam rgyu ni tshe gcig gi bde skyid kyi mgo ladzugs sa dang mjug skyong sa los yin/ spyir me su yin rung rang rang gi 'don 'dun re yod cing mi tshang mas rang nyid kyi 'dod 'dun de 'grub ched dka' las rgyag gi yod la/ gsol ba 'debs pa dang lha dang bla mas skyabs rogs mdzad rgyur dus rgyun re bas mig zung gtad yod/ yang na bsam pa lhun 'grub ma 'don pa dang rlung rta gtor ba/ lha klu gnyan gsum mchod pa semags byas te rang gi 'dod 'dun mtha' dag 'grub par smon 'a/ma 'debs ki red/ yin na'ang / mi tshang mas 'dod 'dun gtan nas 'grub rung gi ma red la/ de ltar 'grub rung ba zhig yin tshe 'dzig rten ni ma gzhi nas go ldog cing / chose nyid la mi stos par gang zag la gtad pa zhig yin par nges pa ma yin nam/ gal srid mi tshang mas 'dod 'dun 'grub dgos na rgya gar gyi ming du grags pa'i mdzangs ma a shi wa re spo dang khā re na kur por/ pu re yan ka chob rā/ rā de'u sogs dang mnyam du chang sa rgyag 'dod pa'i rgya gar ba ga tshod rtseg yod ang / de dag thams cad kyi 'dod 'dun 'grub dgos tshe gong gi bud med de dag ni dngos gnas mi 'di dag gi spyi rdzas shig las ci yang yin mi srid par 'gyur dgos/ de bzhin sod kyi mdzangs ma tshe ring chung bdag dang tshe ring skyid/ bstan 'drin g.yang ladzoms sogs da bar btsan byol

bza' zla bdams nor shor 'dug 7spyi/ tshogs khrod du sod kyi mdzangs ma'e dbu rgyan thob myong mkhan gyi mdzangs ma tsho dang / bod nang ge gzhas ma dbyangs can lha mo dang 'jam dbyangs sgrol ma/ mdo ba tshe skyid/ phul byung sgrol ma sogs su chang sa rgyag 'dod mkhan gyi bod rigs gzhon skyes kyang ga tshod cig yo/da ang / yin na'ang / kho tsho rang nyid kyi las dbang ltar mi gcig la bdag pa las khong tsho snang ba song tshun la bdag stangs shig med pas na/ gnam 'og gi me tshang mas 'dod 'dun mtha' dag gtan nas 'grub mi rung ba ma yin nam/ des na/ khyed cag gis kyang rang nyid kyi snang ba mthun sa dang brtse ba yod sa zhig btsal te chang sa rgyag nga las glen rtags mi ston par mkhyen/ lhag par du rang gi chung ma'i gdong nas tshe gang 'dzum mdangs mthong thub pa dang / kho mo'i sa nas dus kun rnam dag gi brtse ba lhad med pa zhig 'thob pa ra brtson rogs/de'i phyir du phan chun rgyus lon mang cam dang sems dang bsam pa'i phyi nang shes pa'i dus tshod ldeng nges shig 'jog rogs/ de ni phal cher dga' bo'i dus skabs kho na ste/ ngas bsam na bkra shis pa'i gnyen ston ma bshams pa'i sngon dang khyim gcig ge bza' tshang ma bcas pa'i sngon te/phan tshun dga' rogs bsgrigs te dus yun gang 'tsham ring mnyam 'grogs mnyam 'dug gi 'tsho ba rol dang / de nas phan tshun la rgyus 'o na gi red la gzhug phyogs bza' tshang bsgrigs te mnyam du bsdad 'os men yang thag chod ki red/ de ltar byas na bza' zla gdam nor 'chor gi ma red/gang ltar yang 'di'i thad kyi bsam tshul rtsom yig gzhan du'ang yerdzod pas skabs 'dir 'di tsam gyis 'thus par byas so/ /

ci 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/rigs rus la gdon du lta ba'i bsam blo rgyang 'phud/nga rang chung dus bod mdo smad phyogs su ming du grags pa'i sgru nga ba ska la bzang grags pa lags kyis bshad pa'i mgar ba rnyasnabs rgyal dang sras re( ye thenas lha smadagra sgrung gtam la nyan tshungang / sgrung de'i nang don ni rigs rus mgar ba nas mched pa'i mgar ba stobs rgyal dang rigs rgyud rgyal bo'i sras por skyes pa 'i ye she sa lha mo gnyis kyi bar du bcos min gyi brtse dung chags te/ pha na tshun kha 'bral mi thub pa'i tshad du slebs na'ang / rgyal so dang blon ngo sogs kyis srol rgyun gyi bsam blo'i dbang shugs 'og khong gnyis la rang dbang dang bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba zhig rol du ma bcug pa'i khar/ de las stothog ste mgar ba stobs rgyal gye mig 'bras gnyis brus nga dang lce bcad pa / rkang lag gtubs pa sogs kyis mnar gcod tshad med btang ste tshe mjug sdu ga bsngal gyi ngang nas rdzogs dgos byung yo/da/ rgyal bo'i sras mor lusangs dzwa 'e ye shes sna mos kyang rang nyid kyi rnam dag gi brtse dung dang mdza' por gdung sems mnyam skye da byed ched brag ri mthon po 'i steng nas mchong ste rang shi brgyabs yod/de ni ngas mi tshe 'dir ches thog mar thos pa'i rigs rus dbye 'byed skor gyi sgrung gtam gcig pu de yin la / da lta de yang dran lam na de tsam gsal bo mi 'dugaskabs de dus ngas nga tsho 'od kyi yul lung 'gar rigs rus dbye 'byed kyi lta ba shugs

rigs rus la gdon du lta ba'i bsam blo rgyang phud/ 9cher khyab mthod nga shes kyi med/ mgar ba stobs rgyal dang ye shes lha mosna gnyi sa kyi sgrung ni mi rig rbesgod lag bde zhig gis brtsams pa cam la ga'ir bzhag byas 'ebyud/ 'on kyang / deng skabs nga'i bsam blo'i nang sgrung de yang yang lubor zhing / nga tsho'i spi tshogs nang rigs rus dbye 'byed kyi 'du shes shugs drags po yin pa'ang rtogs sorjo / phyi lo 2005 nas 2006 bar lo gcig ring nga mon gho 'dod rgu gling du bsdad pa yin/ phye lerdzo 2008 nas 2009 bar 'epha gcig ring nga spel skosnab lugs zung bsam 'grub gling du bsdad pa yin/ sa gnas de gnyis su bsdad ring ngas rigs rus dbye 'byed skor gyi skad cha mang bo thos shing / mon gho 'dod rgu gleng du kha ngo skye 'bus ha cang legs na'ang rigs rgyud mgar ba yin stabs khyo ga ma rag par bosgo rgas su lhag skusgod nga 'i bud med cig mthong myong / phar bltas tshod la kho mo nga las lo ngo bdun brgyad tsam gyis che ba dang gshis ka 'jam zhing gzhung rgyud drang ba zhig red snyam du 'dug la/ rang la dga' rogs 〈snad nga/ ma gtogs blor 'bab sa zhig 'dug ang bsam myong / de bzhin nga sbel kob gzhis chags su bsdad ring nga'i ngo shes bu mo mang bo yod pa'i khrod kyi gcig ni rigs rus ded na mgar rgyud cig yin tshul 'dug la/ thengs shig nga las 'erto bcu tsam gyis mtho ba'e bud med rgan pa zhig gis nga la nga'i grerdzogs rerwa de rigs rus dman nga/sa 'brel ba ma byas na bzang tshul dang chang sa ni gtan nas rgyag mi rung skor bshad song / de bzhin ngas bud med 'ga' dang mnyam du rigs rus dbye 'byed kyi lta ba'i thog rtsod pa rgyag myong yod mod/ khong tshor yang bu mo gan dang 'di'i rigs rgyud mgar ba red dang / pha gi dang ya ga'i rigs rgyud lha ma btsem red lta bu las gzhan rgyu mtshan gang yang 'chad rgyu mi 'dug

/0 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/ngas bsam na mgar ba dang shing bzo/ lham btsem dang srang lam phyags mkhan/gsang spyod bkru mkhan dang gad snyigs sgrum mkhan sogs ni spyi tshogs kyi bed spyod ches che ba'i mi dang spyi tshogs kyis ches mtho sar bkur dgos pa'i mi dag red/ gleng tsho ci'i phyir regs rus dman par chags pa red dam/ rigs rus bzang bo 'ur dus nges par du bla ma dang dpon po/ phyug bdag tshang zhig gi rgyud pa yin dgos nga dang / cang med dbul so dang las ka phal ba dag byed mkhan cho rigs rgyud ngan par chags dbosgos nga red dam/ngas nga tsho'i pha yul bod lung pa de rang bcan gtsang ma'i rgyal khab cig 'a/ cha bzhag nas bshad na/ rang btsan gyi rgyal khab cig la lham 'tshem med na rgyal khab de'i mi cha nga ma lham med rkang rje na du 'akro dgos kyi yod pas/gnam gshis ha cang 'khyag pa'i mtsho bod mtho snang gi nga tsho'i spu/na zla tsho rkang rjen mar sdod rgyu yin nam/ yang bod mi tshos mgar ba'i rigs rgyud la btsog por lta mod/ mgar ba chos brdung ba'i lha rten chos gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing / rtsachen du bsgri gal srid mgar ba'i rigs rgyud la btsog lta zhing de dag gi grib phog pa sogs la dogs na/ de dag gis bzos pa'i ca dngos kyang de ltar nges nga sa spangs byar rigs mod/ de ni mi phod/ de bzhin sngon chad grong gseb dang kha 'thor du gnas pa nas da lta deng rabs kyi grol brdal dang grong khyer gyi rnam pa ra 'pho bzhin yo/da stabs srang lam phyags mkhan med na grong khyer de gad snyigs kyi pung ga31ga khrod bstim rgyu las thabs gzhan med pa lta bu red/ 'i nga gcig bshad na las ka lham btsem dang gad snyigs phyags mkhan byed kyin yod na'ang / lta rgya dang mthong rgya mi gzhan las che zhing / rang gi khyim tshang dang chung ma bu phrug gi don du 'bad 'bungs byed mkhan zhig yin na rigs rgyud dma' bas bzang ste/ sngon chad kyi rgyal bo dag la dpe

rigs rus la gdon du lta ba'i bsam blo rgyang phud //zhig longs dang nga tshos bdagad stangs ltar na khong tsho regs rgyung mtho ba'i gras yin mo da/khong tshos bud ched mang bor btsun mo'i ming skam po re bslos te nyug rum pa tshor srung du bcug 'phad pa las/ rgyal bo rang nyid dang ma/nyam du skyed mnyam sdug mnyam gyi 'tsho ba rol mkhan gyi btsun mo re zung las med la/ de lta bu'i rigs rgyud ma 〈sna bo'i rgyal so zhig li btsun resna byed pa 'a/sa srang lam phyags ma/khan zhig dang mgar ba zhig nga nga na lham btsem zhig dang mnyam du bsdad kyang bde skyid 'tsho ba dang bza' 'dzoms kyi dga' snang gis rtag tu brgyan ye da pa ma yi/na nam/gang lta ra yang / tshegacig gi bza' chang zer ba ni rgyu nor sku/ da med dang rigs dus bzang ngan 'a rag las med/ lhag par du sod mi tshos lham btsem yin na rigs rus dma' ba dang dngo na rgyud yin na rigs rgyud bzang bo yin nga/'i 'grel log dag 'a de bas kyang rag las med par/ de ni sus rang dang dka' sdug mnyam 'khur dang skyed mnyam/ sdug mnyam gyi 'tsho ba rol te/ mi tshe mtha' nyagyol byed na de dang mnyam du 'dug rgyu de red/

/2 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/rang gi bza' zla la 'khang ra med pa gnang rogs/bza' tshang zer ba ni phyi'i kun spyod dang nang bsam slo/ dga' kha sabyer phyogs dang 'gro stangs 'gro lugs gceg nga zhig yong mi srid pa lta bu red la/ lhag par du las ka dang rgyu nor/ lang tsho sogs kyi thad nas 'dra mnyam zhig yong mi srid mod/ ces kyang phan tshun la 'khang ra med nga zhig yong bar 'bad dgose/ dper na/ bza' tshang zhig gi skyes pa de gzugs lang tsho rang gi chung ma las bzang zhing / dus nam zhig nas skyermos pa des rang gi chung mar bud med gzhan dag ltar mdzes sdug gi lang tsho med pa dang / bud med gzhan dag ltar gyi shes 'jon bral ba lta bur tshor bas nyin de nas bzung rang gi chung mar mun snang skye mgo rtsom pa dang mnyam du sems nang sngar med kyi 'char 'god sna tshogs byed/ skabs de lta bu zhig tu rang gi chung mas sngar bzhin zhogs pa snga bo nas yar langs te rang la zhogs ja bskol ba dang gyon pa bkru ba/ nam rgyun ltar phar 'gro 'dzum gyis skyel ma dang tshung 'ong dung bas bsu na'ang / kho'i sems ngor snang tshul de dag kyang yid mi dga' bar 'byung /de bzhin du bud sped cig gis rang gi khyo ga ni mi gzhan dag ltar 'jon thang ldan pa dang snying stobs ldan pa/ thabs la mkhas pa zhig min pa ra dus rgyun rang nyid kyis gso dgos pa dang / rang gis nyin mtshan med par dka' las brgyabs te bsags pa'i

rang gi bza' zla la 'khang ra med pa gnang rogs/ /3dngul rnams khyo gas spyo skyid gtong bar bkol ba/ skabs rer don med du rang nyid la gcar rdung brnyes gsum byed pa las kho'i sems na brtsedung zer ba'i tha snyad 'di gtan nas mi 'dug snyam pa'i tshor ba rgyud la skyes pa nas/ sngar rang nyid ci'i phyir 'di lta bu'i 'jon thang dang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i mi glen pa zhig la dga' ba yin ang snyams te/'gyod gdung drag po'i gting rim du lhung / de nas bzung khyo gas nam rgyun ltar rang la snyan mo'i ngag dang 'jam po'i tshig gis byams skyong byed par ma zad/ sgo phyi khyim bar nas kyang sems tshegs byed na'ang / de ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ru 'khrul bar 'gyur/skabs 'dir khyed kyis phyir dran zhig byos dang / gcig byas na khyed rang tan tan mig 'khrul byung yod sred/ dper na/ khyed kyis deng skabs rang la gtan nas 'tsham ngo ra mi mthong zhing dang snang ba mi mthun pa'i khag nyin ltar snying 'jags dang bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol mi thub pas tshar rgyu med pa 'i rtsod nyog khrod lhu nga ba'i khyed kyi bza' zla de/ lo ngo gcig dang gnyis/ yang na gsum dang bzhi/ gang ltar khyed gnyis thog mar ngo shes byung skabs khyed gyes kho mo'i phyi'i lus kyi mdzes sdug la sems 3(ra zhing / kho mos thengs dang bor khyed la bstan pa'i lhad med pa'i 'dzum mdangs des khyed rang dus gtan du bla sabyam du bcug yod srid/ yin na'ang / de dus gcig nas khyed rang kho mo'i phyi'i mo sgo tsam la mig 'khrul ba las nang gi bsam pa'i 'khyer dredags mi shes la/ gnyis nas kherdzo mo'i 'gro 'dug nyal gsum gyi gshis :snad mi shes pas de ring gi 'alhungad gdung 'di byung ba red/'di lta bu'i bsam blo ni phan tshun 'dra mnyam ma byung ba las 'byung ge yod la/ nges nga ra du bcos bsgyur 'os pa zhig kyang red snyam/ bza' zla zer ba ni lus skyes gzugs

/4 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/kyi steng nas 'dra mnyam dang nang bsam blo'i steng nas 'dra mnyam/ gshis kun spyod kyi steng nas 'dra mnyam/ slob sbyodang dang lag las ka sogs gang gi thad nas kyang 'dra mnyam zhig yong dka' rung / gtso bo phyogs sna mang so zhig nas 'dra mnyam yong rgyu de red/ de ni dang thog dga' bo sgrig skabs nas pha na tshun yun ring 'grogs pa dang gdageb bsdad pas da gzod gang dang gang nas 'dra mnyam yin min rnyed thub/ bod mi rigs la 'di lta bu'i goms gshis da lta 'i char 'jags med kyang ngas ni goms gshis 'di lta bu zhig nges par la'igs rgyur skul snying 'dod/ rang gi mi tshe gcig gi bde srid dang 'tsho ba'i ched du rang gi bza' zla gtan nas gdam nor ma byed rogs/red/ ngas bza' zla'i skor gyi rtsom yig 'di lta bu dag 'bri bzhin pa'i skabs su/slob phrug bu resna zhig gis nga la sems khong nas brdol ba'i dri ba snying rje bo zhig btang /kho mose kem kem g.yo ba'i mig zung re bas khengs bzhin/ tsho des na/ nga dang nga'i dga' rogs gnyis la mtshon na phan tshun la rnam dag gi brtseb zab mo yod pas/ nged gnyis kyi gzhug phyogs kyi 'tsho ba de bde skyed ldan pa dang phun sum tshogs pa ra 'gyur ram/ zed kho mo'i dga' rogs da lta mtho rim slob grwa 'grem bzhin pa'i slob ma zhig red 'a//khong gnyis kyi da lta'i 'brel 'a/ma ni stabs ka 'grig na re'u gza' nyi mar phan tshun la kha par gtong res byed pa dang / rgyun par slog 'phri na gtong ba tsam red/ ma zad kho mo gzhi nas 'dzin rim bcu ba'i them skas brga'/ te 'dzin grwa bcu gcig bcu gnyis dang /mtho rim slob grwa serdzogs 'grim tshar ba'i bar du nyung mthar lo drug nas bdun dgos kyi 'dug la/ dus yun de'i ring rang gi dga' rogs kyis rang nyid la sgug par yid ches byed kyin 'dug

rang gi bza' zla la 'kha nga ra med pa gnang rogs / /5skabs der ngas kho mor lan 'debs byas don/ da lta khyed kye dga' rogs dang khyed gnyis su yin rung brtsedung gi rgya mtsho'i nang lhung 'dug phan tshun la yid ches dang re bas khengs 'dug de ha cang gi legs po zhig red/ yin na'ang / ngas sgo yin na'ang ’zer skabs kho mo mdun du nur tsam byas pa dang gdong la bkra mi shis pa'i don dag cig bshad rgyu red ang bsam pa'i dngangs skrag skye bzhin med dam snyam pa zhig 'dug ngas mu mthud de/ bza' tshang zer ba de khang chung gru bzhi ma zhig bzhengs skrun byed par chag bzhag na yid ches dang brtsedung gnyis ni zur ngos bzhi las gnyis red la/ da dung phan tshun la bsam shes dang gshis :snad mthun min serdzogs kyang de'i zur ngos gzhan dag tu grub dgos/ khyed gnyis la mtshon na da lta yid ches dang brtsedung ma gtogs ci yang med pas/ zur ngos gzhan dag da dung bzhengs skrun byed rgyur lhag yod/ der brten phan tshun gyi lta ba mthun min dang gshis spyebyud mthun min sogs da dung gzhi nas shes rgyur lhag stabs/ khyim tshang grub rjes bde skyid yong min da lta nas bshad tshod thig gi ma red ces brjod pa yin/‘ ngas de ltar brjod par rgyu mtshan yod de/ khong gnyis kyis phan tshun la kha re skyel —1nga ba tsam las gzhan mnyam 'alngasags mnyam 'dug gi 'a:rdo ba zodal ba'i go skabs thob myong med pas yin no/ /

16 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams / brtse dung gi rmang gzhi ngo ma ni yid ches yin/gong gi rtsom yig tu/ bza' tshang zer ba de khang chung gru bzhi ma zhig bzhengs skrun byed par chag bzhag na yid ches dang brtse dung gnyis ni zur ngos bzhi las gnyis red la/ da dung phan tshun la bsam shes dang gshis spyod mthun min sogs kyang de'i zur ngos gzhan dag tu grub dgos zhes gsal ba ltad bza' tshang phan tshun bar na dus gtan du brlags mi nyan pa zhig 'thod pa ni phan tshun la yid ches blos 'gel bya rgyu de red/ ngas bsam na brtsedung gi ming gzhi ngo ma yang phan tshun la yid ches gtsang ma byed pa de red snyam/ phan tshun la ci tsam gyis yid ches dang blo 'grel thub na de tsam gyis brtsedung gi rmang gzhi je brtan dang rdo brkos ri mo bzhin 'gyur nad rtag brtan gyi ngo bor gnas thub/ bza' tshang gnyis la chag bzhag na zhogs pa'i nyi rtsekar ba nas dgong mo'i grib so ma gon bar dang / tshe stod nas tshe smad bar dus yun skar cha tsam yang phan tshun la kha mi 'bral bar mnyam 'gredze mnyam 'dug gi 'tsho ba zhig resal thabs med pas/ skabs rer khyo ga phyi ru song nas yun ring bya ba bsgrub dgos pa dang /yang mtshams rer chung ma sa thag ring bor song nas las don zhig tu zhugs dgos khel ba sogs 'byung gi yod mod/ rang gi mdza' sor yid ches blos 'grel dang rang gi mdza' mas dus nam yang rang nyid mi bslu bar nges shes rnyed pa/ lhag par du mi gzhan gyi kha nas go thos byung ba'i mi

brtse dung gi rmang gzhi ngo ma ni yid ches yin/ 17kha'i gtam la mi nyan par don dag yod tshad rang gi mdza' bor ma gsang bar drang po drang bzhag gis 'dre ba dang / dogs dpyod byed pa sogs bya rgyu ni gal gnad du mthong /ngas gtam 'di 'dra zhig go myong ste/ se ra dgon du chos sgor zhugs pa'i grwa pa zhig gi ma yum bod gzhung zlos gar tshogs pa'i nang 'khrub ston pa byed kyin pa dang /thengs sheg bod gzhung zlos gar tshogs pa srel kob sa gnas su gzhas sna 'khrab ston byed du 'byor skabs/ grwa pa des rang gi ma yum khrid de za khang du za ma za ru phyin pa gzhan gyis mthong ste khong la mi kha mang so lubor song zer/ gcig byas na grwa pa de'i ma yum lags gzhon nyams dod pa dang mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig yin stabs/ bltas ma thag nas ma bu gnyis mnyam du 'gro bzhin pa'i snang ba ster mi srid kyang / bus rang gi a ma khrid nas za ma zhig za ru serdzong ba tsam gyis kyang gtam mi kha lubor na/ skyes pa zhig gis rang gi ngo shes shig dang mdza' brtse zab mo yod pa'i grogs mo zhig khrid nas 'gro rgyu ni ches skrag snang can zhig red/ gang ltar yang nga tsho bod mi tshor mtshon na pha rol bor brtag dpyad dang rgyus mnga' til 'bru tsam yang med par/ pho mo gnyis mnyam du 'gro ba mthong dus khong gnyis dga' bo red zer la/ grwa pa zhig dang bud med cig mnyam du 'gro ba mthong dus grwa ba de sdom shor cig red zer ba sogs kyi sgro 'dogs sna tshogs byed/ lhag pa ra du khyo ga phyi rgyal du yod cing chung ma rgya gar nang yod pa'i bud sped cig gi ngos nas bshad na khyo ga'i dga' nye spun grogs tsho ni kho mo srung mkhan gyi gsang nyul ba lta bu yin la/ khyo gas kyang rang gi chung ma'i 'gro 'dug spyod gsum la rgyun du lta rtog nan mo byed dgos par bskul yod/ de bzhin chung ma re 'gas de ltar rang gi khyo gar lta rtog byed mkhan dang rjes 'ded gtong mkhan gyi mi bzhag yod/

18 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/rtsom yig 'ode 'bri skabs kyi nyin 'ga'i sngon tag tag der ngas rdzo mtha'i grogs mo zhig la kha par las gleng mol byed skabs kho mos bshad don/ ngas khyo gas / nga khyod la sbyor btang yid ches gtsang ma yod kyang / yang yid ches rgyu mang drags na skyon du mthong gi 'dug pas ngas khyod rang srung mkhan zhig bzhag yode/ da nas bzung rang gi 'gro 'dug spyod gsum la gzab rogs/ zhes brjod song zer/de lta bu'i bsam blo can dang skad cha bshad mkhan dag ni dngos gnas rang gi mdza' bor yid ches blos 'gel med cingan nam yin rung rang gi mdza' so gzhan la shor 'gro ba'i dogs byon nan mo byed mkhan gyi gras red la/ khong tsho rang gi mdza' bor yid ches blos 'gel med stabs mi gzhan gyis bshad pa'i skad char yid ches dgos la/ mi gzhan gyis bshad pa'i skad char yid ches stabs rang dang mdza' bo'i bar gyi brtse dung la chag skyon 'byung gi yod/gang ltar nga tshos nges par du phan tshun la yid ches gtsang ma mi byed pa'i ldog phyogs kyi gnad don gnyis la bsam blo nan tan tu gtong dgos/ de ni phan tshun yid ches gtsang ma byas pa'i bzang phyogs kyi grub 'bras dang / gal srid de las ldog na chag sgo ci zhig 'byung ba gnyis yin/ nga lta bur mtshon na rang gi mdzal mor yid ches byed mkhan zhig yin/ ngas rang gi mig ges ma mthong ba dang rna bas ma thos pa ma mthar yang kho mo rang nyid kyis dngos su ma bshad pa'i don dag rnams mi khar nyan nas thag gcod byed kyin med/ de ni nga rang gi mdza' por sems steng nas yid ches pas yin/ phar de ltar yid ches byas pa 'i mi tshad nga rang nyid kyi byas nyes dang bud med gzhan dang 'brel ba gang dang gang yod med sogs kyang drang por bshad kyin yo/da/ ( yin na'ang / skabs

brtse dung gi rmang gzhi ngo ma ni yid ches yin/ /9rer ma/ gsang sa mi 'grerdzo ba'i bya bar yang 'brad kyin 'dug ) gang thub thub kyis rang nyid kyi pye nang gsang gsum rang gi mdza' mor shes su 'jug gi sku/sgod/sngon chad nga pon sto 'dod rgu gling du sdod skabs nga rang gi mdza' ོ/ phar phud nga/'i zur brten dga' rogs gnyis yod la/ don de ngas rang gi mdza' mor drang mo drang bzhag gis bshad kyin mardzod pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i bar gyi dmigs bsal gyi 'brel ba sesgogs kyang drang por bshad kyin yod/ ngas de ltar rang skyon ngos len dang sems gtam drang bdagad byas pas kho mo rang nyid phyogs ki gnas tshul gdi/nga nga 'a/ gsang gi med/ spyi ra btang kho mo bud med slob sbyong can dang bsam shes bstun shes can zhig yin pa sa/ mi tshad/ ngas kho mo rang nyid la rnam dag gi brtse ba ma dor ba'i pan nas bud med gzhan dang mnyam du nyal so brten pa dang zur brten dga' rogs sgrig pa sogs sems la 'dzin gyi med/de'i rjes nged gnyis rgyu rkyen gzhan zhig gi dbang gis kha khar 'gro dgos byung yang /ngas sem sa nang dus nam yang don dag 'di'i steng kho mor yid 'jog chen po byed kyin yo/da/kho mophas nga la de ltar yid ches byas rkyen mi gzhan gyis bshad pa'i skad char kho mos nyan dgose byung sped/ skabs der nga la zur brten dga' rogs 'phad pa gtam mi kha brgyud na je mang zhes pa ltar/ tshig gcig gi steng du gnyis dang gsum bsnan te sgro 'angebyugs sna tshogs 〈 snas kho mosna'e rna lam du mi gzhan gyis bskyal 'dug kyang / des nged gnyis kyi brtse dung dang phan tshun la bcol ba'i yid ches la bar chad gang yang bzo thub nga byung med/ gcig nas nga rang nyid kyis kho mo'i blo spobs dang gu yangs kyi bsam blor yid ches bcol te ngas ci byas snga sa nas kho por bshad mated pa dang / gnyis nas kho

20 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/mor mtshon na ngas gnas skabs ring zur brten dga' bo brten pa des kho por brtse dung med pa dang / dus de nas bzung nged gnyis kyi lhad med pa'i brtse dung la chag sgo 'byung ba'i rgyu ru lta gi med/ de nee nga rang steng nas rnyed pa'i dpe mtshon tsam yin/des na ngas ldog 'dri zhig byed/ dper na/ gong du nga'i grogs mo zhig la dga' bose lta rtog byed mkhan gyi mi bzhag pa lta bu red/ des ma mthar yang kherdzos rang gi mdza' mo las kyang rang gi grogs po der yed ches bcol yod pa mtshon yod/ de'i stabs kyis kho rang nyid kyis dngos su ma mthong yang nam zhig kho'i grogs pos kho la bud med de mi gzhan zhig dang mnyam du 'gro gi yod skor dang / yang na kho por zur brten dga' bo yod pas mi chad mnyam du nyal ba'ang gzhan gyis mthong 'dug zer na/ khos rang gi mdza' por yid ches byed dam yang na rang gi grogs por yid ches byed/ ngas bsam na skabs der khos rang ge grogs po las mdza' mor yid ches byed ki ma red/ des na khyod rang gis dngos su ma mthong ba dang ma thos pa / yang na chung ma rang nyid kyis dngos su khyod dang rgyab 'gal ma byas pa tshun nas mi gzhan gyi gtam la dus nam yang yid ches ma byed/des khyod dang chung ma'i brtse dung dang yid ches la chag sgo 'byung ba de sems la brtan por nyar rogs/ lhag par du khyod kyis phar yid ches dang brtsedung ci cam spra da kyang da dung tshur bslu mkhan zheg yin na/ phyogs gcig nas rang gi mdza' bo de ma gzhi nas rgyu 'bras dang las 'bras la brtsi srung dang khrel gzhung bral ba'i mi zhig yin stabs red la/phyogs gzhan nas khyod rang nyid la mtshon na phar yid ches byas ma byas dang brtse dung spra da ma nd+ra da kyi thog nas 'dod pa khengs pa dang / gdeng rdzobs skyes na 'grig gi

phan tshun la bsam shes dang sems 'khur mang tsam bya rogs/ 2/ston tshun la bsam shes dang sems 'khur mang tsam bya rogs/ bza' tshang phan tshun bar na dus rgyun bsam shes mang tsam byed pa las lhag pa'i bde skyid cig med/ khyo ga phyi ru las don sgru ba tu 'gro skabs chung mas sgo 'i phyir bskyal te gyis phyag 'bul ba dang lam bar du gzab dgos skor nan gyis brjod pa/ khyo ga phyi nas nang la slebs skabs khams 'dri dang dka' tshegs byung min 'dri ba ma zad/ ja bskol nas ldud pa dang zas g.yos nas ster ba/ nyal sa gtsang mar bzos te ngal gso chog chog byed nga lta bu dang / yang khyo gas dus rgyun rang gi chung mar do snang mang tsam byed pa dang chung mas rang nyid grang bar do snang byed kyin ched na'ang / khyo gas dus ltar kho mor gom khyer yong nas/ tsho sabyag gi ma 'jug 'di gyon rogs/ zer ba dang / gyon gos zhakhrud skabs nyi mar lde rogs byed pa/ zas g.yo skabs mnyam du sngo tshal bkru ba dang nad kyis mnar skabs dus ltar sman pa skad gtong ba ma zad/ dka' tshegs la ma 'dzim par g.yo/ga rgyug pa sogs ni khyem gzhi 'dzin pa'i dgos dmigs yin la bza' tshang yod pa'i bde skyed kyang yin/tag tag 'o gcig lhag 'bosnar yang ngas sems nas don dag cig gtan nas

22 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/brjed thub kyi mi 'dug de ni nam zla cung tsam 'khyag pa'i dgun dkyil gyi mtshan mo pha zhig red/ dgong mo der nga spe sor du ma tho rim slob grwa 'grim bzhin nga 'i nga'i grogs po zhig gi nang du yod cing / khong gi mdza' mo ldi lir mtho slob cig tu 'grim bzhin yod/ khong gi mdza' mos chu tshod 11 yas mas shig la kha par btang yong ste khong la rgyun ring bor skad cha bshad sesgong la/ bar skabs shig nas/ nga 'khyag gi 'dug besgon rgyu mi 'dug da lta spe tog ra ba'i nang du langs bsdad yod/// ces ngu skad dang 'grogs nas brjod pa sa/nga'i grogs ngo/sa skad cha de thos rjesasems pa glo bur du mi skyid par gyu ra cing / 'dang rgyag gi nang du lhu nga song / khos da dung nga 'a// da ga re byed dgos pa red/ mo 'khug gi yo/da sa red/’ zer bzhin rdo leb tsha so'i steng gi grog ma ltar ci byed 'di byed med par gyur song /ngas khong la/ ’ byed rgyu gang yang yod pa ma red/ nam dkyil 'di lta bu zhig la khyod rgya gar sgo phyogs nas bsdad de/ rgya gar byang phyogs su yod pa'i khyod kyi mdza' mo 'i dro sabyag de thag gcod byed thub ki ma red/ kho mo rang nyed gyis rang gi slo ba grogs bu mo cesa'e sa nas nyal beshas 'a〈snal ba zhig g.yar ba'am/ yang na : snab 〈snags bu re'o gzhan zhig dang mnyam du nyal ba/ de yang min na 〈snan gose ma phud nga/ra nyal ba sdusgogs/ gang ltar mo rang nyid kyis thabs shes gang drag byed pa las khyod kyis gang yang sgrub thub ki ma red/ ces brdzod pa yin/red/ ngas 'di lta bu'i don dag mang sto mthong zheng thos pa yin la/ nga rang steng nas bshad kyang rgyang ring na yod pa'i nga'i mdza' mos kha par las nga na gi 'dug dang grang ge 'dug zer skabs/ ngas na dus sman par ston rgyu ma brjed la grang na spyodan bosgos mthug

phan tshun la bsam shes dang sems 'khur mang tsam bya rog sa/ 23cam spyodan rosags zhes bskul ba yin/ khosgo resnas nga la grang 〈snags kye bde sdu ga ci cam bshad kyang le dbar stong phra ga khri phrag gi tshur rol na yod nga sa ngas gang yang byed thabs bra' bas na/ gal srid kho resnas bsam shes cung tsam re byed thub rgyu na de ltar rang rang gi dga' so sems khral la gtad ki ma red/ bsam shes cung cam re byed dgos nges red/ spyi ra nga tshos thag gcod thub pa'i don dag cig yi/na na bsam gzhig byed nga dang phan tshun la sba gsang med par brjod dgos nges shig red mod/ mdza' mo'i byang phyogs kyi grang ngar dga' bos wo phyogs nas 'gog thabs bral ba shes bzhen du mja' bo'i sems pa sdug 'o/ sde ra ba ni bsam shes ma thub pa'i lan pa kho na ru nges sdurdzo/ /gong gi skad cha de tsho dngos yod sbyi tshogs 'tsho ba las byung ba'i dpe/ mtshon rma med nga zhig red 'a/ ngas de reng gi dpya da gzhir 'jin rung ba zhig tu'ang 'dod yo/da/bza' zla gnyis la mtshon na dngos gnas pan chun 'a bsam shes mang tsam bya rgyu dang ngang rgyud ring tsam bya rgyu la sa lhag cig gtan nas med/ dper na/ khyo ga phyi nas nang la thon dus kho ha cang thang chad ceng kha nas chung mar nga 'a/ 'de dgos dang gan byos me zer na'ang / chung mas rang gi khyo ga de kha skom nas mid pa'ang skam la yo da pa rtogs par byas te/ lam sang chu grang mo khyer yong nas ldud pa'am/ ja tsha so bskol yong nas sdud pa/ 'a/nga khyo ga des nyin gang sor las ka byas te gung zas kyang reg med pa ra ltogs sgom gyis mnar bzhen khyim du 'dzul na'ang / chung mas byis pa gnor skyong byed bzhin pa'i skabs dang 'khel bas khyo gas chung ma'i dka' tshegs la bsam shes byas te/ rang nyed kyis lag 'gul nas zas shig gra sgrig byed skabs/ chung ma lam sang bar du 'tshangs te khyed rang thang chad 〈snad pas ngal cung tsam gsoso dang zas ngas ga'abyu chog ces pa na tshun la kha nas dngos su ma bshad kyang sems kyis shes rto gas thub pa dang bas/ma shes

24 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/thub na ci ma rung / de ni dngos gnas skyes pa pho mo tshos bza' tshang sgrig pa 'i don go dang chung ma dang khyo ga yod pas bde skyed ma yin nam/ 'di ltar phan tshun la bsam shes dang brtsi bkur/ byams skyong byas na spyi tshogs ji ltar nyog 'jing che na'ang khyim tshang nang dgod sgra dang bde skyed kyis khengs yod la/ phyi zang zing dang lang long du rgyutshor yod kyang khyim tshang nang glu skad dang brtse gtam gyis brgyan 〈snad pa ma yin nam/de bzhin gcig gcig gi dga' phyogs dang las don la gces skyong dang brtsi bkur bya rogs/ dper na/ khyo ga de shes yon nga zhig yin pa dang khong nyin lta ra glog klad ngor cer nas rtsom yig 'bri ba'am/ yang na dus tshod nam yod la zin bris klog spe la la brel gyin yod pa lta bu dang / khyo ga de rkang rtsed spo lo dang lag rtsed spo lo/ brnyan 'phrin bcas la lta rgyur dga' ba bcas yin tshe/ chung mas kho'i dga' khyedags der gtsigs 'dzin dang rang dbang ches cher dmo da dgos la/ skabs rer mnyam zhugs bya rgyu de yang gal chen yin/ de bzhin chung mas gzhas zhabs gror dga' snang byed pa dang / grerdzogs po dang grogs mo tsho dang mnyam du 'cham 'cham la 'gro rgyur dga' snang byed pa/ mtshan tshogs khang du 'gro ba 31gas la dga' tshe khyo gas kyang bkag 'bosnag dang gnon shugs spyod rgyu ma yin pa ra mnyam zhugs dang rang dbang spyod par 'os/ de ltar phan tshun la bsam shes mang tsam byas nga sa bza' zla'i 'tsho ba las lhag pa'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba zhig gang na yod ang /yang gcig bshad na mi su yin rung nor 'a phyug ni 'byung srid pa red la/ nor 'phyug la'ang rigs mang ste dper na/ nor 'phyug re 'ga' rkang btsugs nas min na'ang sta bas ma legs pa ra 31ra 'gro ba dang / nor 'phyug re 'a ga' mi gzhan gyi brgyud skul

phan tshun la bsam shes dang sems 'khur mang tsam bya rogs/ 25'og btsan gyis bzo dgose thug pa/ re 'ga' u thug thabs zad du gyur te bzo dgos thug pa/ re zung snang med dang ches sdug shos ni khrel gzhung bral te nor 'khrul bzo bzhin nga shes bzhin du bzos pa bcas yin/ gang ltar nor 'phyug gtan nas med cing yang na 'byung mi srid pa'i mi ni 〈snad mi srid pa zheg red la/ bza' tshang gi thad nas bshad na chung ma med sa nas khyo gas bud nad gzhan la 'brel ba byed pa dang / khyo ga med sa nas chung mas skyes pa gzhan la nyal so brten pa bcas ni yong srid pa zhig red/ lha ga par du bza' zla zung phan tshun kha gyes te yun ring 'gor skabs 'di lta bu 'byung srid pa chosi nyid cig red/ deng skabs bod rigs rnams chab srid kyi dbang gis sod phyi nang gnyis dang gudzam gling gi rgyal khab mang bo'i nang du kha 'thor du gnas yo/da la/ bza' zla mang sa zhig kyang de ltar chung ma 'od nang du yod na khyo ga a rir yod pa dang / skye sa pa rgya gar na yod na chung ma yu rab gling du yod pa sogs mang bo yod/der brten chung ma a rir yod pa'i skyes pa zhig gis lo gcig dang gnyis ring kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba rol dgos byung dus/ kher rkyang gi sdug bsngal ni ma gzhi nas bzod thabs bral thog khyim mtshes tshang gi bu po'am/ yang na las grogs gcig pa'i bu po 〈snags su 'brel ba chags te kha thag je nye ru 'gro ba dang sems dang bsam pa je mthun du 'gro ba'ang yod srid pa red la/ yang skyes pa des kher rkyang ge sdug bsngal ma bzod nas la dang lung pa nas bud med thug tshad la 'brel ba byas te chung ma med shul nas gang 'dod du sakhrog sgod kyi bya ba'ang gnyer srid pa zhig red/ de bzhin chung ma des kyang a ri nas lkog las ddhi tshogs byed srid pa zhig red/ yin na'ang / nam zhig khyo shug gnyis mnyam gcig tu 'dzoms nas bza' tshang mnyam 'dzoms kyi dga' bder rol dus/ chung mas sngar rang nyid med shul du khyo gas kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba ji ltar rol tshul

26 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/dogs 'dri dang ya/nga na dpang rtags re zung gi steng nas khyo ga bud med gzhan dang mnyam du nyal myong ba sermegs shes rtogs byung tshe/ skabs de dus khong khro langs te lam sang sdug skad rgyag bzhin/ khyo ga'i steng khyi ngar ngar byed rgyu de gtso bo min la gnad don thag gcod bye da pa'i thabs lam yang min/ kho mo khyo ga'i steng ji tsam sgo(ra yang khyo gas byas zin pa 'i bya ba de phyir ldog yong mi srid la des da dung stabs nyes na don dag chung chung che ru btang ste/ bza' tshang kha 'thor dang gnad don tshabs chen du gtong srid pa zhig red /de bzhin khyo gas kyang chung ma'i nor 'khrul rigs shes rtogs byung skabs lam sang sdug skad rgyag rgyu gtso ngepha ma red/des na gnad don de ji lta ra thag gcod byed dam/ de ni gnad 'gag red/ gal srid chung ma de shes rgya che zhing thabs la mkhas pa zhig yi/na tshe rang gi khyed gar bsam shes thengs shig bya rgyu de red la/ de bas kyang gu yangs thengs shig sprod rgyu de red/ de ltar byed par don snying chen po ldan te khyo gas rang gi chung ma'i blo rgya dang bsam shes 'a/ sngar bas kya nga yi rangs sheng / sems 'gul thebs srid pas dus de nas bzung rang nyid kyis gtan nas de ltar bya ngan mi bsgrub par dam bca' ba dang / yang na sngar bas kyang rang gi chung mar brtseb je zab dang yid rton je brtan du 'gyur srid/ de ni dngos gnas thabs lam ya/ga perdzo zhig red/ngas goge gas byung ba ltar na/ spel kob gzhis chags su skyes nga zhig gis phyi rol nas bud med gzhan dang mnyam du nyal so brten gyi yod pa rang gi chung mas shes kyi yod la g.yas g.yon gyi khyim mtshes tshos kyang bshad kyin yod pa red zer/ yi/na na'ang / nyin zhig khyo ga de phyi nas nang du slebs dus kho'i chung ma dang skyes pa gzhan zhig gis

phan tshun la bsam shes dang sems 'khur mang tsam bya rogs/ 27'khrig la sa byed pa dang stabs khel byung ba ma zad/ mi ngan re zung gis de lta bu'i gnad don nee chabs chen yin tshul dang gtan nas gu yangs la gtong rgyu med tshul gyi dkrugs shing 'pha ngas te/ mthar khos chung ma de g.yugs pa red zer/ khong gnyis la da dung bu chung snying rje bo zhig kyang yod rabs 'duga'adi dngos byung gi don dag cig yin mod/gal srid skyes pa de cung tsam thabs la mkhas shing rang ges byas nyis ngos zen mkhan zhig yin na/ rang gi chung mar gu yangs thengs shig gnang 'os te de ne khong bza' zla gnyis tsam ma zad snying nas brtse ba'i bu chung gi mdun lam dang 'brel ba yod/ gzhan gyi zer rjes su 'brangs nas rang gi bza' zla dang bu phrug kha 'thor du 'gro ba las lhag pa'i sdug bsngal zhig gang na yod/ des na nga tshos dngos byung gi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong las legs pa'i cha phyogs sdom dang gzhug phyogs kye mdun lam 'a/ do nyakhur mang tsam byed nga/ra 'chal/ 'jig rten gyi bza' zla pho mo tsho/

28 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/bzang tshang gi rtsod nyog chung sa nas che sar 'pho ba yin/bzang tshang gi rtsod rtog ni rgyal khab dang mi rigs/ chos dang srid gang gi thog na'ang med par bu phrug dang pha ma/ sgo phyi khyim bar na yod/ de yang khyim mtshes tshang dang kha lag pa'i bar na 'dzid/ khyo gas chung mar kha lag bzo rogs mi byed pa de ya/nga don dag chung chung min la/ chung mas khyo gar gyon pa zhakhrud rogs mi byed pa de yang don dag chung chung min/ khyo gas srang nas bud med gzhan gyi gdong 'a/ lta ba de ya/nga don dag chung chung min 'a// chung mar skyes pa/ gzhan zhig gis dus rgyun kha par gtong ba de ya nga don dag chung chung min/ bza' tshang gi rtsod rtog ma gzhi nas chung sa chung sa nas che sa che sar 'pho bzhin yod/nyin gcig dang gnyis/ yang na zla gcig dang gnyis la ja skol rogs byed min dang zas g.yo rogs byed min/ gyon pa 'khyad rogs byed min/ srang 'a mnyam du 'gro min sogs ni don dag chung tshegs gras yin mod/ lo dang zla ba bstud nas mnyam du gshib dgos pa'i bza' zla zung gi ngos nas bshad na de dag yod tshad don dag chen po yin/ yid mi ches na nam rgyun 'khrug 'dzing gi khrod nas dus 'da' bar byed pa'i bza'

bzang tshang gi rtsod nyog chung sa nas che sar 'pho ba yin/ 29zla zung la/ khyed gnyis rtse'i phyir 'di ltar ma 'cham mam zhes dris dang / khyed gas chung ma der pa ra gcig bzigad na tshur gnyis bshad ki 'dug la/ rgyun du brnyan 'phrin ngor cer sdad nas kha lag kyang mi bzo ba ma zad/ gyon pa gtan nas 'khrud kyin mi 'dug pas nga rang nyid kyis bkru dgos khel gyi 'dug ces zer srid la/ chung mas khyo gas sngon chad nga la zas g.yo rogs byed na'ang deng skabs byed kyi mi 'dug pa ma zad/ ngas zas g.yos te grang mo ma chags par bsgug bsdad na'ang grogs po tsho'i nang du sesgrong nas za ru mi 〈snang ba ma zad/ mtshams rer las ka grol nas yu/na ring 'gor na'ang phyir nang du mi yong ba ma zad/ zhogs pa yang zhogs nyal brgyab bsdad de nga gcig pus nangs ja kher za byas nas las kur 'akro dbosgos kyi 'dug ces sethogs brjod srid/red red/ 'di thams cad don dag chung tshegs rigs shig red/ lhag par du rgyal khab cig dang mi rigs shig gi ngos nas bshad na gleng rin cang med nga zhig red mod/ bza' chang gi ngos nas bzigad na 'di dag gi thad nas ma 'cham dus rtsaba'i cha nas ma 'cham pa yin pa sa/don dag chung sa dag gtan nas snang med du skyur mi nyan la/ bza' chang gi rtsod nyog don dag chung sa chung sa nas che sa che sa ru 'pho bzhin yod nga/ de brjed :she nyan/'di'i thad du bza' tshang re zung gis bzang phyogs nas kyang kha rtsod rgyag bzhin pa ngas mthong myong / dper na thengs shig ngas ngo shes bza' tshang gnyis dgong mo'i nub chu 'thung la nye skabs kha rtsod shor song / khong gnyis kyi rtsod gzhi ni 'di lta ste chung mas rang gi khyo gas khyod kyis ci'i phyir mtshon srung mi 'dogs pa yin nam/ mtshon srung btags na khyod kyi jig nyams 'phrog 'gro gi 'dug gam/ skes mi theg pa'i dka' ngal

30 'khris/ gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/'dug gam/tsho serdzogs khyo gas rgyun nga ra mtshon srung mi 'dogs nga de ni chung mas gnad don tshabs chen zhig tu ngos won byed kyin khrug yin na'ang / kha rtsod brgyab brgyab mthar phan tshun lag kyang 'gul la nye bar gyur song / khyo gar mtshon na mtshon srung 'dogs pa'i bsam pa me 'dug nga/ ma zad/ khose da dung dad pa zer ba ni sems rgyud la dgordzos nga/ zhig las mtshon srung btags ma btags la khyad par ci sku/sgod zer/ gang ltar yang / khong gnyes kyi rtsod gzhi 'de ltar chung zhing don snying mi ldan na'ang / chung ma des don dag 'di'i steng nas nged gnyis thengs mang bor lubrug rtsod shor zhing / de ni kho pos rang gi khyod ga'i bde 'jags la sems khral shugs cher byas pa las byung ba yin tshul sogs kyang 'grel/dgong mo der nga tsho der yo/da kyi mi tshang mar mi sgyid pa byung thog khong bza' mi gnyis gcig gcig gi thog stag ngar ngar byed kyen 'dug la/ phyi nyin yang nyin gung ma zin bar du de ltar kha rtsod rgyag pa dang mug shi bgrangs nas bsdad/ yin na'ang / khong gnyis ni dus rgyun mdza' brtse zab mo can dang phan tshun la brtsi bkur yod nga/'i bza' zla zung yin stabs/ 'de lta bu'i don dag chung tshegs rigs kye steng nas kha rtsod chen po sgosgor ba ne gcig nas blo ngor cung 31nga dka' zhing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bza' tshang gi rtsod nyog rnams don dag chung sa nas che sar 'pho bzhin yod pa'i go brda spyod kyin 'dugagal srid khosgong gnyis kyis mu mthud phan tshun la bsam shes ma thub pa ra lag 'dres nga lta shu byung tshe de'i mjug 'bras ni sus kyang bshad tshod thub pa zhig min pas/ ngas mu mthud du 'di'i thad du bsam blo gtong thub pa mi 'duga'on kyang / spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i dngos byung gtam rgyud dag gis nga tshor gzhug

bzang tshang gi rtsod nyog chung sa nas che sar 'pho ba yin/ 3 /rngogs ji ltar byed 'os min dang nor 'phyug nad pa'i 'tsho ba zhig rol rgyur lam ston /dzad kyin 'dug pas/ bza' tshang phan tshun gyis dus nam yang bzod sgom byed pa dang dog rgya yangs po bya rgyu de yang / bde skyirmod kyi 'tsho ba zhig dang dbosgod sgras khengs pa'i /za' tshang zhig 〈snang ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur nges yin pa ma brjed rogs/

kya 2 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/bcesan ma lta bu'i (sgro gabud med mang bos rang gi khyo gar dmigs bsal gyis lta rtog dang do snang byed ki red/ lhag par du nyin re bzhin rang gi khyo gas las ga'i skabs su me su dang su 'a/ 'brel ba byed pa dang rang nyid med sar bung med gzhan 'a/ 'brel ba byed pa/ yang na rang nyid dang mnyam du yo/da bzhin du rang gi khyo ga'i mig bud med gzhan gyi mtshar sdus rgi lang tsho'i steng 'alhusgor ba'am/ srang lam nas bud med gzhan la lag 'ju byed nga// mi mang nang bud med gzhon nu mar skad cha bshad pa soges la re re bzhin brtag dpyad dang bud med de dang 'brel ba ci yod sogs tsha 'dre yang 'dri byed ki red/ khong tshos bsam par rang nyid rang nyid kyi khyo gar dga' zhing dung bas rang gi khyo ga bung med gzhan dang mnyam du dus yun skar cha tsam la skad cha bshad pa dang / 'brel ba byed pa'i be( skabs med par bzo dgos snyam gyi sku da/ lhag par de'i rigs kyi bud med rnams kyis rang na khyo sa bud sped gzhan dang 'grogs par gcig nas phra ga dog dang gnyis nas sgo|ra 'gro ba'i dogs byon byed kyin yod srid/dper na/ rang nyid las brel zheg gi ched du phyi la song rjes phyir khyim spyod kha par steng kha par btang ste/ khyo ga nang du yod med la brtag nga dang / khyo ga las khungs su phyin rjes las khungs kye kha nga ra steng kha par btang ste khyo ga las khungs nang 〈snang yod med 'dri

brtsan ma lta bu'i khyo sa 33ba/ khyo ga phyi nas nang la thon rjes lag khyer kha par bsdogs te ang grangs gsar ba'am sngar 'brel 'dres byed myong med pa'e rigs 'a/ 'brel ba byas yod med dang / brda 'phrin 'dra mi na 'byor yod med sogs la brtag pa dang / dogs pa yod nga 'i ang grangs rigs dang brda 'brin rigs byung skabs khyo gar tsha 'dre yang 'dri byed nga dang / yang na mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston par ma zad/ dngos su ang grangs de dag myeng kha par btang ste rtsad gcod byed pa lta bu/ yang kho mo tsho phyi logs su song nas yun sdong nang du ngo ga ma thub pa ra la sa dar zhugs dgorngom byung stabs/ mtsham mo/ra kha par gtong gi red la/ gal srid skabs de lta bu 'ib la khyo gas mi zhig dang kha par las kha brda byed bzhin skusgod dku sa rang ge kha par cha zung thabs bral skabs/ phar phyogs kyi mi de su yin min dang 'a/sa ka ci zhig gi cheng du kha par btang ba semags la gtan nas rgyus 'isnan mi byed pa ra/ mchan mor bud med ma gtogs kha par mi gtong ba dang rang nyid nang du med shul du khyo gas bud med gzhan la 'brel ba byed pa gzhir byas te/ rkang btsugs nas nyog dra 'dzugs ki red/yin na'ang / khong tshos de lta bu'i thal cha che ba'i brtse ba spro da stangs dang de'i 'jegs yer ba'i mjug 'bras gtan nas mthong gi med/ brtse ba'i ming gzhi nee ma gzhi nas yid ches yin dadzopām pas rang gi khyed gar yid ches til 'bru tsam yang med bzhin du/ 'otho dang zla ba bsdud de khyo ga mnyam du skyid mnyam sdug mnyam gyi 'tsho ba zhig yerdzong sta ngas med la/ de bas kyang do snang chen po dang zhib tshags po'i sgo nas rang gi khyo ga srung nyin nas khyod kyi khyo ga de ni don la rang ngabang bral zhing sems pa btson la tshud pa'i bzang btson lta bu zhig red/nam zhig nas khyo ga'i sems su phyi rol gyi rang dbang gi 'tsho ba dang dwangs gtsang gi mkha' dbugs dag 'ong gi red la/ skabs de dag tu rang gi chung mar sun snang skye ba

34 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/dang yid 'chad 'byung ba sogs kyang mgo 'dzugs ki red/ bud med 'di'i rigs kyis da dung rang gi khyo gas rang nyid la'ang de ltar phra ga dog dang dogs byon dgos skor brjod ki red/ ji ltar phrag dog dang dogs son byed na de tsam gyis rang la dga' zhing dung ba'i rtags mchan red snyam bzhin 〈snad/ 'on kyang / don dngos thog bza' tshang gi 'brel lam ni 'di lta bu zhig gtan nas yi/na mi 'os/ khyod kyi khyo ga de gzhung zhabs las byed rtseg red dam yang na rtsom sgrig khang zhig gi rtsom sgrig pa red/ de yang min na bzo grwa zhig gi las bzo ba red/ gang ltar yang / kho zhogs pa snga bo nas yar langs te khyod dang mnyam du zhogs zas cas rjes las kur 'gro dgos nga dang dgong mo 'phyi bo ma gtogs nang du slebs thub kyi med par/ rang gnye'i las 'gan bsgru ba dgos la/ de ni khyed gnyis kyis gsar du bskrun pa'i khyim gzhe chung chung 'di'i ched du'o/ /des na phyi nas khyo ga'i lus la las ga'i dka' tshegs che thog phyir nang du thon dus kyang sems ngal 'thol ba mi gnang bar zhu zhu/ rang gi khye1 gar sems gting nas yed ches tshad med gnang rogs/ phar de ltar yid ches gtsang ma gnang bas khomang gi ngos nas khyed 'a/'ang de lta ra yid ches gtsang ma 'thob par 'gyur/ de ni khyed gnyis kyis mnyam du longs su spyod 'os nga 'e bde skyid de'o/ /

gra sgrig yod pa gnang rogs/ 35gra sgrig myosad pa gnang rogs/ mi mang bo 'tsho ba la yid thang chad cing brtse dung la zhen pa log 'dug mi mang bo brtsedung gi bran g.yog tu gyur cing sdug bsngal gyis gnya' nas mnan 'dug khong tsho'i bsam par 'jig rten na bde skyed dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba yod zer ba ni skyag rdzun red la/ lhad med pa'i brtse dung dang tshe gang gi bza' zla yod zer ba'ang go ldog tu gyur 'dug 'tsho ba ni ched du mi la mnar gcod gtong mkhan zhig las ci yang ma red 'dod kyin 'dugakhong tshos de ltar 'dod par gtan nas khag med de/ re zung chung mas bskyur te gzhan rjes 'brangs nas phyin stabs sdug bsngal gyi g.yang gzar la lhu nga 'dug la/ re zung khyo ga grongs rjes sdug bsngal gyi mtsho gting du nub 'dug gang ltar yang mi mang sa mang bo zhig rang rang gi sa na sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhu nga ste 'jig rten gyi bya byed thams cad la yid mug cing zhin pa 'ebyug 'dug da nas bzung khong tshos sngar bzhin bde skyid dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba rol bar brtson gyi mi 'dug la/ rang nyid kyi rnam shes kyang rang la mi dbang ba'i tshod du gyur 'dug yin na'ang / mi de'i rigs kyis 'tsho ba la de ltar ngos 'dzin thabs skyo bo zhig las byed ma thub pa ni khong tshos 'tsho ba'i don snying ma rtogs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos nyid ma gtogs pa sa kyang yin/

3 6 'khris gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/ spyir sod lta bur mtshon na 'di'i rigs kyi gnad don de tsam tshabs chen ma red/ khyod tsho nam rgyun gsar 'gyur las/ rigs la do snang yo/da mkhan dang yang cha sra/nga lam gyi skad char nyan rgyur dga' mkhan zhig de yang min na shes ldan mi sna zhig yin na phyi gling ba'i rgyal khab khag tu 'tsho ba dang brtse dung gi mnar gcod thebs pa'i me rnams kyis rang sems ma non nga ra/ lag tu spe mda' dang gri sogs khyer te rang bi chung ma bu phrug sdeb gsod dang pha ma gnyen tshan sogs kyang sdeb gsod byed/ mthar rang gi sros dbugs kyang rang gis bcad 'gro ba'i don dag skyugs bro bo de'i rigs mang bo 'byung bzhin pa 'i skor mthong thos 'byud rgyu red/ me de'i regs ni khog rgya ha cang gu dog pa 'i khar sngon chad gtan nas dka' tshegs dang sdug bsngal la 'phrad ma myong ba'i gras red/der brten/ dka' khag gi gnas su lhung dus mu mthud dka' khag de las rnam pa ra rgyal ba'i thabs shes 'tshol thub kyi mi 'dug la/ ma mtha' ya/nga btang 〈snams su gnas thub pa'i blo sto bas mi 'dug pa de red/gang ltar yang / skye ba nas 'chi ba dang bde ba nas sdu ga pa/ dar ba dang rgud nga sogs ni mi rtag pa sha stag red/ bod me tshos de la 'a sa dbang zer zhing / las dbang ni khyed kyis gtong bzhin pa'i rlangs 'khor gyi dkyog 'khor ltar gang du dkyog chog chog dang / rlangs gsor gyi lubor sgag ltar tshod 'dzin byed chog cig gtan nas min te/ de las khyed ni khyed kyes gtong bzhin pa'i rlangs 'khor ltar gang du dkyog min dang gang nas 'dug min bcas las dbang gi lag na sku da/ khyed rang las dbang gis rlangs lubor bzhin gtong gi 〈snad la/ las dbang gis 'jam rtsub gang du bzhag kyang khyed rang de nas 'dug dgotes/ de ltar na las dbang gis khyed rang gang la bskor nas gang du bzhag nalang gra sgrig yod nga gnang rogs/ 'on kyang / yod tshad kyi yod tshad las dbang

gra sgrig yod pa gnang rogs/ 37gis go sgrig lta ra yin pas da nas bzung 'bad brtson byed mi dbosgos la/ las dbang 'a/ bzlog tu med pas le 'osto dang sgyid lug gi ngang du gnas sgo ga zer ba'am min pad gtso bo gnad 'gag gi skabs su slebs dus rang sems rang ges gnon thub pa bya dzesags zer ba yin/khyed kyis setems dang nyin 'ga'i sngon du khyed kyis g.yu byu ru'i rgyan cha btags shing / rta nor lug gsum gyi rdzongs pa byin te khrid slebs pa'i bag gsar ma de/ de ring nas bzung dka' sdug dang kyag kyog gi lam bu ji lta bu zhig brgyud dgo sa rung khyed dang mnyam 'gro mnyam 'dug byas te/ tshe gang bor khyed dang kha 'bral mi srid pa khyed kyis ji lta ra shes sam / ma zad khyed rang nyid kyang de ring kho mor rnam dag bi brtse ba 'chang mkhan dang kho mo'i lhad med kyi dung sems la spro dgas rab tu brtas te/ yang nas yang du kho mor tshong dka' sdug dang gnas stangs gang 'dra zhig gi nang du lhu nga yang khyod dang gtan nas kha mi 'bral / zhes dam 'cha' bzhin yo/da kyang / khyod kyis khyod rang nyid gsor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du'am// yang na khyed rang ji srid gnas pa de srid du 'gyur ched rtag brtan zhig yin pa ji ltar rtogs sam/ mi rtogs te khyod kyi chung mar khyed dang gnyecho ma bsgrig pa'i sngon gyi 'char snang dang bde skyid yod la/ khyed dang gnyen sgrig byas rjes kye 'char snang dang bde skyid kyang yod pas/ gal srid khyed rang dngos gnas kho mor 'tsham zhing 'os pa'i ma/ga pa bzang sa zhig min tshe lam sang min rung / nam zheg kho mo 'gyur rgyur gtan khel red/ de bzhin khyed rang nyid kyang sngon chad rang gi chung ma'i phyi'i lus kyi mdzes sdug la sems zugar ba ltar/ 'grerdzogs gin 'gre gas zhin nang bsam pa'i 'khyer phyogs dang gshis 〈snad sesgogs khyod dang gtan nas mi mthun pa sesgogs kye dbang gis kho resna khye1da la casas 'azlom zhig min pa shes rtetegs byung tshe/ nam zhig khye1da kyang u thug

38 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/thabs zad du gyur te kho mo dang bza' 'thor bya rgyu las thabs med pa lta bu 'byung srid/de'i phyir du na tshe 'dir rgyu nor longs spyod ladzoms pa dang khyim la dgod sgras khengs dus de longs su pyod shes par bya rgyu de gal che la/ nam zhig rgyu nor longs sbyod stong zhing khyim chung mas g.yug nas bud song yang / yang bskyar 'tsho ba gsar ba dang bde skyid gsar ba'i mgo 'dzugs rgyur gra sgrig yod pa gnang rogs/ ma mthar yang gnad 'gag gi skabs su rang blo btang snyoms su gnas thub pa'i gra sgrig gnang rogs/gal srid khyed kyi sems na de lta bu'i gra sgrig cig yod pa nas khyed rang chung mas bskyur te gzhan rjes 'brangs nas phyen yang / khyed la mgo go dgye mi thub pa'i sdug bsngal zhig yong dogs med la/ rgyu nor longs sgod kyis stong song yang 'gyel sa nas langs thub pa'i blo sto bas ldan pa yin/ 4'on kyang / ngas khyed tshor gra sgrig sdug sa nas byas te re ba bzang sa nas rgyag par bskul ba yin la/ 'jig rten khams na 'gyur med rtag brtan du gnas srid pa'i bya dngos sna gcig kyang med pas 'tsho ba la gra sgrig yod pa gnang rogs/ 'gyur ldog la gra sgrig yod pa gnang rogs/ 'gyur ldog dang len byed thub par dam bca' rogs zer ba tsam las nges par du de lta bu'i kha chag sna ral gyi don skye na rigs 'byung gi red zer ba'ang min/ngas khyod tshor de bas kyang kha gsal du btang nas 'di ltar bshad 'dod de/ khyed tshos rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang wa ra ṇa si gtsos nang pa/'i gnas chen khag dang bod kyi rgyal sa gnyis pa ste/ byang phyogs dha sa sogs su gnas mjal du phyin skabs/ rkang chad lag rdum du song 'dug pa'i rgya gar ba'i sprang so dag mthong myong ngam/ khong tsho dngos

gra sgrig yod pa gnang rolas/ 39gnas blo rnyasnabs ldan pa dang 'tsho gnas kyi ched du 'che bdag la gtan nas mabesna botho mi sgu ra ba'i mi snying rus can rkyang rkyang red/ khyed tshos mthong myong ngam/ khong tsho'i re zung 'ded 'khor gyi steng du bsdad de gnyen nye tshan zhig gis ded nas lto gos slong du 'gro bzhin yo/da la/ re zung rkang pa zha 'dug kyang rkang lubor steng bsdad de rang nyid kyis lag zung gis rkang lubor ded nas 'gro bzhin yod/ re zung mig zung zhar te gnyen nye tshan gyis khrid nas lto gose slo nga du 'gro gi yod la/ re zung lag rdum chags te gzhan gyis sbyon nga 'i dngul yang khug ma'i nang 'jug thub kyi med na'ang sto gos slong gi yod/de ltar lus kye dbang bo gang rung zhig mi tshang bar 'tsho bas mnar gcod ci tsam gtong bzhin skusgod na'ang / khong tshos mu mthud rang nyid 'tsho gnas kyi ched du nyin mtshan pre da par sto gos bslangs te 'tsho ba rol thabs byed gyen yod/ de'i phyetshor du na dbang bo lnga thang ngo yin pa'i me zhig khyim chung mas bskyur ba de ni don chung red la/ kha ngo skye sa 'bras legs pa'i rdza ༄sag bu mo zhig gi khyo ga grongs nga/ de yang don chung red/ skabs thog cig ring sdug bsngal skudad pa mi tshang ma 'dra mtshungs yin yang mu mthud nas 'tsho ba rol bar brtson dgerdzos la/ lubor ba dang 'tsho bar zhen pa log ga la rung / de ltar sems shugs bskyed la gra sgri ga yod pa gnang rogs/

40 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams /gal srid bza' 'thor byung na/ skabs 'dir ngas khyod tshor don dag cig gleng 'dod byung / ga' phu srid bza' 'thor lta bu byung na/ de'i rjes ci zhig byed dam zhes pa de yin/ gong du brjod zin pa ltar bza' 'thor 'byung ba nee yong srid pa zhig red la/ nga ni de la hang sang gi mi 'dug yin na'ang /nga bza' 'thor byung rjes kye mi'i bya sbyod la hang sang gi 'dug cung gsal sor zhus na nga tsho 'od mi rnams kyi bya spyod la hang sang gi 'dug nga tsho dngos gnas dkrog gtam bzo rgyu dang mi zhig me kho rang ma yin pa'i mi gzhan zhig tu bzo rgyur byang chub 'dug dper na/ bza' mi gnyis 〈snag mar dga' rogs chags te khyim gcig gi bza' zla ma chags pa'i skabs de ni phal cher khong gnyis su yin rung phan tshun sems kyi gting zab sa dang dung ba che sa ru yod yod pa lta bu red la/ skabs thog der khong gnyis su yin rung rang gi nye gsor gyi pha ma ming sring dang gnyen nye tshan yod tshad la rang gi dga' rogs ni mi shes rgya can dang yon tan can/ lag rtsal can dang brtsedung can/ rgan par bkur zhing gcoman par byams pa'i skyes pa zhig yin tshul dang / yang skyes pa des nga'i dga' rogs nee bud nad shes rab can dang rnam rig rgod po can/ dka' sdu ga la gdong len byed thub mkhan dang bza' tshang la kha zhe gnyis med can/ 11gas 〈sna dang ru kha khyim mtshes bar mthun sgril can yin pa sogs skabs rer skad cha re zung sgro btags nas 'ur bstod

gal srid bza' 'thor byung na/ 4/ byed pa red/ de ni thog mar bza' zla chags skabs kho na'i dus yun de'i ring gi skad cha dag red/ de bzhin nam zhig sta bas ma legs par bza' 'thor du phyen tshe rang nyid kyis sngar bshad myong ba'i skad cha dag brjed de/ rang gi bza' zla ni ma rung khog bcug mkhan dang / mi 'a mgo skor gtong mkhan/ ga〈sna sgyu la mkhas shing bslu brid la goms pa zhig yin stabs rang nyid kyang da bar kho'i bslu brid 'og shor zhing / de ni rang la mig yod bzhin du g.yang la mchong ba dang gcig mtshungs yin tshul/ mi des nga'i tshe gcig gi bde skyid brlags song la 'das song gi dka' sdug dang rngul chu yod tshad chu la bskyu ra tshul sogs brjod pa yin/ de bzhin pho rnams kyis kyang rang gi chung mar rnam pa med tshul dang spyoted pa med tshul/ bshad rgyu gtam rgyu mang tshul/ rang gi nang mi sdu/na sring la kha rtsod rgyag pa dang ru kha khyim mtshes la mthun sgril mi byed pa/rang gi las don la gzhogs 'degs mi byed pa sogs skyon sna chung ngu rnams kyang chen ngo/ra bzos te bshad/skabs 'dir dngos gnas skad cha chig gcig gi steng tshig gnyis bsnan te phan tshun nag po bzo rgyu yod tshad cig bzo rgyur the tshom spu tsam yang med pa de red/ de ni phyogs gcig nas mi rang nyeng 'a/ lhag bsam dang drang bden skyong ba'i rgyu 'bras blo mig med pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas phan tshun gyi ma 'ongs pa'i mdun la ma thad do khur dang 'gan len ma byarmos pa'i skyon red/ dper na/ bkra don zer ba dang bstan chos zer ba gnyes bza' 'thor byung rjes/ bstan chos kyis mi thug tshad la bkra don gyis nga'i lang tsho 'phro brlag tu btang ba dang pha ma'i rgyu nor 'phro brlag tu btang ba/ bu phrug gi mdun lam/ 'phro brlag tu btang ba sogs skyon dang nor 'khru'/ yod tshad kho'i mgo thog tu 'ded

42 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/thabs byed nga ra chag bzhag chog yin na'ang / skabs der khyed tsho'e sems la nges dgos pa zhig ni/ 'o na bstan chos rang la nor 'khrul sna gcig kyang med nga red dam zer ba de red/ bstan chos kyis ci'i phyir rang gis nor 'khrul 'de bzos nas khos nga dang bza' 'jor byas song zer nas don dngos mi brjod pa yin nam/ don dngos thog bkra don me de de lta bu'i ma rabs tha shal dang ga'adzi sgyu khram gsum la byang chub pa zhig yin nam zhe na min te/ kho ni gzhung rgyud drang zhing las la brtson par ma zad rang gi mdun lam gtan nas nor ma 〈snang ba'i mi brtsone 'grus can zhig yin/ kherdzo ni bstan chose kyis ches thog mar mthong ba'i ya rabs tshul mthun dang 'gro shes 'dug shes byed pa'i me de rang 'jags yin/ khong gi lus steng gi mi 'dra sa ni sngon chad khong gnyis phan tshun la brtsedung ldan pa dang kho mor byams skyong tshad med byed mkhan zhig yin na'ang / khong gnyes bza' zla bsgrigs nas yu na ring 'gor rjes khong gnyis las don mang bo'i thad lta tshul mi ma thun pa byung ste/ bstan chos la sun sna nga skye mgo tshugs nga dang / kho mor thog mar bza' 'thor byetshod pa 'i gros mgo bton pa'am/ yang na nges par du bza' 'thor byed dgos pa'i skul ma btang ba de red/des na kho dang yun ring 'grogs pa'e kho'i chung mas ci'i byer kho mi nag po nag rkyang zheg tu bsgru bas pa red dam/ khong gnyes bza' snathor byung ba nee bza' zla phan chun lta tshul mi mthun pa dang gshis :snad mi mthun pa las byung ba yin mo da/ kho 'a/ mtshon na de las ldog ste bza' 'thor byutshong rjes sngar byung myong med pa 'i dka' sdug gi 'gag phreng gzhan zhig babod dbesgos 'byung / de ni mi kha dang ma nyes khag gasku'igs kyi zhwa re nag ngo deces/ / ༄mo

zhedzisdekhe brtse dung ldan pa'i mi'i bya spyod ngo ma ci lta bu zhig yin nam/ 43 de ltar bza' tshang kha 'thor 'gro ba la hang sang rgyu gtan nas me 'dug mod/ nga tshos tha'/ drags nga 'i 'grel ngo/ga dag la gzab dgos te de ni rang nyid gcig pus sems nang gi na zug ma bzod pa ra pa rol bo nag sto bzo ba'am/ yang na rang nyid dkar 'don byed ched cam red/ gnam 'og ge bza' zla pho mo zung lags/ khyed gnyis bar na brtse dung gi spe ro lhag ma yod la dus yun ring bor mnyam 'grogs mnam 'dug gi 'tsho ba rol ba'i mdza' brtse zab mo yod pas/ khyed gnyis bza' 'thor byung na'ang phan tshun gyi gzhug phyogs kyi don dag 'a cung tsam brtsi bkur dang gdeng lasdog byed rgyu ma brjed par gyis la/ bag yod par gyis shig

44 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/brtse dung ldan pa'i mi'i bya spyod ngo ma ci lta blu zhig yin nam/gong du bkod pa ltar yun rir 'grogs pa'i bza' zla zung phan tshun kha 'bral dgos byung ba lta bu ni spi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang du yang dang bskyar du 'byung bzhin pa'i don dag cig yin stabazlo/ nga tshos bsam shes thub pa'i thog nas khong gnyis kyi rang dbang dang 'dod mos srung skyob byas thog khong gnyes kha 'bral min de khong gnyis kyis thag gcod ltar brtsi bkur byed dgos pa red la khyo ga dang kho'i nang mi spun mched/chung ma dang kho mo'i gnyen nye tshan su gcig gis kyang khong gnyis kyi nang gi gcig nyes med nyis can du mi bsgrub par mkhyen/ rab byung na khong gnyis kha khar song ma thag pa'i mkha' dbugs dwangs mo lda yang zang zing lang long du ma gtong rogs/ khong gnyis su yin na'ang phan tshun la rgyu mtshan re yod phyir kha khar phyin pa yin kyang / sems gting na bzod thabs bral ba'i sdug bsngal yod srid pas sems gso dang mu mthud spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang du gom pa gsar ba zhig spo bar ram 'degs byed rogs/ lhag par du nang mi gnyen tshan rnams kyis khong gnyis la rjes phyogs phan tshun thug 'phrad byed mi chog pa dang / sems nang nas gcig gcig brjed dgos pa sesgogs kyi tha tshig ma bsgrags rogs/

brtse dung ldan pa'i mi'i bya spyod ngo ma ci lta bu zhig yin nam/ 45de ltar ngas gong gi skad cha de dag rang dbang med par kha nas shor song / ma zad nga'i ya chung sems nang du da dung de las kyang lhag pa'i skad cha mang bo mang bo zhig 'tshang yong gi 'dug de ni don dngos thog ci zhig la brtsedung zer ba dang brtse dung ldan pa'i mi'i bya sbyordzod ci lta bu zhig red dam zhes pa de red/ skabs rer ngas bod mi tsho las lhag pa'i brtsedung can dang byams sems can mi 'dug snyam gyi 'dug la/ yang skabs rer de las ldog ste sod mi tsho las brtsedung mi brtan mkhan dang gdug rtsub can mi 'dug snyam gyi 'duga'adi don dngos kyang yin/des na ngas khyed tshor 'dri/ khyed tshos bsam na brtsedung ldan pa'i mi ni ci lta bu zhig red/ thog mtha' bar gsum du 'gyur med rtag brtan zhig red dam/ pha rol bo'i brtsedung dang 'tsho ba/ 'dod 'dun bcas la bsam shes thub pa'i brtsedung can zhig red dam/ yang na rang gi brtsedung gi ched du gzhan la sdu ga bsngal spyod mkhan zhig red/ de yang min na rang 'dod tsha ba'i brtseb 'chang mkhan zhig red/ gang ltar yang nga tshos brtse dung ngo ma'i go don rnyed dgos la brtse dung ldan pa'i mi rnams kyi bya bzhag kyang ngos zin dgos/ de lta ra byung na rjes phyogs kyi nga tsho'i 'tsho ba la bkrag mdangs rnam par bkra zhing / bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'phang ba'i ram 'degs thob par ngas khag theg byed chog dper na/ nga bud med cig la dga' zhing brtseb por ba'i mi zhig yin par chag bzhag ceteg yin na'ang / stabs ma legs pa zhig la khetho resnas nga'i brtseb dang len mi byed pa'i thog sngar nas dga' rogs bsgogs zin pa ste/ dus nam yang khesto mo'i sems steng na yal ba med pa'i skyes pa gzhan zhichen gi grib gzugs ldan tshe/ngas kho mo nga la 'thob ched du kho mo'i brtsedung dang bde skyid phrogs te/ nga'i bde skyid dang nga'i brtsedung la 'od mdangs smon dgos sam/ nga'i brtsedung 'a/ bkrag mdangs med kyang

46 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/kho mo'i brtsedung la brtsi'agrog dang kho mo'i bde skyid la brtsi bkur bya dgos sam/gal srid da lta'i nga'i bsam pa ltar byas cha ngas don dag gzhug ma de gdam gi yin la/ de ltar byed dgos pa'i dmigs 'dun ni nga kho mor dga' zhing dung ba rnam dag yin na'ang / kho mo nga kho nar dbang dgosi pa 'i rgyu mtshan bgrang rgyu ma yin pad gtso po kho mo'i gzhug phyogs kyi 'tsho bar skyes pa bzang so zhig gis 'gan len byas thog skyes nga de ni kho mo'i lhad nad dwangs gtsang gi sems pa bcol sa dang tshe 'ode'i rgyab rten byed sa nyan tshe/ ngas mu mthud de khong gnyis kyi khyim tshang la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang bkra shis lo legs 'phang ba'i smon 'dun zhu 'os pa zhig red/ nga kho ra/ra dga' stabs kho mo bde zhing skyid na de ni nga'i bde skyid yin 'os la/ kho mo dga' zhing spyo na de ni nga'i dga' spyo yang ci la yin mi 'os/brtse dung zer ba ni pha ma dang bu phrug sgo phyugs dang bdag po/ rang byutshong khor lug dang mi/ khyo ga dang chung ma sesgogs kyi bar na grib gzugs med par rgyu bzhin pa'i sems 'gyu zhig red/ lhag par du rnam dag gi brtse dung zer ba ni rang nyid gang la sems chags shing dung ba sgosnar sa der gces sems ldan pa dang / do snang ldan pa / dus yun skad cig tsam la'ang kha 'bral 'dod mi skye ba bcas red/ yin na'ang / thal che ba'i brtse dung dang btang snyoms ma 'grig pa'i brtse dung ni phal che ba bza' zla'i bar nas phyi la mngon yong /de ni phan tshun do snang byed stangs mi 'dra ba dang brtse ba spyod stangs mi 'dra ba sogs las 'byung gi yod/nga tsho stes pho mo rgan gzhon su yin rung rang rang gi sems phyosnar sa de rang nyid la 'thob chedardo ga' sdug rgyag gi red/ gal srid skyes pa zhig bud med cig la dga'

brtse dung ldan pa'i mi'i bya spyod ngo ma ci lta bu zhig yin nam/ 47ba'i dbang du btang na bud med der kha par dang 'phrin yig mi gzhan bcas brgyud de 'grel lam byed cing / gtso sa bud med de nges par du rang 'a/ 'thob dgos pa'i bsam tshul shugs cher 'dzin pa red/ skabs 'dir nga tsho la dpe mtshon mi sna gal chen zhig yod pa ni brtse dung gi rgyal sras sam/ mi 'gyur gangs phrug lags red/ khong ni padma mtshor brtse ba bor ba'i mi zhig yin pa kun gyis shes gsal red la/ padma mtsho 'thob ched 'phrin yig so bdun can gyi ( brtsedung gi a long las sgo(ra ba'i sems 'phrin dmar 'o/ ) dang ( brtse dung/ mi rkyang ri la chas pa'i gtam rgyud/ ) ( rnam shes kyi brtse dung / ) sogs brtsams par ma zad/ thengs 'gar rang srog kyang gcod grabs byas pa de red/ khong padma mtshor dga' zhing dung ba lhag bsam rnam dag yin la/ padma mtsho'i ched du dka' khag dang bzod par ngaka' ba'i mnar sdug gang 'dra zhig myong dgos kyang 'gyod snang skye gi med/ ngas khong ni rang gi brtsedung gi ched du dka' sdug 'a/ mgo bo mi sgu ra ba'i me rlabs chen zhig red snyam/ yin na'ang / de ni khong gi zur ngos gcig de red/ zur ngos gzhan de ni khong gis rang shi rgyag rtsis byas pa de red/ de lta bu'i bya spyod rigs rang 'dod tsha ba'i brtse ba 'chang mkhan dang pha rol po'i khe dbang dang thag gcod la brtsibakur mi byed pa'i mi'i bya spyod red/khong la mtshon nas bshad na padma mtsho'i ched du rang nyid 'chi thub kyang / rang nyid shi rjes kyi padma mtsho'i bde sdug la khag theg gang yang byas med/ der brten rang gi brtse dung dang rang gi bde skyid/ rang gi 'byung 'gyur dang rang 'dod tsha ba'i 'dod 'dun 'grub ched du gzhan zhig sdug la ma gtod/ ma mthar yang khyedad dang mnyam 'grethogs mnyam 'dug gi 'dod 'dun med pa'i mi zhig don med du sdug la mi gtad rgyu ni nga tshos sems la legs par nyar 'os/

brtse dung ldan pa'i mi'i bya spyod ngo ma ci lta bu zhig yin nam/ 49kun dga' ba'i gtam/na4 tshog spyo1toho na she 'os /haslo nga byaha 73 myong lkol : 37myong rdzo 7na ho dzo tshog rpā〉 〉tsho tshon3 tshoha 'o moṅgā 57yo rdzos rang dzo tsho gadzo 'kho snyoṅgā skye rte pho lo 3 byedzo yo rdzo dzog he pholo 'gan hang long bza zla tsang dzo 0bye tshoha skya 'tsho sme/ rmang ha/ gyen pa'ang gtsod ha lo tsa ( tsho
