50 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams /'jig rten pa'i gtam rgyud/dran 'gyu dzog ma/dngos yo/da spyi tshogs 'tsho sdod pa zhig gi ngos nas bsam na ngas ci'i phyir nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bya bzhag dang / bsam bya mtha' dag phyi gsal nang gsal mi byed par las don bzang bo dag phyi ru ngom pa tsam dang / gtam yag ngo kho na kha nas gleng dgos byung ba yin nam/ gal srid ngas rang nyid mal las yar langs pa nas slar yang gnyid ma 'ostog pa'i bar gyi sems 'gyu mtha' dag la bgo bya thengs shig brgyab tshe brgya cha'i ci tsam gyis bzang phyogs zin pa dang / ci tsam gyis ngan phyogs 'dzin thub min shes thabs bral yang / brgya cha'i mang che bas bud med dran zhing 'khrul ba dang smon nga /gdung ba sogs byung yod/ 'di ni ngas rang nyid la dpe blangs nas brjod kyin yod mod/don dngos thog rgan gzhon dang po mo khyad med du myong bzhin pa'i dngos yod spri tshogs 'tsho ba'i snying so yin la/ g.yol thabs bral ba'i lusar ba'i rang bzhin yang khyo la min/yin na'ang / nub phyogs pa dang shar phyogs pa rnams bsdur nas bltas na shar phyogs pa rnams da dung lkog gyur rang bzhin can dang gsang ba rang bzhin can gyi brtse dung lu rol mkhan dang / skyes bu gsum pa zhig gis mthong thos mi 'ong ba'i 'jig rten gyi bya bar 'jug mkhan tsam las sems nang gi gsang ba phyi ru mi mngon pa ma zad/ gzhan

'jig rten pa'i gtam rgyud/ 5/gyis shes 'gro bar dogs son nan mo byed pa de red/ nub phyogs pa'i ngos nas langeg rten gyi rdzo mo zung 'khrig spyod kyi bya bar 'jug nga/ ni nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi grub cha gal chen zhig red la/ de la 'dzem dogs byed mi dgos pa ma zad nyin dang mtshan/ phyi lo ga dang nang 'ostog tha na srang lam dang bzhi mdo sdusgogs su khyad med du bya ba der 'jug rkyang byed pa de red/ lta 'on kyang / nub phyogs pa yod tshad 'ode ltar min/ ) 'di ni nub phyogs pa'i ngos nas gleng na sngon thon can gyi bsam blo zhig tu rtsibazhin mthod sgo dang / khrims lugs kyi bkag rgya de tsam med pa ra gleng /gang ltar ngas ci'i phyir nga tsho rigar phyogs pa rnams kyis chags sred kyi sems dang bsam pa phyi ru mi mngon pa dang / 'khrig spyoted ni nges pa/ra du lkog gyur gyi bya ba zhig 'a brtsi dgos byung ba yin nam snyam/ gal srid de ltar byed nga ni ya rabs kyi spyod pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed na ni sems de yang lhag bsam zol med du ya rabs spyod bzang gi rjes/ snyeg mkhan zhig yin dberwa5 re da/ de ni ha cang gi rjod thabs bral ba zhig red/sems nang du chags sred kyi pe lce 'bar na'ang kha nas du ba tsam yang thon mi 'ong ba ni dgod bro bo'i gtam rgyud ca ma las ya rabs kyi ཿ sgod pa zhig tu bgrang thabs ga la krerdzod/yin na'ang / skabs 'dir slebs dus mang bo zhig gis sems nang ngas de ltar brjod dus nga tshos pha ma ming sring dang / a pha a khu tshun chad la'ang ngo tsha dang 'dzem byon med par dus nam zhig la/ sa gnas gang zhig nas/ 'khrig srid nam rgyas na de dus sakhig pa sgod par 'thad pa zhig 'chad kyin pa'i snang ba 'char srid/ de lta bu'i bod mi rigs kyi4 ya rabs bzang :thod kyi dri mi bro ba'i lta ba dang spyod pa'ang bdag gis skyong gi med/ des na don ngo mar ngas ci zhig 'chad kyin 'byud zer na/ gsar bu gsar mo

52 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/tshos phan tshun la sems bsam pa'i skad cha drang por mi bshad pa dang glo rgyu ma'i 'gyu ba ngo ma de mi ston pa der bshad kyin yod/ nga tsho bod rigs bud med tsho dpe blangs nas bshad chog khyed tshos blo rnal du phobs la bsam blo yag ngo/ zhig thongs dang / nga tsho'i bod rigs bud sped rnams chags bral ba dang 'khrig spyoted kyi 'dun pa gtan 'gag tu song zin pa rkyang red dam/ nga tsho skyes nga tshos khong tshor dus rgyun btsan tshugs dang dbang shed kyis spyod kyin pa las khong tsho'e ngos nas 'di la dga' snang dang sems 'dun med dam/ de las kyang kha gsal zhing bosto bde ba'i dpe zhig blangs te bdagad na/ chang sa brgyab med pa'i bod rigs bud med cig la dpe blangs te/ kho pos gzugs stobs rgyas shing dang 'a rtsal 'dzoms pa'i stag shar zhig la sems 3(ra 'phad par chag zhog kho mothos sems nang stag shar der re ba chen po med na'ang sems nang nam rgyun nas kherdzos kho por zhakhrig pa lan zhig spyad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i blo zhig yod na/ bud med des rang ge sems 'gyu ce bzhin skyes pa der lab sod dam/ ngas bsam na phod kyi ma red/nga tshos 'khrig pa sbyad zer dus nges pa ra du bza' zla gnyis kyi phan nas mi chog pa red dam/ yang na mi tshang mas bsam blo'i nang rang gi bza' zla'i phan nas gzhan su dang mnyam du 'khrig pa spyoted pa'i blo med pa yin nam/ gal srid de ltar yin na 'jig rten gyi mi thams cad ji 'dra'i blo gcig sems gcig can dang gcig la gcig brten gyi bsam blo can zhig red ang / yin na'ang / mdzub mo nang du bkug nas rang nyid la dri ba re dris na/ nga tsho'i nang du tshe gcig lus gcig la rang gi chung ma'i pha na nas 'khrig pa spyod spe 'dod mkhan dang rang gi khyo ga'i phan nas skyes pa su gcig la'ang dga' mi srid pa'i bud med ga tshod yod ang /spyir chung ma blangs tshar ba'i skyes pa dang gnyen sgrig zin pa 'i bud med su yin rung bkag rgya zhig tu tshud tshar ba red/ des na bza' 'thor byung ba

bdag dang bud med bar gyi gsang ba/ 53dang chang sa ma brgyab mkhan tshor ji lta ra 'grel/ de ltar nga tshos rang rang gi sems 'gyu ngo ma de phyi la ston gyi med pa der bshad pa yin/bdag dang dud med bar gyi gsang ba/nga'i ngos nas bshad na bud med ni nga'i nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kye grub cha gal chen zhig red la/ bud chad kyi gzugs byad dang brang gzhung / 'phong mgo sogs ni nga'i mig gi longs spyoted mchog tu gyur pa sha stag red/ sngar mthong myong yod med gang ltar 'a/nga bud med cig la gzugs byad mdzes shing 'dzum mdangs mophal ba/ 'o 'dzin zlum zhing sha mdangs dkar ba/ 'phong mgo chen po bcas ldan tshe nga la yang yang lta 'dod kyi 'dun pa 'gog med du ster zhing / go skabs re rnyed na gleng mol byed nga/'i thabs la'ang 'bad pa yin/ ma zad ngas bud med kyi bde drod la rol myong byed thengs rer ched du bud med kyi 'dod 'dun cha tshang skor bar 'bad nga yin la/ de las kyang bud med kyi gsang ba re brtol bar nus shugs bton pa yin/ sngar 'phra da ma myong ba'i bud med gsar ba rer 'phrad skabs dang bud med tshor spyodad stangs ma 'dra ba re spad tshe nyams rgyudang gsar ba re gse ga rgyu 'dug de ni mkhas dbang dge 'dun :rdzos 'jel maceteg gi 'dod bsta na 〈snag pa sto zhig gi ngoXm nas gleng na nyams len lta bu zhig red la/ rang nyid kyi ngo1sa nas ba zhad na bud med kyi gsang ba re brtol e thub la 'bad rgyu ni nga'i dmigs bya gal chen zhig kyang yin/spyir bud ched kyi chags pa skye sa pa las langs dka' ba dang 'khrig bde rdzogs

54 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams nga ra dus yun ring so dgos pa ma zad/ zhakhrig spyod kyi snga gzhug kun tu gleng mol byed nga dang / snying gtam bar med du bshad rgyu ni bud med dang nyal bo bsten mkhan gyi skyes nga tshos sems 'a/ nges dbothos pa'i gnad don zhig red/ bud med dang skyes pa sems tshor rno min dang 'phrad phugs bsam min gyi dbang gis gong gi don dag de dag gal chen du gyur ba yin/ bud med tshor ci'i phyir skyes pa tshos bud med longs su spyod dgos na'ang bud sped kyi bde ba mi sems pa ra snang med byed pa dang / rang nyid kyi bde ba rdzogs pa na bud sped la mun snang ba byungari ba yin nam snya ma ri /'i sems tshor rab tu rno ya/nga / de ni rang las gzhan mi gtso zhing gnas lugs dang don dngos la mi dargya thod pa'i skyes pa re 'gas tha shal gyi bya sbyod tsam du zad/ gang ltar yang bud med rnams ni lus kyi 'brel ba tsam dang saspreg spyod kyi bde ba kho nar mi sems par skyes pa/ las ring du brgal te/ rang 'a/ tshe gang bde skyid skru na zhing / dus kun byams skyong byed mkhan zheg dang thug na da gzod 'khreg pa 'i bya bar 'jug rgyur dga' mkhan mang zhing / khong tsho'i sems dang 'dres pa 'i chags nga/ ha cang gting zab pa'i dbang gis langs cermeg 〈snag dang yal lcesgrog :snag med nga ra nges par du rgyu na bsring dgose pa yin/ 'khrig :thod rgyun ring bo byed thub mkhan gyi skyes pa dang / bud med la do snang che zhing sems khams 'a/ brtag mkhas pa'i skyes pa rnams ni bud med kyis ches dga' mos byed pa 'i rigs red ces brjod chog rgyu ma tshan 'de'i dbang gis na gzhon rtsom nga bo shes rab dar rgyas mchog gis ( pho mtho'i las kyi gsang ba dang 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi bde ba/ ) zhes pa'i rtsom yig de'i mgo mjug bar gsum tshang mar bud med dang 'khrig ྅ sgod brten mkhan gyi skyes pa dag gis nges dgos pa'i gnad don gang mang zhig 'grel dgos byung yod/gal srid bud med kyi sems gshis la rgyus mnga' zhan pa'i skyes pa zhig gis

bdag dang bud med bar gyi gsang ba/ 55'khrig thabs kho nar brten nas bud med la bde ba 'thob 'jug dgos snya ma na de mi ha lam spe srid de/ bud med kyi lusag bde rdzogs par mtshan ma 'don 'jug gi bya ba tsam gyis mi 'ong ba'i gnad don shes dgose shing / sems gshis dang 'brel nas bud med kyi tshor ba mtha' dag ngos zen pa byed dgose/ de ya nga mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phe 2 gyis 'khrig pa myur ba'i chung ma 'otho gsum byas/ /chags pa'i bde ba thengs gceg ma 〈snang zer/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin ngas grerdzogs posna zhig gi sa nas gzhan gyi chung ma byas nas 'byu gsum bzhi lhag 'besnar zhing / byis pa'ang btsas tshar ba'i bud med cig gis de ltar brjod myong ba thos shing / kho pos bshad na zhakhrig spyod byed pa ne khyo ga'i re 'a dun skyong ched tsam las de la sun snang che tshul zer/ 'di lta ra bsam zheng zhib tu da sga da na bud tshed ci 'dra'i mang so zhig gis mi 'dod bzhin du khyo ga dang lhan du bya ba 'der 'jug dgos byung ba dang / mi 'dod bzhin du 'khrig bde ma rdzogs pa 'i sdug bsngal myong gi med dam snyam/ yin yang / bud med kye nang du'ang skyes pa'i 'dod 'dun cha chang skong thub mkhan dang mi thub mkhan gnyis ka yod/ dper na/ skyes pa 'i dgos 'dun gtsor bzung gis bya ba byed mkhan dang / sid sgra 'byin pa/ sdom btsur la mkhas pa'i bud med rnams ni skyes pa tshor 'khrig bde ldo da par ster nus pa'i bud med rigs red 'a// phan tshun dogs mi dgos pa'i skyes pa dag 'dzoms sar 'di lta bu'i gtam gleng byed mkhan shin tu mang / bud med dang skyes pa su yin yang nyams myong yod med kyi rnya bas kyis/'khrig pa'i skabs su bde ba spyod thub min skusgod la/ bud med gzhon nu ma las rgan nga dag gis bde ba dmigs bsal ba re nyer nus sheng / 'khrig thabs gang 'dra zhig sprad kyang gros kha mthun pa dang / lus sems gnyis lhod por yong ba sogs khyad chos rdo dme chang 〈snad/ rgyu mtshan 'de'i dbang gis skyes pa tshos bud med gzhon nu ma las rgan nga

56 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ yaṃ/ rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/dag la sgod rgyur dga' zhing / re zung gis ched du bud sped rgan par chang sa rgyag de ni bud cherdo dang skyes pa su yin yang / rang las lo rgan par chang sa rgyag don nee rang nyid 'a gces skyong byed pa dang / rnam dag gi brtseb thob cing / sgo'i phyi khyim gyi 'a/sa 'gan 'a/ dmigs bsal gyis sems khral byed mi dgose pa sdu gas kyis red la/ skyes pa me nyung ba zhig gis rgyun du gleng mol byed sar bud med rgan nga dag dang mnyam du chang sa rgyag pa ni nyakhrig pa'i skabs su bde ba khyad par ba re 'byung rgyu yod pas yin zer/yang bud med lo na sum cu brgal ba'i bud med cig gis bdag la 'di ltar brjod myong / ngas da lta'i bar du rang las lo na mtho ba'i skyes pa zhig khyo gar reg rgyur 'bad kyang ma reg pas da lta'i khyo ga ( ming nas sos te/ ) 'di dang chang sa mi rgyag ka med byung / rang las rgan pa yin tshe sdudags mang so zhig 'a/ blta sa 'dug la/ lhag par du khyem tshang gi 'gan de tsam 'khur mi dgos pa ma zad/ byams skyong chad med thob kyi red zer/ don 'di la bsam na'ang bud med dang skyes pa su yin yang rang las lo na mtho ba dag la chang sa rgyag pa'i dmigs 'dun pal cher gcig tu nges/ 'on kyang / skyes pa rnams khyad chose rgyag rgyur dga' zhing rang gi chung ma'i 5/ga mo sgo dang g.yug las ka gzhan la ngom rgyu ra de bas kyang dga' ba ma zad/ bud med ltar phugs la mi sems pa/ra meg mdun dang kha ru kha thug gi thag gcod la dga' sta bas/ skyes pa tshos chung ma rang las/ lo rgan pa dang rnam nga med mkhan dag la chang sa rgyag rgyu'i 'dod pa de tsam mi byed nga sa/ skyes pa'i nang du bud med rgas lubogs mnyam du chang sa brgyabs pa'i rigs ha cang dkon par gyur yo/da/de min 'dod pa'i bstan bcos dag tu 'khrig thabs grangs/ las 'das pa bshad

bdag dang bud med bar gyi gsang ba/ 57pa dang dge chos kyis drug cu rtsabazhi yod par drangs mod/ stod kyi yul gru phal mo cher bud med kun rkyal du nyal te skyes pas steng nas spyod pa'i lugs 'di shugs cher sbyod rngu las/ langs nas spyebyud pa dang / tsog bur spyoted pa/ rgyab nas spyodad pa/ mabosna mjug ldog nas sperdzod pa 〈snags kyi ྅sned thabs 'di'i rigs sperdzod mkhan nyung khar mtshams mtshams las threngad kyi med/ de bas kyang skyes pa gcig sgos bud nad 'gar dus gcig la sgod pa dang / skyes pa gnyis gyes bud med gcig la mnyam du sgod pa/ khyi rta bya sogs la sgrod pa 'i lugs 'di'i rigs da lta'i char phyi gling bas ma gto/sa sgod kyi med mod/ rtsol rgyun gye gtam rgyud cig tu bla rgan zhig gis rbesnad ma zhig la sparsha pa dge phrug gis mthong nas sto(ga nas tredzed ma'i stu la mer sreg cig byas bzhag pas4/ bla rgan gyis nam rgyun rnya ra rgod mar :sgod par brtsams pas rgod mas bla rgan la 'phra yis gzhus skor zhig dang / de dang 'dra bar skyes pa zhig khyi la spya da pa sogs kyi gtam chung dus nas rna thos yod pas/ bshad tshul 'de 'drar brtag skabs mngon du ma gyur ba tsam las bod sri tshogs la yang rta khyir sbyod mkhan snga mo nas yod par snang / 4gang ltar deng gi dus rabs nyer gcig ste shar nub kyi yul gru kun tu phyogs gang thad nas he bag ha cang che zhing / 'khrig spyod kyi bya ba bye da pa'i thad du de bas kyang bar khyad che bas bod me tsho da dung mi tshe gcig la 'khrig thabs gcig las spyoted ma myong mkhan dang / gcig de yang 'dom gnyis lhan du sbyongar ba tsam dang mchu gnyis mnyam du sgror ba tsam las lus kyi gon pa cha tshang phud nas :snad ma myong mkhan yang mang zheng /de'i rigs pha la che ba gnam gshis ha cang 'khyag pa'i mtsho bod mtho sgang gi 'brog phyogs pa rnams yin nges/ de min gnyig spyod ni skyes pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mas longs su spyod rung ba'i ches mchog tu gyur ba'i longs spyod cig red la/ 'jig rten du 'tsho ba'i snying

58 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/bo dang / 'gro ba mi'i rigs skye 'phe la gyi gzhi mayang yin/ pho mo phan tshun 'dzum cam byed pa yang / /legs par bsam na 'khrig pa'i don yin pa sa/ /zhes dge chaso mchesgog gis pho motho phan tshun 'dzum tsam byed pa yang legs par bsam na 'khrig pa'i ched yin gsungs pa ltar/ mdor bsdus na rgan mgo dkar nas gzhon so dkar tshun chad 'khrig spyod la mi dga' mkhan phal cher med la/ ngo tsha'i dar kha tsam gyis bsgrub pa ste/ /cung zad 'bad na rang zhal rjen pa ra ston/ /gsungs pa/ las ma 'das par snang ngo / /'khrig spyod kyi gal chen rang bzhin gling ba/lo mang bo'i sngon zhig nas nga'i grogs pos khyod lta ba mkhregs ki zer myong / de yang bden pa red/ ngas rang nyid la dang ba 'drin zhing 'dod mos yod pa'i las shig yin tshad rang nyid kyis thag bcad ceng / phyir nur gtan nas byed ma myong / da lta phyir 'dang zhig brgyab na ngas ma gcig bu gcig gi khyim shul ma bskyangs pa dang /dren ma lo'i meg mtha' mchi mas khengs nas gsungs pa'i re bzhag la ma nyan par sa mthar 'grims pa'i blo thag rang gis bcad cing / chung byis dus nas zhing bo bka' drin can dang lo lon tshos re bzhag dang yid ches kyis rgyab 'a/ bskon pa'i grwa chas rgyab nas phud pa/ mi 〈sna du ma'i ring tshogs dang chos grwar 'grims sa'i dgon sde grwa tshang dang kha gyes nga// lasdon na mi lasan na smyu gu bzung ste snyan ngag thar thor re bris pa dang rang nyid kyi lta ba yin zer nas dus rgyun klog nga bo tsho'i rna ba sun sun dang mig tsha tsha'i bar du cig bris bsdad bsda da

'khrig spyod kyi gal chen rang bzhin gleng ba/ 59ngo thams cad/ nga rang nyid kyi 'dod pa dang mos pa yin pa las gzhan gyis brgyud skul byas nga/ min la/ 'di lta bu'i lam bu bdams dus gzhan gyis bkag 'besgog dang gnon shugs mi nyung ba zhig spra da na'ang mgo po sgu ra myong med/de ltar deng skabs ngas rang nyid spyi tshogs 'di'i ches kha thag nye sa nas yar 'grengs te rang gi sems gshis dang 'brel nas rtsom yig 'bri rgyur 'bad brtson byed ba zhin yod la/ 'di lta bu'i langs phyogs shig gi 'og nas nga rang nam yang phyir nur gtan nas byed sred kye ma red/ dper na 'od dus deb spye tshogs khrod slebs pa nas nga la re ba gsar ba zhig skyes shing / dus deb 'di nga tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi kha thag nye sar bcar nas pe long dngos shig ge snang brnyan bskrun rgyur re ba rnyed/ der brten 'jig rten nga 'e gtam rgyud ces pa'i gzeg sgod skor gyi rtsom yig de bris sheng / de'i nang du shar phyogs dang nub phyogs kyi 'khergo pyod byed stangs skor la rang blos dpog tshod kyis da sru/da khul byas nga ma zad/ rang steng gi myong ba kha shas shig kyang klog pa bo tshor spro snang phren phyir ngo tsha rgyab la g.yug nas 'bri khul bya sa/ de ni 'od dus deb spye/ tshogs khrod slebs nas ngo lo gnyis las phyin med pa'i skabs 'dir rtsom yig de lta bu zhig bris na bod yig zer dus mgo na mkhan gye klog pa bo gcig gnyis shig yin rung rnyed na ci ma rung snyams pas de ltar bres pa zhig yin/kha sang de ring nga'i grogs po 'gas brjod na rtsom yig der gleng slong 'dra min sna tshogs shig byed gyen 'dug la/ lhag par du rtsom yig de btsog bshad rkyang rkyang red/yag po mi 'dug zer mkhan yang mang bo 'dug zer/ spyir nga tshos btsog las byed rgyur mi 'dzem par ngas btsog bshad byed rgyur 'dzem don gang yang mi 'dug nga 'di lta bu'i skad char nyan rgyu dang bshad rgyur dga' la/ 'di lta bu'i rtsom yig klog rgyu dang 'bri rgyur

60 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/yang dga'/ 'di nga'i dga' phyogs sheg red/ gal sred khyed rang rab tu byung ba'i ser mo ba zhig gam/ nyon mongs dug gsum spangs char ba'i skyes chen dam nga zhig yang na those bsam sgom sgrub mdzad kyin pa'i bla ma rnam dag cig yin tshe thugs dkrugs na dgongs dag zhu rgyu dang / ngas 'di nas mu mthud de 'bri bar bya'ang khyim nga/ pho mo tsho'i gtam rgyud yin pas mu mthud de bklag bya ma yin/de min khyim pa pho mo tshos 'di bklags nas yag gi zer yang chog la bcog gi zer yang chog gang ltar nga tshos byed kyin pa zheg las ma byas pa zhig ngas bshad kyin med la/ bshad kyang mi shes/ rang nyid rang la lkog tu ma gyur stabs gsang ba byed mi dgose pa'i gsang ba zhig gsang bas kyang ci byed/ bza' zla bsgrigs nas phru gu skyed bsring dgos na 'khrig :snad ma brten nga ra bya ba 'di 'grub thabs med pas 'di gal chen du brtsidagos par 'dod/ langeg rten gyi gnad don yod tshad 'dis thag gcod kyi yod lab na thal drags srid mod/ ngas de ltar 'dod kyin yod/nga'i pha ma gnyis kyis 'khreg spyodad brten med na de ring ge rtsom yig 'bri ba bo nga yang yod mi srid la/ khyed kyi pha mas khyed rang bskyed med na de ring gi rtsom yig klog pa so khyed kyang gang nas yong / khyed rang zhakhrig spyo da la mi dga' mkhan zhig yin nga 'i dbang du btang rung khyed kyi pha ma gnyis kyis khyod skrun byed kyi rgyu gzeg spyod kyi sa bon med na khyed rang ji ltar bskyed/rgyal khab dang rgyal khab bar bud med cig brtsad nas 'byu mang ring dmag 'khrug drag ngo byas shing / de lta bu'i 'thab 'dzing byas byas mthar rgyal bo'i rgyal srid shor/'bangs kyi bde skyed brlag pa'i rgyal rabs bgrang gis mi lang pa 'dug la/ rgya'/ bo

'khrig spyod kyi gal chen rang bzhin gleng ba/ 6/'di dang gan la btsun mo stong yod tshul/ de dang 'di la btsun mo brgya yod tshul/ tha na ma pu hphang gis kyang snang ba song tshun dang mig gis mthong tshad yan chad bdag tu bzung myong ba'i bod rigs bud med mang dag cig 〈snad pa'ang / rgyal rabs 'o( rgyus bklag mi dgos par bod sa ma byusgor gong gi mi zhig yin na shes nges red/ 'di yod tshad 'khrig spyod don du gnyer ba sha stag red la/ btsun mo stong yod pas dmag rgyag sar dmag go mi chod cing / btsun mo brgya snangad pas rgyal srid mnga' thang rgyas pa'i nges pa'ang med/ nga tshos mig gis don dngos la bltas nas/ rna bas don dngos la nyan nas/ lus kyis don dngos byed kyin yod na'ang mi zhig gis don dngos gleng dus khas mi len pa dang / don dngos lkog nas byed pa/ don dngos khog tu sbas pa sogs dngos gnas byas na byed stangs ma shes pa zhig las ci yang ma red/dgong mo bud med cig dang mnyam du mar nyal te 'khrig spyod yag thag chod cig byas rjes/ phyi nyin mi zhig gis 'khrig god skor gyi gtam sgreng byed dus mig 'bur 'thur dang / rna ba krong krong byas nas skad zlo bcog po ma bshad zer ba lta bu ni ha cang blo ngor sgo nga dka' ba zhig red/ mi 'di tsho 'khrig spyod bcog por mthong mkhan zhig red zer na kho rang nyid kyis brten bya bud med red la/ tshom red zer na skad cha yin mdog kha sa zhig bshad rgyu 'dug mi phar zhog srang bar gyi khyi rgan tshos kyang khyi mo re brtsad nas 'thab 'dzing drag po byed cing / lus la rma 'byin na'ang da dung shi gson la kha ya mi byed nga ra khyi mo de reg thabs byed pa lta bu'i srog chags 'khrig spyoted kyi ltad mo ji 'dra'i mang so zhig mthong rgyu 'dug de bzhin du phyi gling ba tshos srog chags 'khrig sperdzod 〈snags ltad po mang bor lta chog cing / dngos yod la dpyad pa byas chog 4

62 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/nga tsho tshang ma mnga' thang rgyas sheng longs spyoted phun sum tshogs par gyur na bud med mang sar chung mar ming du 'bod la/ tha na ja kha chang kha yan chad nas bud med kyi bde grol la rol myong byed kho thag yin/ tshong ba 'di dang gan 'a/ chung ma drug yod tshul/ dang bla ma gan dang 'di la rig ma lnga yod tshul bshad rgyu yod pa'ang / mi su yin rung rgyu yod cing dka' sdug nad na de'i phan na bsam bya zhig yod nga bud med dang bsgrub bya 'khrig spyod yin pas red/gang ltar yang gakhreg spyod kyi dpyad brjod rtsom yig 'bri rgyu 'ode dza'i dga' phyogs sheg red la/ zhakhrig sgod kyi las byed rgyutsho ni nga tsho tshang ma'e dga' phyogs shig yin stabs/ 'di lta ra gleng brjo btsog bshad red zer mkhan tshor ci zhig bshad 'dod kyang bshad du chugs/ ngas dus deb dang tshags sgo(ga gang 'dra zhig yin yang de'i kha phyogs la bstun nas rtsom yig 'bri bzhin yod la/ klog pa so'i mos nga la bstun te gleng slong 'tshol gyin skuthod pas/ brgya tham pa'i nang nas gcig gi 'dod pa bskang ma thub kyang blo 'aspyodad gtan nas med do/ /mchan/ gong gi rtsom yig 'di 'od spyi tshogs dus deb steng bkod pa'i ( 'jig rten pa'i gtam rgyud/ ) las zur 'don byas shing / thengs 'dir bzo bcos kyang gang 'tsham byas yod/

'khrig spyod kyi gan chen rang bzhin gleng ba/ 63'khrig pa'i skabs kyi gtam lnga(ra bu ma/khyed tshos rtsom yig 'di ma bklag pa'i sngon 'dir thog mar rang nyid la dri ba zhig dris dang / khyed rang bud med tsho'i lus steng gi dbang bo gang zhig la dga'/ yang na dbang bo'i che chung dang dbyibs ci lta bur dga'/ ngas bsam na mi tshang mar rang nyid kyi dga' phyogs re yod rgyu red la/ nga tshos phan tshun la rang rang ge dga' phyogs kun sba gsang med par bsidad thub tshe skyes pa pho tsho'i sems khams dmar rjen pa dag kyang bud ped tshos mthong bar las sla ru song yod/gang ltar yang / ngas khyed cag la nga'i dga' phyogs 'ga' bshawa chog dper na/nga bud med mdzes mar dga'/ gdong snying rje 'o dang skyes gzugs mdzes sdug ldan pa/mig gis blta sa nga tsam gyis mdzes ma yin na dngos gnas dga' mod/ mig la mdzes pa tsam gyis 'khrig rgyo da kyi skabs su khyod la bde skyed spyod thub min ni gtan nas bshad tshod dka' ba zhig yin/ bud med re zung phyi bltas ji lta ra mdzes shing lta na sdug na'ang 'khrig pa'i skabs su lus la me zhim pa'i dri 'thil zhing / lus kye reg bya rtsub pa/'khrig rtsal med tshe khyod kyi mig gis bltas nas dga' sa de lus kyis myong dus bu da med gzhan zheg tu gyur zin nga/ yin/

64 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/des na nga ni brang gi myo bum chen po yin pa'i bud med la dga'/ yin na'ang /bud med re zung nyin dkar yar langs nas 'gro dus brang gi myos bum che zhing zlum la snying rje ba zhig yin na'ang / mtshan re 'khrig pa'i skabs su bud med de 'og tu kha yar 'a9ter nas nyal ba na tshungs bum chen ngo rwade brang gzhung hrel bo ra khyab pa'am/ 〈snas bum gyi rtsab che zhing rtse tsete chung stabs lag pas 'chang skabs lhug lhug byed pa ma gtogs 〈snas bum cig la lag pa 'chang gi yod pa'i tshor snang de tsam/ mi snye ra/ de'i stabs kyis nga bud med kyi rtsab chung zheng rtse mo che ba ma zad cung tsam mkhregs tshopa'i myo sa bum la dga' zhing / de ni dkar yod ltar zhabs zlum na'ang rtse che la kha yangs pas yar langs kyang rung la/ mar nyal yang :thog gang lta ra yang case bum gyi bzo lta nam rgyun gcig tu nges pas de lta bu la dga'/ yang myodu bum che drags na mig la mdzes nga/ las lag pas 'chang skabs cung tsam chung zheng zlum sto yin tshe lhag nga/ra du dga'/ de bzhin bud med re 'ga'i myos bum brang gzhung ge cung tsam dma' sar yod pas de la'ang mi dga'/ gang ltar bud med kyi myos bum ni skyes pa tshor ga dus yin na'ang gal 'gangs che shesi shig red 'a dmigs bsal gyis gzhig pa'i skabs su gal chen po yin pa ma zad/ bud med rang gi rgyan cha zheg kyang red/nga la bud med mang sos 'de ltar/ /khyod tsho skyes nga/ tsho bud med kyi myos bum la dga' ba red zer ba bden nam/ zhes dris yong la/ myos bum chen ngo yod pa'i bud med skor zhig gi sems nang rang nyid la myos bum chen po yo/da pas skyes pa tshos dga' mos byed ki red bsam pa'i skyid snang gis khengs 'dugade bzhin bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag dag tu bud med la sked med mar 'bod pa

'khrig pa'i skabs kyi gtam thor bu ma/ 63 rnya ra bud med kye sked nga phra zhing lus kyi sha 'jam na lhag par du dga'/ bud med kha shas chang lag sgom ngo can dang lus rgyag cing ril la sked pa tshil lugs kyes khengs nga ma zad/ la༄ma sha de tsam med pa ra skyes pa ltar sha mkhregs po yin nga sa/ lag pas reg skabs skyes pa zhig la lag pas 'chang ba las bud med cig la 'chang ba'i tshor ba de cam mi ster bas na de cam mi dga'/ lag pas myang ba tsam gyis sked pa phra ba tshor thub cing sha 'jam rgyu ni 'khrig pa'i skabs dang nam rgyun nas gal che sgosgos shig kyang red/ de bzhin 'khrig pa'i skabs su bud med lus stobs chung zhing phra la/ skam na bang du len pa dang rgyab 'dun brje ba/ steng du bskyon pa dang 'og tu 'jug nga sogs gang byas kyang stabs bde yin nga sa de'i rigs kyi bud med ni zhakhrig pa'i skabs su bzang shose de yin/yang bud med kha rta mchu ltar mdun sesgo tshur brgyangs zhing kha sha'i 5/ ma/gul ma mgul gnyis phyogs gnyis su bkar 'dug pa lta bu ma min par/ kha chung zhing kha sha mthug po'i rigs la dga'/ 'khrig pa'i skabs kha sha 'jib ldag byed ska bas kha sha mthug cing chung na dmegs bsal gyis tshor bde re myong rgyu yod la/ de las kyang lhag nga zhig yod pa ni lce yin/ lce sgom po dang leb mo min par phra zhing ring na langeb bde la kha rig 'jib ldag dang mtshan ma 'jib ldag gang gi thad nas kyang dmegs bsal gyis tshor ba zhig ster bar byed pa sa dga'/ nga sngon chad dha sa sreg lhan du sdod skabs khang bdag rgya gar tshang la bu mo gsum yod pa'i 'bring ba des bod skad cung tsam bshad shes la/ nged gnyis kyis pha na tshun la skad cha bshad pa dang ku re rtseb sogs byed kyin yod/ nam rgyun kho mos nor 'khrul zhig bzos skabs lam sang lce snar byas te rang skyon ngos len byed pa'i tshul ston par dga'/ kho mos de ltar byed thengs rer nga lam sang kho mo'i lce la sems pa g.yeng 'gro la 'jib 'dod kyi 'dun pa'ang dus da lta la thug gi bar du yang/ ma

66 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/myong / kho mo'i lce ni ngas gong du brjod pa ltar phra zhing ring la dmar mo yin pa ma zad/ rtse resna phra bu zhig yin stabs sems shig la ba/cig 'jib na'ang 'jib ran zhig 'dug snyam gyin yod/de bzhin bud med kyis 'khrig pa'i mabesha mjug bar gsum du chags mig ges lta ba dang mid sgra rgyun chad med par 'don rgyu de yang gal chen zhig yin/ bud sped re zung 'khreg sreged mabosna btsugs ma thag nas mig gnyis btsums 'gro la 'khrig sperdzod mjug ma rdzogs par du kha rog ger 'dug gi red/ khong tshos lag pa gnyis bsring snas skyes pa'i brang ngos dang ske/ sga la gzhung sogs su 'phu ra mnyed mi byed la/ ngag ni lkugs nga/ ltar du gyur 'gro bas 'khrig pa'i las thams cad skye sa pa gcig pus byed dgos/ bud med 'di'i rigs la 'khrig nga/ spyod skabs nub phyogs kyi 'gyig bzo'i mi zer ba de 'di lta bu zhig yin ang bsam pa las/ sems ldan zhig la 'khrig pa spyodad kyin pa'i snang ba yal 'gro la/ zhakhrig pa 'i skabs kyi bde tshor yang de ca ma mi rnyed/ dper na/ bshang btsong ma'i rigs kyi bud med rnams red/ skyes pa mang sos bshang btsong ma tsho u thug thabs zad du gyur na ma gtogs mi nyo la/ de ni khong tsho dngos gnas 'gyeg bzos mi dang mtshungs pa sa red/ ( bshang btsong ma yin tshul 'di ltar min nga/ra/ bshang btsong ma re 'ga'i khrod na mgron ngo ra dmigs bsal gyis 'khrig rtsal sna tshogs bkol te/ sngar med kyi bde tshor ster mkhan ya/nga yod/ ) grogs po zhig gis nga la sngon chad ldi le'i bshang btsong khang zheg nas rgya gar bshang btsong ma zhig la spyad nga 'i skor zhig brjod skabs/khos bshang btsong ma des spe tog nyi ma gsor gyi ze'u 'bru zhig za bzhin mig gis gnam ngo gang sar khra reg rig gis lta ba las/ mi zhig gis rang la 'khrig pa :snad pa'i sna nga ba til 'bru tsam yang mi 'dug pas bro ba mi 'dug ces zed der brten bud med tshos

'khrig pa'i skabs kyi gtam thor bu ma/ 67saspreg pa 'i mgo 'jug bar gsum du ngu skad 'don pa dang mid sgra 'byin pa/ lag pa sa stes pa'i lus kun la 'phu ra mnyed dang bud med rang gi nu ma dang mtshan mo'i g.yas /yon sogs su 'phur mnyed byed pa de yang skyes pa tshor bde tshor lhag tu ster ba'i rgyu sha stag yin la/ bud med rang nyid kyang de la goms shing 'dris na dmigs bsal gyis bde tshor re rnyed rgyu yod/ches gnad 'gag che ba'i gnasani mtshan ma yin/ mi chang ma'i kha sna'i dbyibs dang che chung sesgogs 'dra min sna tshogs yod nga ltar bud med kyi mtshan ma'i che chung dang dbyibs kyang gtan nas mi gcig la/ 'khrig nga 'i skabs su bde ba spyod thub mkhan gyi mtshan ma'i rigs dang mi bde ba'i rigs/ rlon pa'i rigs dang skam po'i rigs sogs mi/ 'dra ba sna tshogs yod/ 'khrig pa'i skabs kyi dbang bo gal che sgosgos mtshan ma yin la ma tshan ma 'don 'jug gi skabs su mo mchan la bro ba med na 'khreg pa spyad pa 'i don go chod kyi med/ nub phyogs pa'i skyes pa tsho shar phyogs kye bud med tshor shin tu dga' la/de ni rigar phyogs pa 'i bud med tshor 'khreg rtsa'/ 'dzoms pas min nga ra mtshan ma chung ba'i stabs kyis yin/ mtshan ma chung zhing dam la sdom btsur la ma/khas pa'i bud med rnams ni 'khrig pa'e skabs su skyes pa tshos ches dga' mos byed pa 'i bud med rigs yin/ yang mchan ma chung ba tsam gyis 'khrig bde ster thub bam zer na me thub/ dper na bud med re zung ges mtshan ma'i nang ngos chung ba las kha che zhing de tsam dam po min/bud med de'i rigs la 'khrig pa spyod skabs pho mtshan hril bo mo mtshan nang 'dzul sped pa 'e tshor ba 'byung la/ yang pho mtshan gyi rtsom gtogs rtsab mo mtshan nang song ba'i tshor ba de cam mi rnyed/der brten mtshan ma'i nang ngos dam sgod gang yin yang kha chung ba'i bud med kyi mtshan ma ni bzang 3stos de yin/ mo mtshan gyi kha chung ba des bud med rang gis

68 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/kyang skyes pa 'i pho mtshan rang gi mtshan ma'i nang bcug ma thag nas tshor thub la/ ngos kyang de ltar tshor thub nga ra ma zad po mtshan hril so mtshan ma'i nang du yun gyis 'jug skabs sbrul zhig dong nang du ladzul ba ltar/ mgo gang du slebs pa dang bar gang du yod pa/mjug mthar pho mtshan hril bo mtshan ma'i nang ngos su bcug zin pa sogs tshor thub kyi ོ/da la/ mtshan ma 'don 'jug gi skabs su dmi gas bsal gyi tshor bde zhig myong thub pa yin pas mtshan ma'i nang ngos chung ba las kha sgo chung ba'i mo mtshan la dga'/mo mtshan re zung drod khol rgyas shing tsha sob sob tu yo/da la/ re zung 'khyags sob sob tu yod nga sa yun ring la bdag med du lus nga/'i 'gyig mtshan zhig tu 'khrul/ mod/mi'i lus ni nam rgyun nas drod khol rgyas yod la mtshan mar de lta ra drod khol rgyas shing pho mtshan nang du bcug ma thag nas drod lham ser 'gro bas/ nga ni drod lham lham gyi mo mtshan la dga'/ de bzhin chags sems shugs che ru 'phar ba dang mnyam du g.ya/'a chu de ltar mang du bzhur zhing / sakhreg pa ji tsam gyis mang du spyad na de tsam gyi sa/ g.ya/'a chu mnga' ba'i mo mchan ni/ ma tshan ma 'don 'jug gi mabordzo mjug bar gsum du gal chen nge yin/mjug mthar 'khrig pa'e skabs su skyes pa tshor bde tshor ster min ni bud med kyi byang goms dang zhakhrig rtsal la thug yod ces brjod par 'dod la/ bud med kyi 'dod 'dun yongs su skong thub min yang skyes pa tshos byang rtsal la thug yod pas/ gzeg sgod la goms shing 'khrig rtsal ldan pa'i bud med ni stes pa tshos ches dga' mos byed the'i rigs yin la nga rang ches dga' sa'ang yin/ 4'dir ngas gnad don zhig kha gsal bo byed/'dzam gling steng mtshan snyan rgyas pa 'e

'khrig pa'i skabs kyi gtam thor bu ma 69lag rtsal spo lo rtsed mkhan rjor ldan dang rkang rtsed spo lo rtsed mkhan bhe khem/ glu gzhas kyi rgyal so me khal rje khu son lta bu'i skyes po dag red/ khyed tshos soms dang khong tsho tshang ma a ma'i byang khog brgyud nas sar lhung dus nas de lta bu'i rtsed rigs 'a/ mkhas shing glu gzhas gtong mkhan zhig red dam zhe na/ de ni gtan nas min te khong tshos kyang nga tsho dang 'dra bar gom pa gcig spo gnyes sgo dang skad cha 'cha' ma 'chol bshad kyin chen po chags pa yin la/ de nas rtsed rigs la dga' snang 'phel ba dang yu na ring sbyong brdar byas pas da gzod de la mkhas shing ming du grags pa yin/ 'khrig spretshed byed nga/ de yang ma khog nas skyes ma thag nas shes seteng mkhan zhig med la/ der zhugs nas ma skragams pa zhig kyang med/ gtso so de spyod gshes pa tsam min pa ra de 'a/ byang rtsal laḥm rgyu de ya/nga gal chen zhig red/ ma/ gzhi luzeg pa spyod pa ni nyin re'i byed sgo'i khrod kyi lus rtsal/ bzang shesi de yen pa ma brjed rogs/mtshan/ gong gi dga' phyogs de dag ngas rang nyid kyi dga' phyogs bshad pa tsam las skyes pa yin tshul de lta ra yin dbosnas pa'i lta tshul bdag la med/

70 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/'khrig spyod ga dus red dam/bza' tshang bar na dus nam yang dang stod 'byung mi nyan sa zhig ma/rdzod pa ni 'khrig spyod kyi bya ba 'di yin la/ 'khrig sbyod ni bza' tshang gi brtse ba'i 'brel ba'i rmang gzhi dang 'cham mthun dang bde skyid kyi rtsab ngo ma de yin/ nyin dkar phyi ru las brel je ltar che rung mtshan mo bza' zla zung drod laram gyi mal khri'i steng nyal nas/ gzeg sbyo da kyi bya bar 'jug pa dang 'jeg rten gyi 'tsho ba ngo/ngas su spyo da par byed/ de ni bu rum 'a/sa lhag cing sbrang rtsiyelas mngar ba'i 'tsho ba'i bde skyed ngo ma de yang yin/ yin na'ang / dka' ngal zhig mardzod pa ni bza' zla gnyes la mtshon na gcig mthun gyi bsam blo dang dus mtshungs kyi dgos 'dod cig yod mi srid nga/ de red/ lhag pa/ra du phan chun gyi las ngal mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis 'khrig spyod kyi dgos dmegs kyang mi 'dra/res gza' zla ba nas pa sangs bar du tshe gas pa'i chu tshod 5 nas dre/ da ga las shar 'a〈sna dbesnas la/ dbesnang lngardzo'i chu tshod 9 dang phyed ku'am/ yang na de'i rjes nas ma gtogs phyir nang du sku nga thub kyi med/ nyin dkar las brel shin tu che thog las ka byed yul gyi sbyin bdag de ha cang rlung tsha ba'i dbang gis khyo ga phyir nang du thon dus/ nam rgyun lus ngal dub kyis bsdams shing sems mi skyid par gyur te/ gdong lugs nas yothong ge yod la/ nub chu 'thung mtshams nyal rkyang byed/ de yang 'ophas yin/ sang snyasnags sngar bzhin

'khrig pa'i skabs kyi gtam thor bu ma/ 7/nangs snga mo nas langs te las kur 'gro dbostos/kherdzos nam rgyun chung ma mnyam du skad cha bshad pa'i dus yun ni nub chu 'thung skabs kho na de yin mod/ skabs rer chung ma'ang phyi nas nang la thon 'phyi ba dang nub chu gra sgrig zin med stabs/ khos gser las dkon pa'i dus yun thung ngu de 5/nga kha rtsod dang sdug dpe kho na'i 'da' bar bye da kyin yod/gang ltar yang / khos de ltar nyin gyi zas bcags mtshan mo'i gnyid bcags te hur thag gis las shar zhugs don ni/ chung mar byis nga btsas nas yun ring setreng med sta bas kho mo'i lus por bde thang 〈snang ched du yin la/yang gcig bshad na chung ma'i ched du rang nyid da lta rang ma shi dmyal bar song nas phyir yong dgos kyang / 'dang rgyag med pa'i rnam dag gi brtse ba de'i dbang gis yin/ khostong gis nam rgyun rang gi chung mar bshad don/ /khyod ni nga'i tshe 'di'i bde skyid yin la rgyu nor longs sgod kyang yin/ khyod yod pas da gzod nga'i 'tsho bar bde skyid bsnan byung la/ khyod rtsod nga/sa da gzod dza'i 'tsho bar 'byor tsu ga dang gser dngul g.yu/ byur/ rta nor lug gsum gyi rgyu nor med kyang nga la 'jig rten 'di'i steng gi ches mche ba'i dngos po zhig thob song ba ltar dga' zhing spyo yo/da/ / ces zer/ skad cha de chung ma'i sems su brtan por nyar yod la/ skabs rer kho resnas skad cha de dag la bsam blo gakhor skabs gdong la dbang med du 'dzum mdangs rgyas shing kher dgod kyang yang yang byed/ yin na'ang / kho dang chung ma gnyis mnyam du bsdad nas lo gnyis 'khor la nye ba'i skabs 'der gcig nas kho rang las ka gsar bar zhugs pa dang gnyis nas chung ma nang du bsdad de byis pa gnyor mabosgo brtsams pa nas khong gonyes kyi 'khrig sprusgod kyi bya bar chag sgo byung / de'i sngon du khong gnyis nam rgyun

72 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/dgong mo snga so nas mar nyal te gang dga' gang skyid kyis 'khrig spyardzod kyi bya bar zhugs pa dang / zhogs pa sgo da lhod byas te mal sa las langs pa/ nyin dkar ya nga las brel/ chen po med pa ra mnyam du sang la song nas sngo tshal dang zas rigs nyo ba/ spro 'cham byed pa sogs byed kyin yo/da pa/sa/ skabs de dus kyi 'tsho ba ni dngos gnas ches spyo skyid dang ches mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig red/ da lta chung ma'i sems su gong gi don dag de gcig pu las dran gyi mi 'dug la/ byis pa gnor skyong dang gzhug phyogs kyi bya ba'i thad du'ang sems gabor thub kyi med/ chung ma dgong mo re re bzhin gnyid mi khug par 'khun sga dang 'dang rgyag ge nang du lhu nga nas nam 'phud kye yod mod/ khyo ga de las ldog ste gnyirdo sdug ngo zhig gi gting rim du 'dzul 'gro ba ma zad/ skabs rer chung ma yar langs te phyi 'o/gas kyi 'khyam ra'i khar yar 'a〈sna mar 'gro byas te nam phud dbosgos byung ba grangs kyis mi zin yang khos shes rtogs byung nad/ chung mar mtshon na 'khrig thesgod kyi bya ba ma reg par bdun phra ga gsum tag tag phyin tshar la/ mtshan mosna re re bzhin4 'khrig sems rgyas te re ba'i mig zung mal sa ru bde bar gzim pa'i khyo ga'i steng shor 'gro yang / de ni ma gzhi nas bem po cam zhig las 'khrig spretshed kyi bya bar phan thogs sped nga/ra gyur 'duga'adi ni dpe mtshon tsam red/ de bzhin skyes pa mang bo zhig la'ang zhakhrig sbyo da kyi bya ba'i thad du dka' ngal chen po 'phrad kyin yod cing /de ni rang gi chung mas rtag par gnyeg sbyod kyi bya ba sang sgrub dang gnangs sgrab ces zer la/ khyo ga'i blo la gtan nas 'bab dka' ba zhig ni rang gi chung mas raX nyid la satheg spyod kyi bya ba sgrub tu mi 'jug pa de yin/ kho la chung ma yod kyang gnyeg sgod brten sa med pa 'i dka' ngal rgyun par 'phrad nga ni khos bzod bsran dka' zhing / rnom rgyun sems mi skyid pa dang khong gnyis bar la kha rtsod dang 'khrug pa 'chor ba'i rgyu kho na ru grub 'dug

'khrig pa'i skabs kyi gtam thor bu ma/ 73khyo gas phyir dran byas don/ sngon chad kho rang sprang sakhyam gyi 'tsho ba rol rte sabyam/ nyul byed skabs kyang de lta bu'i sems mi skyed pa byung ma myong zhing / sngon chad kho 'a/ btsan po dbang 'byud tshos mthong chung dang brnyas bcos/ gcar rdung byed skabs/ kyang kho rang gtan nas sems ma pham zhing dpa' ma zhum/ yin na'ang / da lta rgyu nor 'ordzongs sperdzod rgyas shing / phru gu'ang skyes zin pa'i khyo ga 'di rtag tu bgrod dka' ba'i phrang lam zhig4 tu gtan nas bgrod thub kyi mi 'dug ste/ de ni kho dang chung ma'i bar gyi 'khrig spyod thad kyi don dag de red/kho'i chung mas rtag tu kho la 'khrig spyo da kyi bya ba ni de tsam gal chen ma red/ gtso so bde skyid dang dgod sgras khengs pa'i 'u cag gi 'tsho ba gal chen red ces zer/ yin na'ang / chung ma 'dis kho mo dang khyo ga'i bar gyi 'khrig sbyo rdzod ni khong bza' zla gnyis kyi 'tsho ba'i grub cha gal che 31sa de yin pa rtogs med la/ de'i thad du kho mos gtan nas bsam gzhig kyang byed ma myong / yang gcig bshad na kho por nam 'khrig speged dgos na khyo gas de dus sbyin gyin yod pas kho mor 'di'i thad du dka' ngal byung ma zlong zhing / 'ode'i thad kyi sdug bsngal yang rtogs med/red lags/ nga tsho mi rnams la 'tsho ba'i yo byad lag khyer kha par dang rlangs 'khor/ 'phrul rta/ lag 'dogs chu tshod/ nyi glog dang chu glog brnyan 'brin sesgogs khyim tshang re re bzhin rang rang gi 'tsho ba'i gnas bab dang dpal 'byor gyi yo/nga 'bab tshod kyis khyim sgod ca dngos mang bo dgos la/ de dag nyos kyang yo/da/ 'on kyang / kha dku ra zhig gtong skabazlo lag khyer kha pa/ra slo bur du skyon shor te gtong thabs bral ba dang / dza drag gi don dag cig byung nas lam sang phyi 'a/ 'gro dgose khel skabs/ rlangs lubor gyi snum

74 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/sngar nas rdzogs zin pas 'gro thabs bral ba/ grogs po zhig la dus bcad byas pa ltar dus thog thon dbongs kyang byis pas lag 'dogs chu tshod bcags zin pas nam dus ma nges pa ra lhag pa sogs kyi skabs su/ gong gi ca dngos de dag yod pas ci byed/ de dang gcig mtshungs ltar/ chung sa nas bshad na nam 'khrig sperdzod dgos na de dus bed spyod med pa'i chung mas ci byed/ chung ma len pa nee zhakhrig pa sgrod rgyu kho na'i ched du men 〉da/chung mas rang gi khyo ga'i 'dod 'dun skyong ba ni rlabs che dī'i chung ma zhig gi 'os 'gan dang khong bza' zla zung gi bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba'i ming gzhi yin pa'ang brjed ga la rung /skabs rer chung mar mi gzhan pas lkog nas 'khrig pa :thod pa dang yang lan rer khyo gas bud med gzhan la lkog 'brel byed pa sogs kyang don dag 'di lta bu'i steng nas 'byung gi yod la/ rang gi rim na yod nga 'i chung mas rang la 'khrig pa'i bya ba byed mi 'jug na phyi nas bud med btsal rgyu ni nges pa zhig red la/ rang gi khyo gas chung mar 'khrig spe da tsam gyi 'dod nga 'ang skong mi nus na nam zhig chung ma rku la 'che ra ba dang gzhan sgro rjes su 'brang rgyu de yang yong srid pa zhig red/ de'i phyir du na bza' zla su yin rung phan chun la 'khreg spu da kyi thad du dka' ngal 'phrad mi 'jug rgyu de yang gal che'i nang gi don chen zhig red/ 'di'i skabs su pha na tshun kha bsang bo byed rgyu ni dngos gnas gnad 'gag yod tshad kyi rtsab lta bu red/ dper na/ chung mas rang gi khyo gar bdun phrag gcig nang nyung mthar yang kho mor thengs ci tsam la 'khrig pa spyod min dang / kho mor zhakhrig sems ga dus rgyas kyi yod nga/ dang 'khrig spyod ga dus dgos pa sogs 'chad pa /yang khyo gas rang gi chung mar 'khrig pa/'i skabs su 'dod blo tshims ki yod med dang rang nyed 'a/ ga dus gzeg pyod dgom pa sogs brjod rung ba zhig red/

'khrig pa'i skabs kyi gtam thor bu mardzo/ gsheX'akhrig pa'i skor gyi rgyun shes sbyong rogs/'khrig sgod skor gyi rgyun shes la rmongs pa'i skyes pa dag gis rang nyid kyi chung ma'i 'dod 'dusna yongs rdzogs skong thub kyi med/ gal srid re zung yod na de ni kho rang nyid rang bzhin lhan skyes su 'khrig spyod rgyun ring so 'dzin thub mkhan gyi skyes pa zhig yin sred pa'am/ kho'i chung ma de bud med spyi byings ltar 'khrig sbyod rgyun ring bo dgos mkhan gyi bud sped cig min rtags yin/ de min skyes pa dang bud med kyi chags pa de rgya mtsho zhig la dpe blangs nas bshad na/ skyes pa'i chags pa rgya mtsho'i kha dang bud med kyi chags pa rgya mtsho'i gting du mthod pas/ bud med la ga ler chags sems rgyas te rgya mtsho'i gting rim du yod pa'i chags pa rgya mtsho'i khar ma slebs pa'i sngon du skyes pas ces kyang bzod bsran dang sdug rus byed 'os/ lhag par du skyes pa rnams kyis bud med kyi chags pa sems gshis dang shugs cher 'brel bas 'khrig pa ma srad pa 'i sngon du kho mo tsho'i sems la pog thug btan nas 'byung mi rung ba'i gnas lurgos kyang legs par rtogs 'os/ ngas khyed la mna' bskyal nas bshad chog bza' zla zung drod 'jam gyi mal khri'i steng bde bar ma gzim pa'i sdon du kha 'dzing cung tsam shor bar chag zhog de'i rjes khong gnyis kyis phan tshun la ci yang bshad mi 'dod par mal las bde bar nyal/ nyal nas cang ma 'gor bar skyes pas gong nas kha 'dzing shor ba'i don dag de

76 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/sems nas brjed du bcug ste/ rang gi chung mar gnyig pa spyoted rgyu'i gros mgo 'don pa dang kha skyel ba/ 'phur mnyed sogs byed/ skabs der chung ma nyam chung zhig yin na rang gis khyo ga'i 'dod 'dun la snang med dang bkag 'gog mi byed/ yin na'ang / kho mo nam rgyun las ldab 'ga'i chags shugs nyam zhing rgud skusnad/ de ni khom mo'i sems la phog thug sgosar ba las byung ba zhig besgo/ /de min phyi gling ba lta bur mtshon na bud med tshos rang rang gi sems gnad mang bo zhig rang gi khyo gar 'grel thub kyi yo/da la/ khong tshos rang la zhakhrig pa'i skabs su sbyo da shugs kyi che chung dang dal mgyogs/ rgyun ring thung sogs rang gi dgos 'dun dang mthun par bshad phod kyi 〈snad/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na skyes pa tsho yang 'khrig pa 'i skor gyi rgyun shes sna tshogs la byang chub pa rkyang ste/ 'khrig las kyi thad nas khong tshor de tsam gyis dka' ngal chen po 'phrad kyi med/ gal srid yod dbang du btang na'ang / 'khrig sred slob ston pa'i sar nas lam ston len pa'am/ rang gis dngos su deb klog pa dang slog brnyan la blta ba/ bza' zla zung gis phan tshun la kha bsang bo'i sems gtam bshad de sel thabs byed kyin yod/ yin na'ang / bod lta bur mtshon na da lta'i char 'di lta bu'i srol lugs dag dar med la/ nga tsho'i rna lam du yang dang yang du bud med re 'ga' rang gi khyo ga mnyam du tshe gang bsdad kyang 'khrig pa'i bde ba ma myong ba'i skor thos yong gi yod/des na nga tshos rang rang gi chung ma tsho 'khrig pa'i skabs mthar thug gi bde ba myong thub kyi yod med la spyir btang ba'i gshes spyod 'ga'i thad du mnyam 'jog dgos shing / dri ba 'don pa dang nyams tshod len pa sogs byed 'os/ dper na/ bud med re 'gas

'khrig pa'i skor gyi rgyun shes sbyong rogs/ 77don dag med sa nas rang gi khyo gar rnyog dra bzo zhing rtsod pa byed/ khyo gas kho tshor yar bshad na khong tshos rkang btsugs nas mar bshad srid la/ phar tshig gcig b.rigad na tshur tshig gnyis bdagad 'ong / khong tshos don dag tsag tsig gi steng nas kyang rtsod pa byed sred/'on kyang / don dngos thog khong tshos rtsod pa byed nga/'i gzhi ngo ma ni mig snga'i don dag de men par sems steng gi sdug bsngal zhig gis bslangs pa yin la/ sdug bsngal de ni rang gi khyo ga mnyam du 'khrig pa thengs ci tsam spyad kyang mthar 'khrig bde ma thob pa'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa des so/ /

78 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/'khrig pa'i sngon 'gro'i rgyu bshad pa/skye sa/ pa zhig gi ngos nas bshad na sems la chags sred me lce lta ra 'bar ba'i skabs su 'dom gyi dbang sa gyen la mkhregs por langs zin la/ dus yun skar cha rer yang sgug long med par bud med cig gi mtshan ma'i nang sprul ltar zhugs te zho ltar dkrug 'dun ni 'gog thabs bral ba zhig red/ yin na'ang / 'khrig pa'i skabs su de ni dge chos mchog gis gsungs pa ltar/ khyi yis glo ba mid pa'i ngang tshul tsam red/ de las las der go rim ldan pa dang byang rtsal ldan pa/ dus yun ldan pa 'i ngang 'jug rgyu de ni gal che 3(sa shig red/'khrig spyod mgo 'dzugs ma byas pa'i sdon der bza' mi gnyis kyi su yin rung 'das zin pa'i skyo gar lta bu'i rigs sems nas dor cing / 'phra da kyin pa'i 'gal rkyen dag kyang re zhig sems nas brjed du chugs/ tha na sang nyin gyi nyi rtse shar phyogs 'phags ri'i rtse nas 'phags dus khyod la ci zhig 'byung min thad kyi dngangs skrag tsam yang med par/sems rnal du phobs la mi ga dang rna ba rang gi mdza' mo'i phyogs su gtod cig khyed kyis zhib kyis gzigs dang nyal khri'i steng bde bar gzims te spyan zung gem gem g.yo bzhin chags mig gis cer sdod mkhan ni/ khyed kyi snying nas brtseba'i chung ma ste dkar zheng 'jam pa'i lus po gtsang dag yang dag cig bkrus nas khyed dang lhan du

'khrig pa'i sngon 'gro'i rgyu bshad pa/ 79zhakhrig pa'i las su gzhug par re bzhin bsdad 'dug yin na'ang / skabs der khyed brel sha langs mi rung ba de sems la nyar rogs/khyed kyis ga ler rang gi gyon pa dag phud nas kho mo'i drod 'jam gyi rum du 'dzul cig de nas byung na kho mo khyed kyi mig lam du ji ltar snying du sdug cing lta ba'i chog mi shes pa zhig yin pa'i skor brjod pa'am/ khyed dang kho mo'i bar gyi lhad med pa/'i mdza' brtse'i sko ra gleng ba/ yang snying kho mo ni khyed la mtshon nas bshad na ci 'dra'i gal chen zhig yin pa dang / gal srid mi ring bar khyed gnyis la snying nas brtseba'i bu chung zhig btsas pa yin na khyed kyis khong ma bu gnyis la sngar las kyang byams shing brtseb sermegs kyi skor gleng 'os/ lhag par khyed rang lo ngo 'di 'dra'i mang 'o zhig la rang gi mdza' mo mnyam du nyal te 'khrig spyod kyi bya ba gnyer na'ang / kho mo'i lhad med kyi dung sems dang mdzes sdug gi lang tsho/ 'khrig pa'i skabs kyi bde tshor setegs kyis khyed rang gtan nas kho mo dang 'khrig las byed par mun snang 'byung ma myong tshul sogs go rim ldan pa'i ngang brjod dang / skad cha de dag gis rma byas 'brug sgra thos pa ji bzhin kho mo'i sems la smra mi shes pa'i bde bas khyab par byed thub/gang ltar 'khrig spyod mgo 'dzugs ma byas pa'i sngon der re bas khengs pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi 'tsho ba zhig snying gtam gyi lam nas bzhings skrun byed zhor/ bza' zla gnyis rka'i sems su sang nyin ni de ring las mdzes sdug ldan la/ sang nyin gyi 'tsho ba ni de ring gi 'tsho ba las bde skyid ldan pa zhig yin ang bsam bzhin/ phan tshun gyi gdong la 'dzum mdangs dang chags mig gis lta bzhin/ 'o dri 'thil ba'i kha skyel bzhin/ /tshong dngos gnas khyed la dga'/ nga'i tshe thog 'dir khyed lta bu'i skya ya zhig reg pa ni las

80 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ ce sa rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/dbang dang dkon mchog gis nga la tshad med pa'i gzigs skyong gnang ba zhig red la/res skyid res sdug gi nga'i mi tshe 'jig rten du 'tsho ba'i snying po'ang red/ / lta bu'i snyan langeb kyi tshig dag brjod par 'os/ de nas bud med kyi sems la sngar med kyi bde tshor khyab par 'gyur la/ bde tshor de sems kyi gting zab sa nas mgo btsugs te lus hril sor khyab par 'gyus de dus khyed kyis 'jam mnyen gyi lag pa zung gis kho mo'i ske dang brang gzhung / rgyab dresags bcas nas 'phur mnyed kyi mabosna brtsams te rim gyis kherdzog smad dang brla sha mtshan ma'i g.yas gaskusnan bcas su lug rdzi rgad pos ri mgo nas lung ga3(nga du lug chu khar 'ded pa'i tshul gyis/ bud med kyi lus stod nas mgo brtsams te lus stod kyi bde tshor dag lus smad la 'ded pa dang / de nas slar yang lus smad nas lus stod sogs su ded de ga ler 'phur mnyed byed dgos/ de ltar 'phrur mnyed byed pa 'e zhor du kho mo'i gdong dang mchu/ rna rtsadang ske/ phrag mgo dang brang gzhung bcas su kha skyel ba dang lce rtses lajib ldag byed dgos/ lhag par du rlan zhing gsher ba'i lce rtses bud med kyi ske dang brang gzhung / 'o 'odzin dang ste ba bcas su lajeb ldag byed skabs kho mo'i sha gseng la za 'phrug langs shing / sems nang gi chags sems rab tu rgyas par byed thub/ 'khrig pa'i sngon 'gro'i skabs su dus yun ci tsam gyis ring na de tsam gyis bud med kyi sems sgod la 'bab cing 'khrig sems rab tu rgyas par 'gyur thub/de min phan tshun gnyis mos byung na mtshan ma 'jib ldag gi las dag mtshams 'dir byed par rigs/de ltar sdon 'gro'i rgyu dag legs par grub rjes gzhi nas mtshan ma 'don 'jug gi las su 'jug rogs/ de'i rjes dge chos ma〈snag gis/ de ltar gnyis ka chags

'khrig pa'i sngon 'gro'i rgyu bshad pa/ 8/pas snying 'dar zhing / /dmar zhing bag tsha bral ba'i gdong blta sa te/ /dbang bo'i nor bu lag pas drangs byas nas/ /bha ga'i bu ga dag la 'jug par bya/ /rtse tsam bcug nas yang yang phyi ru byung / /phyed tsam btang nas yang yang phyi ru byung / /mthar ni rtsaba'i bar du sbyar byas te/ /gyen gyi phyogs su yun ring gtod par sga /zhes gsungs pa ltar dngos su mtshan ma 'don 'jug gi las la 'jug chesgog lhag pa ra du pho mtshan bud med kyi mtshan ma'i nang thog mar btsugs ma thag bud med re 'gas kha nas dbang med du 'khun sgra 'byin pa dang dbugs kyang hal gyis gtong len byed/ gal srid khyed kyis tshor yod na skabs der kho mo'i snying yang lhog rdzog tu ldang gi yod la/ kha 'dar 'dar byed pa dang brang khar chu yis reg pa lta bu'i dbugs gtong len byed/ da ni khyed rang 'khrig pa dngos kyi las la zhugs zin pa yin la/ de'i rjes kyi bya :snad dag mi re re bzhin gyis rang rang gi byang rtsal dang goms 'dres ltar byed chog gang ltar phan tshun gnyis mos byung na 'khrig spyod kyi bya ba'i thad du 'di gtsang gan bcog gi lta ba'i rigs 'dor bar bdag 'thad/

82 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/khyod kyis nga'i gsang gnas shig rnyed byung /ngas bud med tshor yang dang rim gyis nan tan gyis re ba gcig ma gtogs zhu gi med/ de ni khong tshos rang rang gi sems gnad dag nga tshor gsal bor bshad rgyu de yin/ ngas khong tshor bcangs pa'i re 'dun ni de ltar chung chung zhig ma gtogs med pas ngal ba mang sa brten mi dgos par bsgrub rgyur las sla na'ang bud sped tshos 'jon gi mi 'dug rang rang gi sems gnad tsam 'grel rgyur yang ngo tsha dang bag khums su gyur ba'i bud med tshos da dung bud med kyi thob thang dang khe dbang / 'dra mnyam sogs rtsode rgyu zer nas rna tsha tsha'i bar du ku co 'don/ nga'i ngos nas bshad na de ni dgod spyad dgod spyad cig red/gang ltar 'dir bshad 'dod pa ni nga dang yun ring 'grogs pa'i bud med cig dang bdag gi bar gyi gsang ba zhig snye/kho mos/ ‘ kha sang khyod kyis nga'i gsang gnas shig rnyed byung /’ zedangs/ gang nas/’ zhes dris pasakho mos/ khyod kyi lag pa/ khyer sna ga/ zer/

khyod kyis nga'i gsang gnas shig rnyed byung / 83 de'i rjes khotshe mosnas nga'i dkyil mdzub nas 'jus te khepha mo'i mtshan mo'i spo thol zhig nas 'phur du bcug ngas kyang ga ler 'phur mnyed byas pas mdzub mose sha 'jam la mnyen pa zhig rnyed cing / der yun gyis 'phur mnyed byed skabs kho mor bzod du med pa'i na zug slong ba dang / sha de'i thog tu tshungang reg sesgogs byas tshe kho mo'i lte mtshams nas mtshan ma'i ya thod kyi rtsargyus kyang shugs kyes spos yong / de ni nga tshos skad shugs chen pos glu len pa'i skabs dang skad rgyag pa'i skabs su ske masam por 'gyur ba lta bu zhig red/ gang ltar rtsader 'phur mnyed byed kyin byed kyin rtsagand du khel na bud med kyis kha nas rang dbang med par 'khun sgra 'chor zhing / sngas 'bo'/ steng nas mgo yang yar 'chungag tsam byed de ni mtshan ma'i nang pho mtshan bcug pa las kyang na zug ster nus pa'i gnas khyad par can zhig red/de'i rjes nas bzung ngas bud med der 'khrig pa nam spyad na rtsader myong reg byas shing / des kho mor zhakhrig bde spyod ngo ra ster gyin yod/ ma zad ngas bud med gzhan la'ang byed thabs de bed spad pas bud med tshos dga' mos chen so byed kyin 'duga'on kyang / skabs der ngazlo rtsade'i skor shes rtogs byung med cing rtsader 'phur mnyed 'a/ ma gosgoms na mi rnyed la/ yang rnyed kyang 'phur mnyed byed stangs ma shes na za 'phrug slo nga ba phar zhog rma bzo ba dang na zug nyer ba sermegs byed pas bud med tshos bkag 'thothog byed srid/ rjes su ngas dra thog dang dpe deb las de'i skor la dpyad skabs de ni bya le zer ba de yin pa shes rtogs byung / red/ de ni bud sped kyi bya le red/ bud med kyi bya le ni chags pa'i skabs kyi gsang gnas gal chen zhig red la/ der 'jam mnyen gye lag pas snungang reg byas pas kho nga tshor dmigs bsal gyis tshor bde zhig 〈snad thub/ ma zad phyi gling bas bud med tshos skyes pas steng nas sbyod skabs rang gi mdzub mos rang gi

84 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/bya ler 'phu ra mnyed byed kyin yod pas/ de ni ches mchog tu gyur ba'i gnyig las byed stangs shig red/dge chos mchog dang shes rab dar rgyas rnam gnyis kyis bya le'i skor mang du gsungs 'dug kyang / dge chos mchog gis bud med kyi bya le langs shing mkhregs por gyur tshe phan tshun la 'khrig pa'i bya ba byed thub ces gsungs par phran dogs snang sna tshogs skyes yong / ngas blta sa na de lta bu'i chen ngo/ yod med dogs gnas su 'dug la/je tsam che na'ang pho mtshan ltar bya ba byed thub par brjod na rdzun gtam dang 'ud shob tu 'gro nyin che bas sus shes kyang 'dir bcug na bdag ha cang 'thad/de ltar ngas bud med kyi gsang gnas de rnyed byung / yin na'ang / de ni nga rang nyid kyi ngos nas gsar du rnyed pa tsam las dge chos mchog dang shes rab dar rgyas gnyis kyis snga sa nas rnyed zin pa khong rnam pa gnyis kyis de'i skor mang du gsungs 'dug nga/sa shes nus so/ /

khyod kyis nga'i gsang gnas shig rnyed byung / 85dud med kyi lang tsho'i me tog la dngos gnas rin thang de lta blu zhig ldan nam/ 'obyu gcig gnyis shig gi besgong nas bzung ngas bud med me tasnag ma zhig dang mnyam du gtan nas thog dang bo'i nyakhrig spyebyud mi brten par dam bcas pa yin/ deng skabs nga'i dam bca' 'di je brtan du 'gro bzhin 'dug la ngas gnad don 'di'i thad du bzung ba'i nges zin yang je gsal du 'gro gi 'dug ngas ji ltar bsam yang bud med me rtog mar ches thog ma'i 'khrig spyoted brten rgyu ni thob bya med cing sdig las tsam du zad/ lhag par du shar phyogs nga/ dang bod rigs bud med tshor ( nga'i pha yul lta bur mtshon na 'di ltar min pa 'grog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa zhes par gsal/ )gtan nas ches thog ma'i 'khrig spyodad ma bsten na bzang snyam/deng skabs ngas bud nad me tog ma cig dang dga' so bsgrigs nas phal cher zla ngo bzhi lhag 'gro gi 'dug la/ dus yun 'di'i nang nged gnyis kyis phan tshun la kha skye'/ res dang lce 'jib res/ mtshan ma 'phur mnyed sogs mtshan ma 'don 'jug gi bya ba ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma byas pa yin/ lhag nga/ra du ngas kherdzong mo'i kha sha gnyis mthug cing nang ngos chung ba'i mtshan mo'i g.yas g.yon du mdzub mos 'phur mnyed byas par ma

86 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams//zad/ skabs rer mtshan ma'e nang logs su'ang mdzub mo bcug tsam byas skabs kho mos bzod du med nga/'i sid sgra 'byin gyin 'dug la/ chags pas rab tu myos nga 'i meg gnyis dmar bor gyur te mtshams med par nga'i pho mtshan lag pa/sa 'phur ba dang nga'i mchu dang gdong / ske dang brang kha sogs su kha skyel ci thub byed/ nged gnyis kyis nam rgyun de ltar phan tshun la laphur mnyed yun ring byas rjes mtshams 'jog pa las mtshan ma 'don 'dug gtan nas byed ma myong / de la rgyu mtshan gnyis yod de gcig ni nged gnyis su yin yang rang rang gi sa na rang rang gi dga' rogs yo/da pa dang / gnyis pa ni kho mo bud med me tog ma zhig yin stabs ngas kho por thog ma'i 'khrig :snad de bsten mi 'dod/yi/na na'ang / ngas kho mo'i kha sha mthug cing nang ngos chung ba'i mtshan ma'i g.yas g.yon du lag pas 'phur mnyed byed thengs reg dus nam zhig ngas kho mor 'khrig pa dngos shig spyod thub rgyu na ci ma rung snyam nga/'i bsam blo gtan nas 'chi ma myong la/thengs shig ngas kho mos rjes phyogs khyod kyis chang sa brgyab tshar rjes go skabs shig reg na nga la 'khrig pa lan cig spyoted du 'jug gam/ zhes dris par/khong resnas/ ci'i phyir yin nam/ zer nas ldog 'dri byas/ ngas bsam na khyod kyi mtshan ma ha cang chung khar kha sgo dog cing kha sha mthug stabs dmigs bsal gyi bro ba zhig myong rgyu yod pa nges gtan red/ ces brjod pa sades na/ khyod kyis nga'i lang tsho'i me tog de len rogs/ gang ltar yang ngas bza' zla basmigs rjes mi su la'ang 'khrig pa bsnyen na rung gi ma red/ zer bas ngas re ba de chud ces su bud song /

bud med kyi lang tsho'i me tog la dngos gnas rin thang de lta bu zhis/ ldan nam/ 87de ltar ngas khong mo'i lang tsho'i me tog de blangs med/ kho mos kyang nga 'a// /ci'i phyir kho mo'i lang tsho'i me tog de len mi 'dod pa yin nam/ zhes 'a/nga yang dris shing /dogs pa sna tshogs pa zhig skye gin 'dug yin na'ang / ngas kho mor de'i rgyu mtshan dag 'di ltar brjod pa yin/ bud med cig ge ngos nas bshad na ches thog mar rang nyid la zhakhrig pa spyod mkhan nam/ ya/nga na rang ge lang tsho'i spe tog de len mkhan su yin na'ang tshe gang bor sems nas brjed ki ma red/ der brten nga khyod kyi tshe gang gi dran shing byed mi 'dod par ma zad/ khyod kyi tshe gcig gi bza' zla ngo ma de su yin na de khyod kyi lang tsho'e me tog gi bdag po ngo ma de yin 'os pa zhig red/ gnyis nas ngas khyod kyi lang tsho'i me tog len ska bas khyed rang sems 'tshab ki red/ snying 'dar gi red/ lus 'khum gi red/ mtha' mar 'jam zhing mnyen pa'i khyed kyi mtshan ma'i nang nga'i 'khregs shing sgom pa'i pho mtshan shugs kyis gtad dus khyed rang tsha nas ngu gi red/ de ni khyed la khag med de ches thog mar gakhrig pa spyod dus bud med phal mo che de ltar red/ de'i stabs kyis nga yang nam rgyun ltar lus sems gnyi ka sgod du babs nas 'khrig pa spyoted mi thub par skabs rer skyed po 'byung la yod skabs khyod kyis 'jam mnyen gyi lag zung gis nga'i brang kha nas yar gtad de 'gog gi red 'a// lan rer khu rba bzhur la yod skabs khyod kyis kha nas ngu skad dang sbrags te da chog gi zhes kyang zer srid/ de ltar ngas gtan nas zhakhrig bde stod po zhig myong mi thub pa'i khar khyod kyis kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig myong bas na/ ngas khyed kyi lang tsho'i spe tog de gtan nas len mi 'dod ces brjod pa yin/lhag par du skabs der ngas gsal stor shes pa zhig ni gal srid ngas khongang rerto'i lang tsho spe tog blangs nga 'i dbang du btang yang / nged gnyis la mang na thengs gnyis dang gsum tsam ma gtogs 'khrig pa spyoted rgyu'i go skabs bral 'phad/ gal srid nged gnyis

88 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/zla gcig gnyis shig ring mnyam du skyid mnyam sdug mnyam gyis 'khrig pa spyodad pa'i go skabs yod tshe/ nga la bskyar du bsam blo gtong ba'i gzhi zhig yod kyang / ngas go skabs de tsam zhig gi ched du kho mo'i lang tsho len thub ma song / yang gcig bshad na kho mo'i gzhug phyogs kyi khyo ga des kyang gcig byas na rang gi tshe gcig gi chung ma'i lang tsho'e me tog de ya/nga rang nyid kyis len thub na bsam mkhan zhig kyang yin srid pa red/ de ltar ngas kho mo'i lang tsho'i spe tog de gtan nas blangs med/de bzhin lo gsum gyi gong du'ang nga dang bud med cig zla ba mang bor dga' bo bsgrigs pa ma zad nyal sa gcig gi nang du mtshan mang sor nyal na'ang ngas kho mo'i lang tsho'i pe tog blangs med/ nged gnyis kyis kyang mtshan ma 'phur mnyed dang kha lce 'jib ldag gi las dag gong mtshungs ltar byas pa yin la/ de dus kyang phan tshun gnyis kur phyogs gnyis ka na dga' rogs yod pas phyogs gnyis ga'i 'byung 'gyur gyi mdun lam la do phog mi 'byung ched de ltar byas pa zhig kyang yin/ gang ltar yang bud med cig gi rum nas nyal yang / de dang mnyam du 'khrig pa spyod mi rung ba'i blo lda sems rgyud la yod pa nas mtshan ma 'phur mnyed dang kha lce 'jib ldag gi las la ji ltar zhugs kyang / chags mgo mi mnon pa'i sdug bsngal nee bdag la yod ma myong / der brtag na mi'i sems na re ba chen po ched na chags sems kyang de ltar shugs cher 'phar ge med pa gsal so red/dper na nga tsho skyes pa tsho rang gi ma dang sring mo mnyam du nyal skabs 'khrig sems rgyas mi srid pa zhig red la/ bud med cha med rgyus med cig dang mnyam du nyal skabs ltar chags sems rgyas te sdod mi tshugs pa'i dka' ngal dag kyang yong gi ma

bud med kyi lang tsho'i me tog la dngos gnas rin thang de lta bu zhis ldan nam / 89red/ de ni dang thog nas de ltar byed mi rung ba'i bsam blo lda sems rgyud du yod pas red/ yin na'ang / ngas bud med gzhon nu ma tsho'i lang tsho'i spe tog la de lta bu'i rin thang zhig 'jog thub kyi mi 'dug lhag par du khong tshos ngos 'dzin pa'i rin thang de lta bu zhig gtan nas 'jog thub kyi mi 'dug rang gi khyo gas blangs kyang rung la gzhan zhig gis blangs kyang chog gang ltar yang lang tsho'e me tog de mi zhig gis len dgos pa gcig mtshungs red/ de gtso so ma red/ de bas kyang gnyen ston bshams te khyim gcig tu ma bsdad bar kho mo'i lang tshor lag pa 'chang du mi 'jug pa'i bud med rnams la mtshon na/ khyo ga des bud med de'i zhakhrig rtsal mi shes la mtshan ma'i che chung dang 'jam rtsub mi shes/ 'khrig pa'i skabs kyi bde tshor sdu gas gcig kyang mi shes pas chang sa brgyab/gnyen ston bshams/ de nas/ sakhrig pa spyod skabs da gzod nor yo/da pa shes na 'phyis zin pa ma yin nam/der brten lang tsho'i me tog gcig bur de tsam gal chen du ma 'dzin rogs/ rlabs che ba'i skyed ma tsho/ de ni kha 'byed la nye ba'i me tog cig nyi 'od phog tsam gyis kha phye sa pa tsam red/ de 'a/sa kyang gal che ba ni kha phyes zin pa'i spe tog cig la ze'u 'bru phun sum tshogs pa 'byud med de ma yin nam/

90 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/mjug mtha'i slob tshan thun gcig dang tshe gcig gi lag byang / nga slob grwa dang kha bral te mi lo drug tag tag phyin song / lo 'di dag gi ring ngas slob grwa dang kha 'bral la nye ba'i skabs kyi mjug mtha'i slob tshan thun gcig gtan nas brjed myong ped la/ slob tshan des nga'i da lta'i bar gyi 'tsho bar ches spyod sgo che ba'i shes bya zhig bsla bas song /nyin der nga tsho'i 'dzin grwa'i dbyin yig dge rgan ngo ma de ma phebs par dge rgan gzhan pa zhig nga tshor slob tshan khrid du phe bas/ dge rgan de ni bud med cig yin la kho mo 'dzin khang nang 'esgong nas yar lta mar lta zhig byas rjes/ slob grogs tsho'i khrod na btsun ma zhig yod pa de phyi la 'gro ru bcug ste/ tsho de ring ngas gzed rgyu'i slob tshan nang khyod kyis sbyangs dgos pa'i shes bya gang yang med pas phyi ru song nas deb cig bklags nas 'dug rogs zhes zer/de'i rjes khong mos nga tshor mjug mtha'i slob tshan thun gcig de khrid mgo brtsams song / khong mos da lta'i bar du khyed tsho tshang ma slob gling 'di'i ra ba'i nang btson ma ltar bcug bzhag pa red/ de'i stabs kyis khyed tshos spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang gi 'gro stangs sdod lugs shes kyi ma red/ lhag par du khyod tsho tshang ma na gzhon yin stabs rjes phyogs ma shes na mi chog pa'i shes bya zhig sku(da pa ni 'khrig spyodad skor gyi

mjug mtha'i slob tshan thun gcig dang tshe gcig gi lag byang / 91 shes bya red// skabs 'dir khong mo'i gdong mdog cung tsam dmar bor gyur song yang / khong mos mi ring bar slob grwa dang kha 'bral la nye ba'i slob phrug nga tsho'i don du mu mthud du khrid mgo brtsams song / /spyir sazheg spyod zer ba'i tshig 'di btsog bshad red 'a/ dge slob tsho'i bar du bshad 'os pa'i tshig cig ma red/ 'on kyang / de ring nga tshos 'di la 'dzem zon med pa 'e sgo nas dmar khrid thengs shig bya/ des khyod tsho'i gzhug phyogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang phan cung tsam thogs na bsam pa'i re ba shugs cher 〈snad/ khyod tsho spyi tshogs khrod slebs rjes rang dbang thob pa red/ lhag par du pha ma gnyen tshan bod na yod stabs sa 'dir khyod tshor 'gro 'dug spyod gsum thad du stangs 'dzin byed mkhan ci yang yod pa ma red/ / ces sogs brjod pas/ slob phrug bu mo tshos mgo bo dang khar smad byung la/ bu chos kyang phan tshun la lkog lta dang mig mda' 'phen res byas sesgong / 'on kyang tshang mas blo sems rtse gcig gis dge rgan gyis khrid bzhin pa'i slob tshan der mu mthud de nyan bsdad/khong gis mu mthud de/ tshod lta khyod tsho su yin na'ang lo chung chung min pas spyi tshogs khrod slebs rjes zhakhrig sad kyi bya ba gnyer rgyu ne nges tshar ba zhig red/ yin na'ang / gtso bo pho mo su yisna na'ang 'tsho bar nges gtan gang yang med pa'i skabs su zhakhrig sperdzod byas par brten nas dus min gyi mngal sbrum du 'jug rung gi ma red/ khyod tshos sgro1mas dang pha ma spun mched sod du skusgod pa'i bu mo mang bo zhig la dus min mngal sbrums te gcig nas phru gu skyes pa dang gsesgo skyong ge nus nga/ med thog gnyis nas bu mo rang nyid tshor 'tsho bar mnar gcod ci lta bu re phog myong yod pa red/ re zung mnga' sbrum rjes bzang na ngan na pho mo gnyis kyis 'gan 'khur 'og phru gu gso skyong byed pa dang / 'tsho ba gsar bar hur thag gis zhugs bzhin mardzod kyang / ma rabs tha shal gyi bya bar

92 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/besgoms pa'i skyes pa mang dag cig gis bu resna tshor mngal sbrum rjes g.yug rkyang byed pa de red/ de'i stabs kyis 'khrig spyodad byed dus mngal sbrum 'gog gi shes bya rishes par bya rgyu de gal chen so red/’ ces gsungs/ya/nga khong gis/ ཿ sngon chad skyes pa mang bos bu mo tshor mgo bskor bslu brid byas te gang 'dod du 'khrig pa sbyad rjes g.yu/ga rkyang byas yod pa red / yin na'ang / deng skabs bu mo tsho yang sngar bas sbyang grung ldan par gyur te mngal sbrum par thabs shes byed kyi yod pa red/ kho tshos bsam par gal srid rang la mngal sbrum pa yin na skyes nga de rang la mi dga' na'ang phru gur snying rje skyermo srid nga/sa rang nyid la/sa sla bor g.yug chog chog cig yod pa ma red bsam yod pa red/ sogs zhakhrig spyod skor gyi shes bya mang cam bsla bas/ mjug mthar khong gis 'khrig :sgod skabs su mnga' sbrum 'bosgog gi thabs lam gsum bslabs pa ni/ 'khrig pa'i skabs su 'gyig shubs bed spyodad pa dang 'khrig pa'i snga gzhug gang rung du bu mor mngal sbrum 'gog gi sman za ru 'jug pa/ skyes nga 'i khu ba bud med kyi mtshan ma'i phyi la gtor ba bcas red/ sprir mngal sbrum 'gog gi skabs su byed thabs gzhan 'ga' yang yod la/ de ni bud smad kyi bu snod kha gcod pa/ dang dbung pa 'i steng khab lasag pa/ skyes pa'i thig le nus med du gtong ba/bud med rang nyis kyis skyes pa'i khu ba rang gi mtshan ma las phyi ra btsur ba bcas red/ gang ltar mjug mtha'i slob chan thun gcig de dge rgan bka' dren can khong gis kha yo/da lag yod cig khrid gnang mdzad song / skabs de dus nga tsho saweg sgod skor dang mngal sbrum 'gog gi skor la gang yang mi shes mkhan rkyang yin thog sa/ tshan des nga dang nga'i slob grogs yongs la phan thogs byung yod/ yin na'ang / da lta nga la 'di'i thad

mjug mtha'i slob tshan thun gcig dang tshe gcig gi lag byang / 93du lta tshul gzhan pa zhig yod/ de ni dge rgan khong gis khrid gnang mdzad pa'i byed thabs gsum las snga ma gnyis kyi skor red/ dper na/ 'khrig pa'i skabs su 'gyig shubs bed :snad byed pa lta bur mtshon na/ gzhug phyogs khyim gcig gi bza' zla bya rgyur gtan lu'el zhing pan tshun reg dug gi na tsha lta bu med pa'i bden dpang byed thub tshe/ 'grig shubs bed ཿthod bya rgyur bdag mi 'thad/ gcig nas 'gyig shubs rgyadan pas nam rgyun lta ra 'khrig pa'i skabs su bde tshor de tsam cadang mi thub la/ gnyis/ nas mchan gcig la lusag thengs mang bo sgod tshe bud med kyi mtshan ma'i nang ngos su rma bzo gi yod/ der brten chang sa rgyag garten khel ba'am/ yang na chang sa brgyabs zin yang gnas skabs ring bu phrug mi dgose pa'i bza' zla rnams kyis 'gyig shubs bed spo da par dgos phan chen po med/ gnyis pa sman 'thung ba de red/ sman 'thung ba lta bur zlotshon na 'khrig pa ma spyad nga 'i sdon nas 'thung chog pa dang 'khrig pa spyad de zla mtshan ma/ bab tshe zla gcig dang zla phyed nang tshun du 'thung chog pa'i sman sogs sman sna rigs mi 'dra ba mang bo yod mod/sman mang bo bed spyad na mngal sdod la skyon 'byung srid nga sa gzhug phyogs phru gu chags mi thub pa'i nye na kha che bar brten/ de yang thabs lam bzang bo zhig ma red/ thabs lam bzang sgordzos ni skyes pa'i khu ba phyi ru 'don 'jug rgyu de red/de ni ches mchog tu gyur ba'i thabs lam gcig pu de red/ phyi gling ba ltar bur mtshon na khu ba de bud med kyi kha'i nang du gtor gyin yod la/ bud med tshos kyang re 'gas btung ba dang re 'gas phyi ru byo ba sogs byed kyin yod mod/ de ni ya rabs bzang sgod ldan pa'i nga tsho bod mi tshos spad bya ma yin snyam/ 'on kyang / nga tshos khu ba bud med kyi4 lus thos tu gtor ba dang / yang na sakhrog pa ma spyad gong nas bud med kyi 'og tu dar gos lardom po de 'dra btang ste/ khu ba 'byung skabs dar gos steng byo ba lta bu'i thabs

94 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/lam bed spyad chog de gnyis gang yin rung thabs lam bzang so gnyis yin mod/ bdag ni skyes pa'i khu ba bud sped kyi lus steng dang mtshan ma'i g.yas ga〈snan du gyo ba'i rigs la ha cang 'thad/ skyes pa'i khu ba bud med kyi lus steng du gtor skabs bud med kyi lus kyis de bde tshor zhig tu tshor thub la/ lus tshor des bud med de'i sems su rang dbang med par da ne 'khrig bde thob song snyam nga/'i tshor ba'ang 'byung rgyutsho ngo/da pas/ byed thabs 'di'i rigs la bcog mi lta ba dang 'khrig spyodad grub rjes khrus rgyag chog chog gi skabs su skyes pa tshos khu ba bud med kyi lus steng du gtor ba des kyang / bud med la mtha' ma'i bde skyid cig sbyin gyi yod snyam mo/ /'dir bud med kyi bud sdod sgo 'gog pa dang dpung steng du khab lasag pa/ skyes pa'i khu ba nus med du gtong ba serdzogs kyi thad nas kyang cung tsam gleng chog ste/ phran pa yul du yod skabs de ni rgya gzhung gis tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyis bud med rnams bzung song nas/ bud med rgan pa rnams la gtan nas skye sgo gcod pa dang gzhon nu ma rnams kyi bu snod sgor lca gas kyis kha gcod pa lta bu'i gshag bcos byed kyin 〈snad/ gshag bcos btang ste bu sdod sgor lcags kyi a long bzhag ste yun ring song rjes/ lcags zhi ste bud med kyi sha gseng du bzhur khu rnams khyab rjes nad rigs 'dra min bzo gin yod pa sa/de ni ches nyen kha can zhig red la/ de bzhin dpung steng du khab 'jog pa lta bur mtshon na/ khab de bzhag rjes zla mtshan dus thog mi yong ba lta bu'i dka' ngal rgyun ldan du 'phrad kyin yod skor bud med 'gas zer/ des na de yang thabs lam bzang sto zhig ma red/gzhan de ni skyes par gshag bcos byed pa dang khab brgyab ste skyes pa'i khu bar bu phrug sres spel gyi nus pa med pa bya rgyu de red/ de yang nyen kha che zheng gzhug sdudags bu phrug rgye spel byed dgos 'byung srid thog stabs nyes na 'dom gyi dbang bor gnod skyon shor

mjug mtha'i slob tshan thun gcig dang tshe gcig gi lag byang / 95te zhakhrig las byed mi thub par 'gyur srid pas/ de yang thabs lam bzang bo zhig min pas khu ba bud med kyi lus 〈snag tu gtor ba ni thabs kyi maglerdzog red snyam/mjug mthar de bas kyang ches mchog tu gyur ba'i thabs lam gcig ni bud med rang nyid la skyes pa'i khu ba phyir btsur ba'i nus pa ldan rgyu de red/ ngas phyi gling ba'i glog brnyan skor zhig las bud med tshos skyes pa'i khu ba btsur ste phyi ru byo ba mthong zhing / bud med tshang mar thabs rtsal de 'dzoms tshe mngal sbrum 'bosgog ni ches rang dbang ba zhig dang spyir btang ba zhig tu gyur song ba min nam snyam la/ yang dge 'dun chose 'phel mchog gis/ skyes nga 'i rkang gnyis rgyab nas mdun phyogs su/ /bud med brla yi 'og tu brkyang par bya/ /skabs 'gar bud med 'phong mgo zur du bsgyur/ /rkang pa gnyis ka skyes pa'i ga〈snan du bskyang / /de bzhin skabs 'gar g.yas su bsgyur bar bya/ /sbru ma pa 'bosgog la tshul 'di legs pa ste/ /'greng dang tsog pu'i 'khrig thabs kun kyang phan/ /bud med 'phong mabotho khri'u la bzhag nas/ /rkang pa gnyis ngo sa la phab ste bgrad/ /mo yi ro stod mtho bar gzengs bstod pa 'i/ /mdun nas skyes bu langs te bsgrod nga ra bya/ /'de dang 'dra ba'i sbyor /bas gzhan dag kyang / /sbrum nga 'gog la shin tu phan pa yin/ /mdor na skye sanas/ zur du kha phyogs shing / /liṅga ṅge ga'i 'og la 'gro ba dang / /mo yi sked pa mdun du ma gug pa 'i/ /sbyodar thabs kun kyang sbrum pa 'gog la phan/ /khu ba phyung ma thag tu bud med nyid/ /ya/ra 'a/ langs te rkang mthil sa la brdung / /bha ga chu dron dag gis bkra bar bya/ /'di yang sbrum nga/ 'gog la sman dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs yo/da nga sa mngal sbru ma 'gog gi skye bo rnams la cung zad tsam yang phan phyir du 'di ru bkod pa yin la/ gtso sto mngal sbrum 'gog gi skabs su gzhug phyogs bu snod sogs la skyon me 'byung ba'i thabs bsten rgyu ni gnad dam pacas/ /

96 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/blud med tsho/ chos nyid go ldog ma byed ang /nga btsan byol du 'byor rjes gzhi nas 'gro ba mi'i thob thang dang bud med kyi thob thang / byis pa'i thob thang lta bu'i tha snyad mang dag cig shes rtogs byung zhing / tha snyad de dag btsan byol spri tshogs khrod khyab shugs chen po yin pa tshor sdudang / lhag par du 'das pa'i lo 'je 'gar bud nad kyi thob thang skor gleng mkhan gyi bud med sngar 'a/sa je mang du 'gro bzhin pa mig mthong lag zin du gyur yod/ dha sar yod nga/'i bud med tshogs pa 'i dbus spyi khyab yig tshang dang sa gnas khag gi bud med tshogs pa sogs kyis btsan byol skyi/ tshogs khrod bud med kyi thob thang skor la zab sbyong yang mang dag cig sprad pa dang / bod nang du'ang bud med kyi thob thang skor la 'tshogs 'du bsdu ba dang bgro sgreng sogs byas dang byed mus red/ de ni bzang phyogs kyi 'gyur ba chen po zhig red la dus nam zhig nas bod rigs bud med rnams kyis kyang rang nyid kyi khe dbang srung skyob ngang / spyi tshogs 'a/ skyes nga dang 'dra mnyam gyis zhugs thub pa dang / nus pa 'don thub pa 'i snga ltas bzang bo zhig kyang red/ yin na'ang / bod gzhis byes gang yin rung bud med kyi thob thang rtsodi len byed mkhan gyi bud med pha la mo ches da dung bud med kyi dgos 'dun ngo ma dang khe dbang ngo ma/ thob thang ngo ma bcas rtsod kyin med par khong tshos dus

bud med tsho/chos nyid go ldog ma byed ang / 97rgyun bza' tshang gi don dag chung tshegs rigs kyi steng nas skyes pa dang bud med kyi thob thang rtsod kyin 'dug khong tshos thob thang gang zhig rang la 'thob rung ba dang / gal srid de 'thob na dge phan gang yod pa dang / thob thang gang zhig me 'thob kyang chog pa dang / de nges par rtsod mi dgos pa zhig yin min sogs kyi skor la dpyad zhib byed kyi mi 'dugadaper na/ bud med tshos rang gi khyo ga tshor kho mo tsho dang mnyam du gyon gos zhakhrud rgyu dang za ma g.yo rogs/ nang las byed rogs dang srang du 'gro rogs/ byis pa gnor slong byed rogs lta bu'i steng gi 'dra mnyam zhig las rtsod kyi mi 'dug bza' tshang zhis/ lha ngos nas bshad rnga lade yang do mnyam yong dgos sa zhig red/ 'on kyang / nga tshos lta rnya ngas mi 'dra ba zhig gi steng nas 'di'i thad du bsam gzhig byed chog ste/ skyes pa dang bud med kyi nus pa dang chos nyid kyi ngo po'i thog nas 'dir lta stangs ci zhig 'dzin min de gnad 'gag red/ gong gi gnad don de dag bza' tshang gi ngos nas bshad na gal chen yin yang des bud med tsho'i khe dbang ngo ma srung skyob byas med par ma zad/ bza' tshang bar du'ang 'gal 'du'i rigs mang du khyer yong gi yod/ de las bud med tshos skyes pas gang 'jon pa de ngas kyang 'jon gi yod la byed kyi yin zer dgos kyi 'dugaskyes pa tshos rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin bya thub na nga tsho yang yar langs nas rgya'/ khab kyi sred 'dzin stegs bu'i steng 'dzegs ki yin la/ btsan byol bod gzhung gi bka' blon khri pa'i go gnas kyang nged cag bud med kyis 'dzin gyi yin/ skyes pa tshos lus shugs ngal rtsol khrod gal che'i nus pa 'don na nga tsho yang skyes pa dang gcig mtshungs su bgrod thub pa bya rgyu yin/ skyes pa tshos shugs las dang drag las/ lus shugs ngal rtsol dang klad shugs ngal rtsol gang 'dra zhig byas kyang nga tshos kyang de ltar byed kyi yin/ zhes yar langs dbosgos kyi 'dugade ni khyed kyis khyim gzhi chung chung zhig gi 'dra mnyam rtsod pa 'a sa

98 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams /tshad mtho ru phyin yod la/bud med kyi khe dbang ngo ma dang thob thang ngo ma brtsad pa zhig kyang yin/skabs rer bud med chos nga la 'di lta bu zhig bshad kyin pa'i snang ba 'byung gi 'dug dper na/ skyes pa tsho langs nas gcin pa gtong gi 'dug pas nga cho ya/nga langs nas gcin pa gtong gi yin/ nga tshor zla mtshan 'bab kyin 'dug pa/sa skyes pa tshor yang cig 'bab dgos kyi 'dug nga tshor mngal mi sbrum par de'i tshab tu skyes pa tshor mngal sbrum ste/ nga tshos bu phrug skye spel skabs kyi sdug bsngal kun skyes pa tshos tshusgong dbothos kye 'dug sogs snyam gyi med dam snyam/ yang gcig bshad na nga la 'di lta bu'i ku re rtsed mkhan gyi bu mo mang so byung / de'i phyi ra ngas ji ltar bsam ya/nga bud med tshos cherngom nyid dang mi mthun pa'i bud med kyi thob thang zhig la/sa rtsod kyi mi 'dug la/ pho mo 'dra mnyam zer dus lus sems kyi dka' gnad tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin pa zhig la go ba che/na bzhin med dam snyam/ yin na'ang / de ni mi srid pa zhig red/ dper na/ dud 'gro'i rang dbang tshogs chung gi mi zhig gis nga tshor da nas bzung nga 62) nyam thag sems can dud 'grerdzo rnams/ la rang dbang spyod 'os/ khong tshos smra shes shing don mi go ba tsam las nga tsho dang 'dra bar skye dga' na 'che'i sdug bsngal sku da pa gcig mtshungs yin stabs/ nga tsho'i 'tsho rten dang kha zas su spyod rgyur snying rje mi skye 'am zhes brjod na brjod stangs legs ngo zhig yin mod/ mi des nyam chung dud 'gro rnams kyi khe dbang dang rang dbang srung skyob ched du sang nyin nas nga tsho'ang langs nas mi 'gro bar gog nas 'gro ba dang zas mi za bar rtswa za ba/ 〈snan gos mi gyodan par cer bur bud nas 'gro 'os zhes brjod tshe/ nga tshos mi de ni rnam rig bor ba'i skyo dan pa zhig red ces lan 'debs srid/ rgyu mtshan khos nga tshor 'chad 'chad po thams cad 'jig rten gyi nyid chos dang gnas lugs la 'gal 〈snad pas sete/ /
