bud med tsho/chos nyid go ldog ma byed yong / 99der brten/ ngas rlabs che ba'i bod rigs bud med rnams la zhu rgyur/ 'jig rten bkod pa pos nga tsho skyes pa nas bzung rang rang gi chos nyid logs su dgar yod la/skyes pa'i pho mtshan phyi ru 'bur du bcugs pa dang bud sped kyi mo mtshan nang du sdud par byas pa/ skyes par chags sred rgyas skabs 'dom gyi dbang bo gyen la langs pa dang bud med la chags sred rgyas skabs 'dom nas g.ya' chu 'dzegs pa / skyes pa'i rleg sgo nga gnyis phyi ru bzhag pa dang bud med kyi rlig sgong gnyis nang du bcug pa/ bud med la zla mtshan 'bab cing lus kyi sha 'jam la mnyen pa dang / skyes par zla mtshan med pa ra lus kyi sha mkhregs la gyong ba/ bud med kyi brang khar 'o 'dzin 'bur du btod nga dang skyes par ming tsam du bzhag pa lta bu dag ni rang bzhin lhan skyes su yod pa'i pho mo'i lus kyi khyad par dag red/ de bzhin skyes pa tsho chung dus nas cung gtum spyod kyi rang bzhin can dang drag las byed par dga' ba/ stobs shugs che zhing snying stobs che ba/ bud med rnams de las ldethog ste stobs shugs chung zhing snying chung ba/ byams sems can dang zhib tshags pa bcas sems gshis kyang logs su dgar 〈snad/lhag par du ngas rlabs che ba'i bod rigs bud med rnams la gsal bor zhu rgyur/ khyed tshos pho mo gnyis la 'dra mnyam gyi thob thang yod pa dang 'dra mnyam gyi gshis sperdzod ldan pa/ 'dra mnyam gyi 'du shes shugs drags ma/rdzod pa'i phyi gleng ba'i bza' zla mang je'i nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi 'gro stangs sdod lugs dag rtogs/ sam/ yang na khong tsho'i khyim tshang nang dgod sgra dang bde skyid ldan min rtogs sam/ tha na khong tshos rtsod kyin pa 'i bud med kyi thob thang dang khyed tshos rtsod kyin pa'i bud med kyi thob thang bar do mi nyams pa'i gnad don tshabs chen lhag 'dug pa mthong ngam/ phyi gling ba'i bza' zla mang bos 'dra mnyam gyi bsam blo dang 'dra mnyam gyi kun spyodad 〈snags gtso sor 'dzin pa 'a/sa khyim tshang

/00 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/gi bde skyed ngo ma de rnyed gi sped/khyo gar phyi nas las ngal ji ltar che rung phyir nang du 'byor dus khos rang nyid 'a zas gamatho dgos nga las/ chung mas ga〈sna rogs mi byed la/ kho gnyis kyis rang rang gi za ma rang rang gis g.yo/ rang rang gi gyon gos rang rang gis lubrud cing / nang las yod tshad dbye mtshams lta ra rang rang gis las/ mthar brnyan 'phrin la blta ba dang deb klog skabs kyang rang rang gi khang mig chung ngu'i re'i nang du 'dzul nas blta klog byed pa ma zad/ za khang zhig tu zas za ru phyin skabs kyang rang rang gi zas rin rang rang gis spyod/khong gnyis bar na bza' tshang gi 'brel thag cig 'byud pa ni 'khrig spre da kyi las kho na tsam yin/ dha sar yod pa'i sa le rgyal rnying gras shig sngon chad phyi gling ba'i bud med cig dang chang sa brgyabs te phyi rgyal du song nas lo gcig bsdad rjes/ phyi mo der bza' 'thor byed dgos byung ste phyir dha sar yong ba dang / de'i rjes bod rigs bud med cig 'a/ chang sa thengs gnyis pa brgyabs te bsdad yod/ khos nga la bshad rgyur/ ji ltar bshad rung da ni bod mo zhig chung mar reg rnya bas ga dus/ phyi nas nang du thon na'ang khyim du drod lam per 'dug 'a// cig za tsha ga snurmeg dang 'thung chesgog ceteg tu 'dug ma zad byedan bothos rnams kyang gang nas phud nas gang la g.yu/ga kyang sang nyin gtsang dag yang dag cig tu nyar 'dug pas bza' tshang yerdzod pa'i skyid cig 'dug / ces zer/de bzhin bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa sa tshe ring don grub lags kyis/ /bkra shis lha mosna dang mnyam du bsdad pa nas blo bzang rgya mtsho'i khyim du sa rdul skyag rdul nyin mo ra babs na phyi dror phyags pa dang mtshan lngasnar babs na snga dror phyags pa/ 〈snan gos rnying hril 'ga' 'o bltabs na yod pa/ za 'bru khug ma 'ga' sa gral bsgrigs nas yo/da pa/

bud med tsho/chos nyid go ldog ma byed mang / 10/zas 1stod gasku'o chas 'ga' bosto nam yang gtsang mar 'esgod pa/ las ka mtshams bzhag ma thag byis pa tshos brgyabs pa'i sbra steng gi rdo ba rnams blangs nas thab gar me sbar te drod lam mer 'dug pas na/ ’'jig rten lubor ba bdud kyi btson rar rlom pa'i blo bzang rgya mtsho'ang khyim la 'dzul ma thag shes nad tshor med ngang gdong gi sdug nyams dang lus kyi ngal dub yal te sems khong drod lam mer 'gyur nges red// ces zer/gong gi dpe mtshon de rlung dmar 'ur 'ur gyi shog ngos 266 dang 267 steng gsang la/ rtsom pa so khong gis rig gnas/ gsar brje'i skabs blo bzang rgya mtsho dang bkra shis lha re gnyis kyis chang sa rdzun ma brgyabs nas mnyam du 'dug khul byas te/ blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sdom pa mu mthung srung bsdad pa'i skor zhig bzhengs skru na byed skabs kyi dum tshan thung ngu zhig red mosnad/ des nga tsho la bde skyid dang phun sum chogs nga 'i 'tsho ba zhig gi zur ngos shig dmar rjen du bstan yod/des na ya rabs dang bzang spyod ldan pa'i rlabs che ba'i bod rigs bud med rnams/ khyed tshos kyang 'di lta bu'i 'tsho ba la smon gyi 'dug gam/ ngas bsam na khyed tshos tan tan dgod sgra dang bde skyid kyis khengs pa'i 'cho ba la yid smon skye gi red/de'i phyir du sod kyi gdod ma'i bsam blo ltar khyed cag ge bsam blo dang 'gro 'dug smra brjod rang dbang bcas 'phrogs pa ni lugs mthun zhig ma red mod/ khyed cag ges khyim las bsgru ba ste rang gi skyes par zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang / skyes nga sa 'jon pa skyes par bsgrub tu 'jug rgyu dang skyed mas bsgrub 'os pa/ dag rang gi bde skyed dang khyem gyi bde skyid ched du bsgrub pa ra 'os/ de bzhin 'dir skyes pa tshor zhu 'dod pa zhig la bud med lasan thang can dang shes rab can/ bsam bshad sgrub phod kyi steng stobs can dang

102 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/spyi tshogs thog sgod sgo che ba dang / gzhan don dang gzhung don ched rang gzhi'i 'gan stse ha cang lci ba'i rbad med rigs kyi skyes pa tshos khong tshor dus nas dus su rgyab skyor dang da pung rogs/ stobs shugs stsol rgyu ni gal che'i don snying chen po ldan yod ces skul snyeng 'dod/ngas pha yul lta bur mtshon na nang las ye da tshad bud med tshos sgrub pa las skyes pa tshos mi sgrub la/ phyi'i las don mtha' dag skyes pas sgrub nga las bud med kyis the gtogs de tsam me byed/ mgron po zhig nang du slebs skabs sgo'i phyi khyim kun tu gtsang sbra mi dod pa dang / ja ldud chog chog dang zas za chog chog med pa/ ca lag rnams go rim med par yar 'jog mar g.yug byas yod tshe phal cher de tshang gi bud med rnams khyim las la mi mkhas pa dang / 'jon thang med pa ra cha 'grog pa yin/ yang nang gtsang sbra dag cing ca lag gang 〈snad pa rnams go rim legs nga ra bsgrigs pa ma zad/ 'od kyi ler gtsang dag yang dag tu nyar tshegs byas yod na'ang / nang du ca dngos nyung ba dang deng rabs kyi 'bod stan/ mdun cog dang sgrog tse/ brnyan 'phrin dang kha par sogs kyi mkho chas mi ldan tshe skyes pa de 'jon med nus med cig tu bgi des rang bzhin gyis skyes pa dang bud med gnyis bar gyi las ka dang lasan thang logs su dgar yod/khyed tshos bsam blo gnad du phobs la bsam gzhig cig byos dang / btsan gyo'/ spyi tshogs lta bur mtshon na bud med kyi thob thang skyes pa las lhag pa med kyang sdug pa med/ lhag par du btsan gyol du skyes shing 'tshar ba'i na gzhon tsho'i mig nang du bud med rnams rgya gar gyi bud med ltar gong bkur bya yul dang gces skyong bya yul du gyur yod/khyed tsho slob grwar 'gro ba'i go skabs 'dra mnyam thog thob kyi yod la 'jon thang ngom pa'i

bud med tsho/chos nyid go ldog ma byed ang / /03go skabs kyang 'dra mnyam yin/ tha na rang gis blor su babs na de dang chang sa rgyag chog pa dang mi mang nang skad cha bshad pa / khyim tshang nang gros mgo 'don pa sogs rang rang la 'gron thang ldan tshe/ dga' ldan khri la bdag po med pa'i dpe/ ltar bud med kyi thob thang brgya cha brgya khyed tsho'i lag mthil du 〈snad/yang khyed tshos mang so zhig gis 'di ltar brjod srid de nga tshos las ci zhig byas rung mi kha las thar gyi mi 'dug la/ 'phya smod dang brnyas bcos byas yong gi 'dug nga tshor mgo yar 'degs pa'i skal ba til 'bru tsam yang ster gyi mi 'dug ces zer srid/de lta bu'i skad cha bshad mkhan dag ni sod nas gsar du 'byor ma thag pa'i bud med tsho'i khrod du mang bo yod cing / ngas tshags sgostog dang dus deb/ dra rgya sogs las bud med skor zhig gis bud med kyi thob thang rtsod pa dang de'i 'gal rkyen gleng ba'i skor la lta nyan byas shing / khong tsho'i sems kyi phyi nang gsang gsum klog gin ye da pas besgong gi skad cha de lta bu god sas byung / yin na'ang / mi kha dang 'phyad smod skyes pa tshor yang 'dra mnyam gyis phog gin yod cing / gal srid nga tshos tan tan tig tig gis de lta bu'i 'chal gtam dang rgyab bshad rgyag mkhan dag su yin rtsad gcod byas tshe/ stabs nyes na pho mo gnyis las mos brgya cha mang ba zin yong ba de yin/ de ltar yin tshe bud med tshos rang nyid la lcags sgrog brgyab pa las skyes pa tshor nga tsho la thob thang mi 'dug dang / mabotho 'gyogs mi 'jug gi lta bu'i skad cha dag bshad mtshams zhog la/ da ni rang gis bsgrab 'os pa dag bsgrub par 'bod cig sude las gzhis bzhugs bud nad rnams la mtshon na dus rabs nyer gcig pa/'i bud med cig tu skyes pa stabs legs pa zhig red mod/ bod gdod ma'i bsam blo'i

/04 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/'ching rgya las de tsam 〈snal med pa'i spyi tshogs shig tu skyes pa ni tshogs ma bsags pa rang red/ khong tsho phal cher skyes dus nas 'gro ba mi'i smra brjod rang dbang dang chos lugs dad mos rang dbang sogs rgya gzhung la 33ra zin yod la/ bud med kyi thob thang dang khe dbang sogs kyang bod kye gdod ma'i bsam blo dang goms gshis kyis phrogs tshar yod/ khong tsho ni dngos gnas sdug bsngal nyis/ brtsegs can dang mnar gcod 'thol ba myong mkhan gye bud med khyu zhig yin/ khong tshos mgo so bsgu ra nas khyim las byed pa dang mgron po tshur 'ong gi bsu ma dang pha ra 'gro'i skyel ma/ nang gi rgas lubogs/ rnams la zhabs phyi hur thag gis bsgrub pa dang byis pa tshor byams pas/ skyethong rgyu/ sgo'i phyi khyim bar gyi las ka byed pa sdudags rjesags mtha' bral ba'i la sa ka rkyang la mabesna 'khor rgyu las mtho brgal gyi bsam blo zhig gtong thub kyi ched/ de lta ra mtho brgal gyi bsam blo zhig gtong ba'i go skabs kyang ye nas me sprod/ tha na rang nyid la 'os shing 'tsham/ nga 'i khyo ga zhig kyang gdam dbang med pa ra pha ma dang gnyen nye tshos su tshang 'a/ bag mar byin na de tshang la 'grerdzo dgose/ gal srid stabs ma legs par khong tsho'i pha mas khong tsho rgyu chen dang dpon tshang zhig gi rdzongs pa mang so zhig dang brjes yo/da tshe khong tsho pha la cher de tshang dzopa las gaskusgog cig tu btang ba dang gcig mtshungs red/ phar de tshang la bag mar byin na'ang bud med kye thob thang dang khe dbang srung skyob kyi thob thang med pa gcig mtshungs yin thoganyin ltar las kur 'jug dgos pa dang / tha na khyim tshang gi las don che ma chung gsum gang gi thad du'ang khong tshor kros kha bsdur sa'i gnas med par 'byud tshad skyes nga tshos thag gcod byed la/ skyes pa tshos thag gcod gang byas pa de 'grig na'ang nyan dgose la ma 'grig na'ang nyan dbothos/ de ltar gzhis bzhugs bud med rnams la mtshon na bud med kyi thob thang gtan nas med/

bud med tsho/chos nyid go ldog ma byed ang / /05 khyim tshang zhig la bu gcig dang bu mo gcig 〈snad tshe bu de slob grwar gtong ba las bu mo de mi gtong / de ni bu mo de slob grwar btang yang bu ltar slob sbyong la 'bras bu 'thob rgyu dang / gzhug phyogs 'tsho don sde don skyong mkhan zhig tu 'gyur mi srid pa lta bur ngos 'dzin byas pas red/ de'i rjes khong gnyis nar son te khyim gzhi 'dzin pa'i dus su slebs pa na bu de khyim tshang de'i shul 'dzin du nyar la bu mo mna' mar gtong / de yang bu mo ldar khyim shul 'dzin pa'i nus shugs ldan med pa dang gal srid kho mor khyim shul 'dzin du bcug che/ ṇitshe mo'i khyed ga'am mag pa'i lag tu dbang 'a〈snar rgyu yin stabs/ mag pa bzang bo zhig min na pha ma gnyis sdug la gtod sridapa dang / bu mo'ang mag pa 'i dbang shugs 'og shor te pa mar lta skyong byed par dka' ngal 'byung srid nga sa pha shul bu yis 'dzin 'jug gi yod/ de yang bud med la mthong chung dang pho mchog gi mo dman gyi lta tshul bzung ba zhig las ci ya/nga ma red/'on kyang / da lta dus kyi 'gyur 'gros dang bstun nas de yang je lhod dang je bzang du 'gro bzhin yod la/ bod rigs bud med rnams dka' ngal gyi gnas 'di las myur du grol thub par bdag gis yid ches gtsang ma zhu/ yin na'ang 'dir gtso bo bod nang gi bud med kyi gnas bab dang bod byes kyi bud med kye thob thangaganyis bar na gnam sa lta bu'i khyad par yod pas/ byes kyi bud med rnams kyis de shes par gyitshos la/ longs su spyod cig ces nan gyis skul snying 'dod/

106 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/myosal rgyab kyi blud med tsho'i sems gshis/mi su yin rung rang rang gi sems na gsang ba re yod la/ gsang ba 'ga' zhig nges par du gsang dgos nges rigs yin pas mu mthud du gsang bar rigs/ yang gsang ba 'ga' zhig ni bshad rgyur ngo tsha ba tsam las bshad me rung ba'i gras min/ nga yang de ltar yin te nga la nga'i sems kyi gsang ba yod la/ bshad rung ba dang mi rung ba'i gsang ba mang bo yod/ 'on kyang / 'dir dgod bro la zhim mngar ldan pa 'i gsang ba 'ga' zhig ngas ngo tsha spangs nas dmar rjen du bshad na khyed tsho klog mkhan tshor spro snang 'phel bar che(ga gzhug phyongags nga tsho'i 'khrig las thad kyi gsang ba mang tsam rtogs pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur ba dang lhag par du bud med kyi sems gshis ngo 'phrod pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar 3snags gnas ga ge mosna zhig nas nga dang 'grogs yun thung ba'i bud med cig gis 'khrig pa sbyad pa yin/ nyin der phyi rol du char ba shag shag gis 'bab bzhin 'dug la/nged gnyis gcig pus nang du kha brda byed kyin yod/ kho mo mal khri'i steng nyal te gnyid khug 'dod yod tshul bshad mod/ don la gnyid 'bab kyi mi 'dug pas kho mo'i go rgyu yod pa'i skad cha de nga'i sems la zug song / kho mo nyal khri'i steng gan rgyal du nyal te mig gis hrig hrig tu nga la lta bzhin mu mthud go rgyu yod pa'i skad cha sna tshogs bshad par ma zad/ nga la dga' bo yod med dang kho mor dga' bo yod na'ang phan tshun la brtseb

bud med tsho/chos nyid go ldog ma byed ang / /07de tsam med tshul/ mtshan mor slebs thengs rer skyes pa mang bos kha par btang ste gnyid yag so khug tu mi 'jug tshul sogs brjod/skabs de dag tu ngas sems su rang dbang med par kho mo dang 'khreg nga/'i bde bar rol 'dun las kho mos bshad kyin pa'i skad cha dag kyang skabs rer go gi 'dug la/yang skabs rer go thub kyi mi 'dug nga ni chags pas rab tu myos shing 'dom gyi dbang bo gyen la mkhregs por langs byung bas/ ga ler kho mo'i mal khri'i zur du bsdad de mig gis kha thug tu kho po'i gdong la gtad nas blta bzhin tshonged gnyis mnyam du gnyid khug chog / ces brjod/kho mo phar tsam nur te nga la zur du nyal chog pa'i brda bstan byung / nga kho mo'i zur du nyal bzhin rkang pa g.yas pa kho mo'i rkang nga gnyis kyi steng rnos pha ra bsrings pa dang / lag pa g.yas pa'ang kho mo'i brang gzhung nas bsring te phar phyogs kyi rtsibs ma'i 'og nas tshur 'jus/ kho mos mu mthud skad cha bshad kyin nga'i ci byed la snang dogs de tsam med pa'i khul byed/de nas ga ler kho po'i mchu sgros snying rje bo'i steng kha zhig bskyal bas kho mo gzhi nas gnyid las zad pa ltar/ yag ngo byas nas nyal rogs/ de lta ra ma byed/ ces zer bzhin nga bkag byung mod/ skabs der nga'i sems ni rnyi las thar ba'i rta mchog ci bzhin mu mthud kho mo'i mdzes sdug gi lang tsho'i rtswa thang du bang gis rgyug bzhin 'dug cing / kho mor mu mthud du kha skyel ba dang 'phur mnyed kyi mabo brtsams/yin na'ang / bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la bud med 'di ni dngos gnas dgod bro 'o zhig ste/ kha nas de ltar ma byed dang / bcog pur sdod/ ngas skad rgyag gi yin dang go'u ce'u/ zer bzhin skabs rer bkag 'gog byed pa dang / phar kha skyel

108 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/skabs ske phar gcu tshur gcu byas te g.yerdzol thabs byed mod/ yang mtshams rer tshur kha smel ba dang 'phur mnyed byed pas nga nee kho mo mos mthun yod med la the tshom skye dgos byeng mod/ dge chos mchog gis ngo tshas dar kha tsam gyis bsgribs pa ste/ /cung zad 'bad na rang zhal rjen par ston/ /zhes pa'i tshig de dran te mu mthud du kha skyel ba dang gakhrig gtam brjod pa/ 'phur mnyed byed pa sogs kyi las byas/ skabs de dag tu kho mos mtha' gcig tu nga la 'besnag 3snal mi byed pa des nga la'ang mu mthud u tshugs cung tsam byas tshe 'bras bu 'byung rgyu yin pa'i re ba bstan byung /de ltar ngas kho mo'i stod gos dang rkang thung / gsang dor sogs re re bzhin gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis 'phud dus khong mos ming tsam gyis 'gog rgol re byed zhor min dang yun zhes 'khun sgri chung ngu re'ang 'byin 'ong / de ni btsan g.yem byas pa zhig red zer na kho mor yang 'dod pa 'dug la/ ma red zer na kho mos mtha' gcig tu mos mthun ma byas stabs ngas u tshugs cung tsam byed dgos byung / de lta ra nged gnyis 'khrig spyod kyi las la dngos su zhugs na'ang / kho mos skabs rer slo bur du 'khrig nga sgod mtshams ladrog tu bcug ste da 'grig song zer la/ yang skabs rer sakhrog rgyo da dang /brel ba ye nas med pa'i gleng mol lta bu byed/ mig gis yar lta mar lta byed pa dang sems pa zhakhrig spyod kyi steng du mi 'bab nga ra phye ma leb ltar yar 'phur mar 'a phur byed kyin 'dugade lta bu'i bya spyod dag gis nga la zhakhrig spyod kyi bde ba myong bar bar chad chen po byas/ khosto mdzer mtshon nas bshad na 'khrig pa'i skabs su sems rnal du phabs nas 'khrig bde myong bar mi 'bad par bsam med kyi byis pa zhig dang mtshungs par 'dugaganyig spyod grub rjes kho mos mgo 'o nga'i brang khar brnyes te snying gtam sna tshogs

yol rgyab kyi bud med tsho'i sems gshis/ 109bshad/ tshul des nga la khyed kyis nga btsan g.yem ma byas par nged gnyis gnyis mosi byung ba yin zhes brda spyod kyin pa lta bu'i tshor ba sbyon yong /skabs 'dir slebs skabs nga rang 'obyu na chung dus zheng bo zhig gis bshad tshusgong ba'e skad cha zhig yid la wa ler dran byung ste/ nga'i zhing bos bshad rgyur/ thengs shig nga rang ming la /rdo zer ba'i bud med cig gi sar pho nyul du song ba yin/ rum du 'dzul ma thag nas phar rgyug dang min zhes bkag 'gog byed kyin 'dug mod/ nga kho mo/ 'i steng bud pas slo bur du lhod kyig ger gyur song ba ma zad/ 'khrig rtsal la byang chub pa zhig red 'dug yin na'ang / dgod bro ba zhig la 'khrig skyedad grub ste zur du nya'/ ma thag slar yang phar rgyug dang mi dgos zer nas 'khrig pa ma sgod pa'i sngon gyi bya spyod dag mngon byung / bud nad zer ba 'di dngos gnas bshad sherngopha pa mi 'dug zer/ zhing bo'i gtam rgyud de dang gong gi ngas bshad pa'i gtam rgyud 'di gnyis cung 'dra so 'dug la/dngos gnas bud med kyi sems khams zer ba 'de dgod spyad cig red/sde min da dung bud nad la 'khrig spyod brten dus dgod bro ba'i tshor snang yong ba dang / bshad 'dod nas mid sgor 'tshang yong ba'i gtam rgyud 'ga' bshad rgyu yod kyang sdudags gzhan zhig nas bsam dus/ bshad rin chen po mi 'dug pas mu mthud de mi gleng bar ga yin na'ang / gong gi rtsom yig 'di las 'grel 'dod pa ni bud med kyi sems gshis rtogs dka' ba de yin/ lha ga par du sod rigs bud sped kyi sems gshis de yin/sngon chad nga nyo phyogs mon sto 'dod rgu gling du sdod skabs nga la khams phyogs kyi bud med dga' rogs shig yod/ kho mor dgod bro ba'i gtam rgyud cig bshad rgyu 'dug

/10 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/ kho mothos bshad don/ thengs shig skyes pa zhig gis kho resnar kha par btang ste re skul/ zhig zhus song / skabs der kho mo bcun ma gnyis dang chang sa brgyabs zin nga/'i bud med rgan pa zhig bcas mnyam du skusgod/ kho mor kha par 'phang ma/khan gyi skyes pa des kho por khyod kyis nga'i kha par la nyan bsdad pa'i chog de min gyi re ba gzhan med zer bas kho mos kha par gyi sgra phyi logs su btang ste khong tsho bzhi sos nyan pañtsa da/ skyes pa des da lta nga khrus khang du yod la ngas rang nyid kyi lag pas rang nyid la bya ba byed rgyu yin pas khyed kyis kha par ma gsod rogs/ da dung rab byung na khyed kyis nga la skad re rgyag rogs zer bzhin khos 'khun sgra 'byin mgo brtsamos song bas/ der yod kyi btsun ma gnyis las gcig skyu ga mer langs te gsang spyod du skyug pa skyug tu byin song /tsho zhes brjod/ de ni na gzhon rtsom pa bo shes rab dar rgyas lags kyis bud med cig gcer bur bud nas 'gro skabs skyes pa zhig gis mthong skabs chags sred rgyas te 'dug bzod mi bde ba 'byung srid na'ang / skyes pa zhig gcer bur bud nas 'gro skabs bud med cig gis mthong na sde las ldog ste skyug mer langs pa sogs 'byung srid ces gsungs/ pa ltar/ 'di ni skyes/ nga dang tha dad kyi shud med tsho'i sems gshis de red/ gal srid skyes ṅge zheg yin na de rta bu'i bya sbyo/da dag phyi la mngon mi srid/

yol rgyab kyi bud med tsho'i sems gshis/ 1/ /mal gyi bde ba 'aḥṭāl ba/gcig mtshan gnyis ma ning zer ba ci zhig red /nyin 'ga'i sngon ngas 'khrig spyod skor gyi glog brnyan zhig la bltas shing / glog brnyan de'i nang mtshan gnyis ma ning 'gas phan tshun la 'khrig spyod byed kyin 'dug spyir gdong dbyibs dang gzugs byad/ brang gi nu rdog ngag gi gdangs sogs gang la bltas kyang bud med cig ge ngo bor grub 'dug kyang / mi gcig sa ni mtshan ma pho mtshan yin pa de red/ khong tsho'i pho mtshan des skyes pa'i pho mtshan gyi byed nus dang gcig pa zhig 'don thub kyi 'dug cing / khong tsho'i khrod kyi re zung gi pho mtshan 'greng pa'i tshe na mkhregs shing ring ba dang khu ba phyung skabs kyang pho ltar red mod/ re zung la pho mchan zhig yod pa tsam las 'greng rgyu mi 'dug yin na'ang / sngon chad ngas mtshan gnyis ma ning zer ba 'di la pho mtshan mo mtshan gnyis yod pa'i khar/ b.ragang lam yang yo/da nges bsam yo/da mod/ de ring gi glog brnyan de'i nang gi bud med de tshor pho mtshan dang bshang lam ma gtogs mo mtshan mi 'dug pa tshor rjes/ ngas dra rgya'i thog mtshan gnyis ma ning skor gyi dra rgya gang yod rtsad gcod byas shing / dra rgya mang bo zhig la bltas rjes bud med mtshan gnyis ma ning tshor pho mtshan zhig dang bshang lam las resto mtshan mi 'dug pa shes rtogs byung / gcig byas na pho mtshan mo mtshan gnyis ka 〈snad thog bshang lam skusgod mkhan yang

/12 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/yod srid mod/ da lta'i char mtshan gnyis ma ning zer ba 'di la'ang bshang lam dang pho mtshan las med pa zhig las ma mthong / khong tsho'i skad dang gzugs byad/ brang gi nu ma/ sems khams de bud med lta bu zhig tu grub pa tsam las/ bud med cig ma red/ pho red ces brjod kyang mi chog pa ci yang mi 'dug pho la'ang pho mtshan las lhag pa'i rtags mtshan ci yang med mod/ gtso so phyi'i rnam 'gyur dang nu dog lta bu'i byed nus re zung tsam ma 'dra ba zhig red 'dugagang ltar nga tshos bshad stangs ltar na phyi gling gi mi 'di tsho mi byed dgu byed la mkhas shing / 'khreg spyoted zer dus skyes pa pho mo rgan gzhon med pa ra mkhas pa'i yangs rtser zin yod stabs/ mtshan gnyis ma ning 'di tshos kyang rang nyid bud med byed 'dod skabs bshang lam du zhakhrig pa spyod kyin 'dug la/ de ni nub phyogs su yongs grags su song 'dug pa zhig kyang red/ de min khong tsho pho byed 'dod skabs pho mtshan bed sbyod kyis sakhrog spyod brten bzhin 'dug la/ zhakhrig pa sbyod stangs dang khu ba 'byin stangs/ pho mtshan gyi mkhregs 'dug sogs tshang ma skyes pa pho dang gcig mtshungs red/ spyir bud med mtshan gnyis ma ning 'di tshos skye sa pa tsho'i bshang lam du nyakhrig spyod brten pa dang /nub phyogs pa'i skyes pa tshos khong tsho'i mtshan ma nu ba dang khu ba 'thung ba sogs ni cung rnam pa gsar ba zhig red ces brjod 〈snag la/ de yang nub phyogs pa'i sbyi tshogs khrod nas rnam pa gsar ba zhig red zer ba las/ bod la mtshon na nga'i rtsom yig 'di yang rnam pa gsar bar gyur yo/da do/ /gang lta ra mtshan gnyis ma ning zer yang chogapo zir yang chogamo 'ur yang chogapho mtshan las nu ma med na pho dngos gnas shig red 'a// mo mtshan med kyang brang gi nu rdog

mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba /13dang skad gdangs sogs kyis mo zhig red ces brjod chog mthar gtugs na mtshan gnyes ma ning zhig red/ khong tsho nga tshos ngos 'dzin bzhin pa'i mtshan ma gnyis ldan gyi mtshan gnyis ma ning zer ba de'i 'khrul gzhi ru bdag gis 'dod pas 'di ni dpyad gzhir phul ba tsam yin no/ /gnyis/ shar nub kyi dud med kyi 'khrig smyon byed thabs/nub lhungags pa'i mi phal che ba gzugs rnyasnabs che zhing mtshan ma ni che thag :thod re 'dug cing / bud med tsho yang pho mchan chen po can gyi skyes pa dang gnyig spyod rgyun ring so brten dgos mkhan gyi gras rkyang rkyang red la/ khong tshor shar phyogs pa'i sakhrog spyod byed pa'i lam nas 'khrig pa spad na/ tshims rgyu zhig skusnad mi srid/ de bzhin shar phyogs pa tsho ni gzugs stobs chung snang nyam chung ba dang / zhakhrig sbyod kyi las dgos kyang de'i dka' gnad yongs su mi rtogs pas nub phyogs pa zhig gis gnyig pa spyad tshe/ de ni tshe 'dir brjed mi rung ba'i rtsache'i dus yun zhig yin nges yang / dper na/ e sha ya/'i bud med phal che bar 'khrig sbyordzod byed mkhan de pho mtshan chen po can zhig gam/ thabs lam 'dra min sna tshogs la byang ba can zhig yin tshe/ khong tsho hang hang sang byed cing /zhakhrig pa'i skabs bzod du med pa'i na zug ster la/ re 'ga' sdug thug nas ngu ba'ang yang nas yang du yong gi 'dug mod/ nub phyogs pa'i bud med tsho ni pho mtshan ci tsam gyis che zhing / 'khrig thabs ci tsam gyis mang na de las skyid cig gang na yod/ khong tshos mi rigs nag po pho mtshan bong bu'i pho mtshan lta bu can 〈snad mkhan de tsho dang mnyam du gzeg sbyod brten thabs byed pa dang / dngos su rta dang bong bu/ 'gyig sna tshogs kyis

//4 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/bzos pa'i pho mtshan che ru che tshul la brten gyi 'dug mi nag de tsho'i pho mtshan de ltar che zhing spom na'ang / khong tsho'i rang gi mtshan ma'i nang du 'jug bcug ste/ 'khrig bde'i bro ba zhig myong thabs la brtson zhing / 'u'ig spyod kyi bde skyid mthar thug pa zhig 'thob nga/ra brtson gyen yod/ ( tshan rig pas bud med kyi mo mtshan che chung thad spyir btang san ḍi smi ḍar rangal nas 6khul bar yin par 'grel / )de ltar red de/ bod gcig pu rjes lus nas yang lus su kyusgyur ba tsam las deng skabs rgya nag dang ko ri ya// nyi hong sogs su'ang zhakhrig spyod kyi bya ba gal chen du 'dzin nga dang / de'i skor gyi glog brnyan brgya phrag brgal bar lta rgyu 'dug cing / dra rgya yang bklag mi tshar ba'i tshod du 'dug mod/ de dag las 'khrig pa sperdzod stangs ni nub phyogs pa las ring du brgal ceng / gong du brjod pa ltar skyes pa pho ma~Xn chen po can tshos 'khrig las byed skabs rigar phyogs ma tshor na zug ma bzod pa'i sdug bsngal las/ bde ba zhig myong gi med tshod red bsam bsam yang yang skyes yerdzong gi 'dug dper na/ ngas bltas myong ba'i glog brnyan skor zhig las nub phyogs nga/'i skyes pa pho mtshan chen po can dag gis shar phyogs pa'i bud med dag la spyod skabs bud med de tshos ma khar so btabs te/bzod du med pa'i na zug cig myong bzhin pa las bde skyid cig tshor du med pa'i snang ba sbyon yong gi 'dug la/ khong tsho'i skad de yang ngu skad cig yin thog gzugs po 3khum 'gro ba las nub phyogs pa'i bud med ltar lus sems gnyis stod du bab te/ 'khrig pa'i thog blo sems rtsegacig tu sgri ma pa lta bu zhig ma red/ nub phyogs ma tsho'i mtshan ma shar phyogs ma'i mtshan ma las che ba dang dam lhod ran min gang ltar yang / 'khrig rtsal la byang chub pa des khong tsho mnyam du 'khrig sperdzod brten mkhan la khyad du 'phags nga 'i tshor bde dmigs bsal ba re sbyin kyin yod/4

mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba //5ngas deng skabs dha sar yod pa'i sa le rgyal rnyeng gras re zung gis bod pa'i bud med rnams la dga' so sgrig rgyur spang zin pa red zer ba zhig go zhing / de phal cher bden tshod du 'dug de ni nub phyogs pa'i bud med la spyod myong mkhan zhig yin na shar phyogs pa'i bud med dang de'i nang nas kyang sod rigs bud med rnams ni 'khreg las la gtan nas rmongs shing / de'i skor gyi shes bya gang yang mi shes mkhan dang ngo tsha chen po'i gras yin pas gang dga' sang skyid kyi 'khris las shig byed thabs med stabs yin nges la/ nub phyogs nga 'i bud med dag gis gakhreg rtsal dang byang rtsal gyi nga tsho hang sang bar byed/ nub phyogs/ ma tshor skyes pa gnyis kyis bshang lam dang mtshan ma'i nang 'khrig pa sgod bzhin du da dung nga la shugs kyis spyod ces skad ngan rgyag cing / shar phyogs ma tsho spyor btang nas bshang lam bed spyod gtong goms su song med thog skyes pa gnyis kyis bshang lam dang mtshan ma gnyis su dus gcig la spyod skabs na zug gis ma bzod par ngu skad 'byin pa dang yang na/ thabs gang yod kyis 'gog pa de red/da dung glog brnyan 'ga' las mthong ba ltar na nub phyogs ma skor zhig ges rang gi mtshan ma las skyes pa'i khu ba phyer btsir shes pa de red/ de byes pa btsir nas skye pa dang btsog pa btsur nas 'dor ba dang gcig mtshungs ltar/ dbugs kyi rgyu ba khog tu bsgo ma nas btsur te khu ba phyi ru 'ded nga/ de red/ 'di ni zhakhrig pa'i skabs su 'grig shubs dang sman sna/ thabs lam gzhan gang yang bsten mi dbeshas par khu ba gsesgog nyar byas te byis pa sbrum 'dod skabs de ltar byed pa dang / khu ba phyi ru btsir te mngal sbrum mi 'dod skabs de ltar byed pa lta bu'i rnam nga gsar zhing sperdzod sgo che ba'i byed thabs shig 3rdospran/ ༄pha

/16 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/gsum/ rngo(da spyi 21gas khrod kyi bsam gzhiga.a rir phyin char ba'i nga'i dga' sa zhig gis kha par las a ri na khyed la dga' ba'i glog brnyan mang bo 'dug khyod 'di ru yod na ci ma rung / zer/ drang mor bshad na a ri na nga dga' ba'i ltad mo yod cing nga dga' ba'i khor yug dang / ngas 'dod pa'i bud med zhakhrig spyod shes yon can tsho yod nga/ ngas shes kyi yod mod/ kho mos de ltar sems gtam zhig bshad/ skad cha des nga la khong dgod cig bslangs shing / bsam gzhig 'di bod spyi tshogs su gtad du bcug dper na/ kho mos bshad pa ltar 'khrig sbyod kyi glog brnyan la bod kyi spyi tshogs khrod nas nga ma gtogs mi dga' zhing / 'khrig sgod ngas ma gtogs spyod kyi med pa red dam/ gal srid de ltar yin na nga 'di 'dri zhig rsham gdon zhig yin pa gor ma chags shing / da lta'i bod spe tshogs su 'dug bzod bral ba yin nges mod/ de ltar yin min nga tsho rang rang gi semathe na khrigs khrigs red/ yin na'ang / ngas de sngon nas gnyig sgod kyi gal chen rang bzhin skor gleng thengs cung mang bas/ 'dir yang mu mthud du dedro skor mi gleng bar nga tshos de bas tshad dma' sa zheg nas bod spyi tshogs khrod zhib lta thengs shig byas na/ sod mi tshos rang rang gi zla bo'am mi che'i bza' zla de phyi'i dang la 'byor tsam dang rnam pa tsam/ skad cig gi sems pa mthun min tsam la lta ba las dus yun ring bor mnyam du gshib nas 'khrig sprebyud thad kyi shes bya gang yang sbyang gi mi 'dug de dngos yo/da gnas tshul yang red/ de bzhin deng skabs sod kyi skyes pa tshos dper na/ nga bud med cig tu dga' zhing dung bas ngas kho mo chung mar len rgyu yin zer ba lta bu dang / bud med cig gis skyes pa ga ge mosna zhig gis nga la byams ngo byed kyin 'dug pa/sa ngas kho bdams pa yin zer ba lta bu yong gi yod mod/bsam blo rnal du dbab nas soms dang / de lta bu'i rgyu mtshan chung tshegs shig gis

mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba/ //7khyed tshos mi tshe mtha' 'khyodal rgyu red dam/ nga tshos do snang ma byas pa red ma gtogs/ mi che'i zla bo btsal rgyur rngam mi rung zhing de ni tshe gcig gi don dag yin stabs ma nor ba zhig bya dgos shing / mjug lusal dgos pa de bas kyang gal chen po red ces 7gong sa mchog gis kyang gsungs myong yod pa ltar dga' zer ba dang brtse dung yod zer ba/ nga la byams ngo byed kyin 'dug zer ba lta bu ni mi tshe skyel mkhan nam bza' zla sgrig skabs kyi rgyu mtshan yang dag pa de ma red/ dper na/ bud med cig gis nga la 'di ltar bshad srid de/ nga khyod la shin tu dga' zhing dung la brtse ba rnam dag yin pas khyed med na nga 'chi yang srid la spyo yang srid/ gang ltar nga'i brtseb 'di khyed kyis dang len bya rogs zer tshe/ ngas kho mor snying rje skyes dgos sam/ dga' zhing dung ba de rgyu mtshan du bya dgos sam/ des nga'i mi che'i mjug tu bde skyed cig bskrun thub pa'i gdeng tshod ji ltar rnyed thub bam/ der brten/ ngas kho mo nga 'a/ dga' zhing dung ba de rgyu mtshan du byas nas nga'i ched du kho mos ci zhig blos gtong bya thub min dang / nga'e ched du kho mo1sa dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba dang / kyag kyog gi lam phran zhig bsnyeg thub min la lta gi red/ de bzhin ngas bud med rtseg chung mar gdam skabs kyang ngas kho mo'i ched du ci zhig bsgrub thub pa dang /ngas khosgo mo'i 'tsho ba'i khormed du 'gan ci zhig 'gan len thub pa/ khag theg ji lta bu zhig bya thub min la lta gi red/ 'di ngas rang gi ma 'ongs pa'i chung ma ngo ma de gdam pa'i shes bya yin la/ don dngos thog nas kyang ngas lam kha 'di brgyud nas yong zhing mu mthud du 'di brgyud nas 'gro bzhin 〈snad/

//8 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/bzhi ba/ dud med la khu ba yod par thag bcad chogamakhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyis bud med la khu ba yod med ma/ mkhyen par dpyod ldan rgan pa tsho'e gleng skal du phul bar brtag na/ khong yang mkhas pa zhig yin stabs 'dod bstan 'bri rgyur ngal ba ma byung zhing / mi skya yin pa sa cha nas zhakhrig pa yang lan mang spya da yod tshod red de/ yin na'ang / khong gis zhakhrig pa spyad pa'i brgyud rim khrod nas rgan po tshor phul ba'i bud med la khu ba yod med skor gyi dpyad gzhi'i gsungs mol thung ngu de la dogs slong zhig mi bya thabs med red/ lo 'ga'i sngon ngas thog mar 'khrig spyod skor gyi rtsom yig 'bri skabs ngas kyang dogs slong cam byas nas bzhag yod mod/ de ring thag bcad nas bshad thub pa ni da lta'i dus 'di lta bu zhig tu bud med la khu ba yod med kyi gtam ni dogs slong zhig min nga ra thag bcad nas bshad chog pa zheg red la/ da lta'i dus 'dir rang gis myong zhing dpyod mi shes pa'i dbang du btang yang glog brnyan dang dra rgyar bltas nas dpyad chog gi red/ ngas bltas pa'i slog brnyan dang dra rgya skyor zhig tu bud med la khu ba bzhur gyi yod pa rtogs shing / de ni mkhas dbang dge 'dun :thos 'bel lags kyis gsungs pa'i g.ya' chu zhig gam/ chu zhig 'chor rgyu 'dug zer ba de gtan nas ma yin par skyes pa dang gcig mtshungs kyis bzhur yong ba'i khu ba zhig red la/ de ni gtso bo nub phyogs pa'i glog brnyan skor zhig las lta thub/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel lags kyis gsungs pa ltar bud med la g.ya' chu zhig 'chor rgyu 'dug cing / de ni dang thog 'khrig pa mgo rtsom skabs shen tu mang bo bzhur yong zhing / de'i stabs kyis skyes nga 'i pho mtshan bud med kyi mchan ma'i nang du 'jug skabs mtshan ma gnyis 'don 'jug bya rgyur ram 'degs byed kyin yod/gal srid g.ya' chu des ram 'degs bral tshe kha'i mchu ma lta bu zhig gis pho mtshan bud

mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba //9med kyi mtshan ma'i nang 'jug pa'am thabs lam gzhan zhig brten daskusgos shing / de lta bu'i g.ya' chu drin po che de med tshe mtshan ma 'don 'jug gi las 'dir dka' ngal 〈snang ba gdon mi za/ yang nub phyogs pa'i bud med tshos gcin lta bu'i khu ba dang g.ya' chu gang gi khongs su'ang mi gtogs pa 'i chu zhig phyir gtong gi 'dug cing / phyung stangs ni khu ba dang ha cang 'dra ste 'khrig pa'i skabs kye bde tshor drag po phyi ru mngon skabs bzhur yong gi 'dugagand don 'dir ngas bsam gzhig byas nas yun ring 'bosgor skabs shig la nga rang nyid kyang 'dom chu 'di bzhur yong mkhan gyi bod rigs bud med cig dang thug cing /chu 'di ni 'khrig pa'i bsam pa shugs cher 'phel zhing / mtshan ma 'don 'jug gi las la shugs gyes 'jug skabs da gzod bzhur yong gi 'dug la/ dri mi zhim zhing gcin dri lta bu zhig 'dug pas chags sred kyis dbang gis lus kyi rtsarnams stod de gcin phyi ru bzhur 'ong ba zhig yin tshod 'dug 'on kyang da dung dogs gzhi 'dug yin na'ang / srir btang nub phyogs pa'i mi 'di tshos 'khrig spyo da skabs drag las mang du brten bsnan 'dug nga sa/ drag las kyi byed thabs 'dis bud med la na zug ster cing / des na zug bsang bar bya thub mod bde ba dngos de myong mi thub cing / kho tshor khu ba yo/da med kyang dpya da dka' ba'i tshod du 'dug dper na/ nub phyogs pa tshos drag las spad spad de rang nyid kyi khu ba phyi ru phyung rjes phan tshun gnyis ka bde bas tshims pa/ zhi/ tu thos 'dzin gi 'dug la/ bud med tshos kyang 'di la mos mthun byed bzhin 'dug yin na'ang / ngas myong grub kyi dbang du byas na/ de ltar gtan nas ma yin par bud med la bde ba dngosi sgo da pa dang / khong tshor khu ba yod med la brtag skabs pho mtshan mo mtshan gyi sbubs su gtad de/ ha cang mgyogs myur gyis 'khreg pa spyod dgos pa dang / drag las gtan nas

/20 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/bkod mi rung zhing / pho mtshan mo mtshan las yar mar 'don 'jug bya rgyu de gal chen ngo men par lus po hril bo mnyam du bar med du 'gul rgyu de red/skabs 'dir 'dom gnyis ka ha cang dam du sprel dgos shing / de ni bar med par margyadags myur gyis 'khrig sperdzod skabs bud ched kyi mtshan ma'i g.yas g.yon kun tu chags pa'i bde tshor khyab yordo stabs/ mtshan ma'i g.yas g.yon du skyes pa'i rlig ril gnyis dang 'dom spu yod sa'i sha sogs thug thub stabs/ des kyang bud med la sred pa'i me lce drag tu 'bar 'jug thub ste/bud med kyis rang dbang med par 'khun sgra 'byin pa dang ngu skad 'chor zhing / skyermos pa'i kha dang gdong la bar med du kha skyel ci thub byed nga de red/ thabs lam 'di spro4da shes mkhan zhig gis rang nyid la 'khrig bde ma byung ba'i sngon du'am 'khrig thengs gardzug la bud med la thengs gsum nas bzhi/ drug nas brgyad bar 'khrig bde spyod thub cing / skyes pa zhakhrig yun ring bo can tshos de bas kyang mang bo spyod thub pa smos med yin mod/ gakhrig thabs 'dis skyes pa'i khu ba cung tsam ring du 'dzin pa sa skyes pa'i bde ba myong rgyur drag las cung cam bkol na bzang ba yin/ de min 'khrig thabs 'di bsten skabs bud sped la khu ba 'byung ba'am dang bde ba 'thob rgyur nyams bzhag nas bsdad de/ bde tshor 'thob sdurdzong bsam ma thag sperdzod mtshams bzhag ste pho mtshan mo mtshan gyi spugs su gtad pa yin na/ po mtshan gyisado tsed med kyi khu ba skyes pa bzhin mo mtshan nang ngos nas bzhur yong ba tshor thub pa yin la/ bud med kyang skyes pa ltar khu ba 'byin bzhim pa'i skabs kyi bde tshor dang spyir btang gi 'khrig spyod gnyis kyi skabs las 'khrig bde byung ba'i skabs kyi bde tshor shugs che zhing / lus khams hril bor bde tshor gyis khyab 'gro da dung bud med la khu ba byung ba dang 'khrig bde 'thob rjes mtshan ma drod lam lam dang sdom tsam sdom cam byed pa yin/

mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba /2/gong gi byed thabs de gtso bo 'khrig thabs gnyis kho na ste/ skyes pas bud med kyi steng nas zhon te/bud med kyi rkang nga gnyis phar tshur ches cher bgrad bcug nas rang gi rgyab phyogs su 'jog 'jug pa dang / 'dom gnyis dam du sprel rjes bud med dang dam du 'tham ste sbyor btang ba'i 'khrig sprebyud kyi thabs lam de bsten dgos pa yin la/ gzhan gcig ni skyes pa zur du nyal te bud med kyis steng nas sbyod cing / bud med kyi rkang ba gcig skyes pas lag pa ya gcig gis rang gi phrag mabosnar 'khur ba dang / rkang ba ya gcig skyes nga 'i rkang ba gnyis kyi bar du gnar 'jug dgosnas la/ 'dom gnyis dam du sprel ched skyes pas rkang pa ya gcig gis 'dom du gnar ba'i bud med kyi rkang ba'i phyi log nas gnan dgos/ gang ltar 'khrig thabs 'di gnyis las kyang rjes ma de da bar deb dang glog brnyan/ dra rgya sogs su gtan nas mthong myong med la/ dge cherngos kye deb tu'ang mi 'dugadage chos dang shes rab dar rgyas rnam gnyis kyis bud sped kyi sems dang 'khrig spyod kyi 'brel ba gnyis gal chen yin skor brjod pa ltar gong gi byed thabs de gnyis mtshan gcig gi nyal rogs cam gyi bud med la bkol 5/nga 'bras bu de tsam mi 'thon zhing / rang gi chung ma dang dga' ma tshor yang sems na sdug bsngal lam khong khro langs pa'i skabs su bkol yang 'bras nad yin/ de ni bud med rtseg dang ci tsam gyis sems thag nye ba yod kyang khong mo tsho'i sems su sdug bsngal yod pa dang sems 'khrag pa'i skabs su ldab mang bos 'ukhrig spyod kyi bde ba myong rgyur 'gal rkyen 'byung gi yod pas yin/ gzhan ngas bud nad kyi skro dang mchan spu/ 'dom spu gsum ni bud med de'i srir btang gi chags sred che chung la tshad lasal byed bzang shos de yin par mthong zhing / zlod med cig gi skra rdzongs mthug cing sgom pa dang / 'dom spu mthug cing mang la/ rtsub po yin

/22 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/tshe bud med de'i rigs chags sred shugs che zhing 'khrig las gang 'dod du dgos pa 'i gras yin la/ bud med kyi skra lo 'jam zhing phra la/ 'dom spu nyung zhing 'jam pa/ mchan spu de ltar yin tshe khong mo tsho ni spyir btang ba'i lwajeg spod tsam dang / chags sred kyi shugs de ltar chen ngo med pa'i gras yin/ 4lnga/ re zhig mjug bsdu ba/nga'i 'khrig sgod skor gye shes bya ni ches spyir btang las kyang spi ra btang ba zhig yi/na stabs/ 'jor brjod bzhin pa'i nyakhrig spyod skor gyi rtsom thung rdog tu/ khyed cag klog mkhan dag la'ang ches spyir btang ba'i shes bya tsam las ngo spro da bya thub kyi med la/ rgas 'khesags nyams tshungang can dang bud med dang 'khrig las la byang be'ums can cesas 'khred dgod gnang srid kyang / ngas rang gi gdong mdog dmar rjen du bstan te rang nyid kyi dga' phyogs shig 'tshol ba'i dmigs yu/la ni/ gcig nas rang nyid las 'di lta bu zhig la 'jug bzhin du 'di mi gleng bar sdod 'dod med nga dang / gnyis nas ngas (nga ) zhes pa 'di sdun la drud de/ ( khyod ) ces pa mjug tu sgon gi yod pas/ nam zhig khyod kyang khyod kyi dga' phyogs dang / khyod kyi don dngos gleng thub mkhan dang bsam thub mkhan zhig tu 'gyur bar smon zer rgyu de red/ mi mang bo zhig gis nga tsho sod ni ngo tsha khrel skusgod can gyi khyad 'apa gas mi regs shig yin sta bas/ 'di lta bu'i skad cha btsog bshad ni lkog rkyang rkyang nas 'chad dgos so 'ur yang / ngas nga tsho bod ni ngo tsha khrel yod can gyi mi rigs shig yin pa brjed de/ rang gi ma dang sring resna 'ged sa tshun chad nas bcog bshad bya dbosgos shing / bcog las nam bsgrub 'dod na de dus bsgru ba dbosnas zer

mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba/ /23gyi med par 'di'i skor gyi shes bya dag ni tshe gang sor bkol spod ches che ba'i shes bya de yin la/ nga tsho ni de la rmongs 'dug pas dus rgyun gyi 'tsho dro la brdab gsig thebs kyi 'dug zer ba de tsam resna/ /mchan/ mal gye bde ba 'tshol ba zhes pa'i rtsom thung 'di de pyi lo 2008 lo'i 'epha mjug tu bris te 'od spyi tshogs dus deb steng bskur yang / de'i rjes dus deb de grags 'gul med pa zhig tu gyur bas da bar gang du'ang bkod ma thub par lhag yerdzod pas 'dir bkod do/ /

mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba /25sbra 'dabs (7 ma'argan ces/5(ha lto rno can sgru tsa 7 73 dzog he5 mo phodze sgror phonye sgron lnga phod 707 na myo skyes ra( tshor long dzo nga hang mnyam 'o stodza( rtso bsgron 79na ghu grangs 'dzo hang han skrun nyes smerdzo 3ha rtse ( tshod tshoyo she lkor 2ho ho rang sgroha skya lko/49 ha pho 7 byayo rpā dzog ha ( skyes pho rdzong kho rang dzo mo rmyo la 'ong spyong tshogasgru nga ho gnyer hu lho zholaṅgā rtson pho ha rtsed lo/skye ra 'gyel sme dzog kyang rehā she ñtsā tha spo myalaspo pa/ 'gel srol phog kyang rehā

126 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed snyangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/sngon gling thung du zhigathengs shig ngas grogs po skor zhig dang lhan du gleng mol byed skabs nga tshos zhing 'brog gnyis kyi gsar bu gsar mo tshos mi che'i don dag bca' stangs dang dga' rogs sgrig stangs/ khyim tshang skyong stangs/ nyakhrig sbyod byed stangs sogs la gleng mol byas pas zhing 'brog gnyis kyi 'khrig :stod kyi las la he bag chen yo yod pa shes rtogs byung / nga dang bla brang bsang khog gi grogs po zhig gis 'gog phyogs kyi bu mo tshor mtshan mo rum la 'dzul nas skad cha yag po bshad pa dang / kha yag ngo bstod byed nga sogs byas na lujeg pa spyod 'jug gi red ces brjod skabs/ der yod kyi grogs po zhig gis sngar de lta bu zhig mthong thos myong gsum gtan nas med pa dang / khong tsho'i pha yul du phal cher gnyen rtags brgyabs zin pa'am chang sa ma brgyab bar bu resna tshos gang 'dod du gzhig pa spyod 'jug gi ma red/ 'di yig thog tu 'bri thub rgyu na dngos yo/da spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i don snying ldan gi zer mod/ sgyid lug dang le lo'i dbang gis da bar lus/

mal gyi bde ba 'tshol ba 127thengs 'dir phyir dran byed zhor dang grogs sto 'gar skad cha 'dri zhor gyis 'brog phyogs sa khul gyi gsar bu gsar mo tsho mtshan mor pho nyul byed du 'gro stangs skor nas 'phros te 'bri khul byas pa yin mod/ 'jig rten gyi bya dngos gang zhig 'bre rung rang nyid lag len dngos la ma zhugs par yag po zhig 'bri thabs gtan nas med stabs/ngas 'dir gang gleng ba dang ci zhig bris pa yod tshad rna bas thos pa dang mig gis mthong ba tsam las lus kyis dngos su myangs ma myong / ( di ni nga rang chung dus grwa pa/ byas te 'gog dgon zhig tu 'tshar longs byung stabs yin/) de'i stabs kyis nor ba'e cha re yod srid pas rgan zhon nyams myong can tshos mdzub ston gnang rgyu dang / spi tshogs dpyad brjod pa tshor gleng gzhir phul ba tsam yin/ 4nang don dngos su 'jug pa/me'i bsam pa'i dpal skusgon dang khor yug gnas stangs/ spyi tshogs kyi grub tshul sogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis 'gro ba mi'i 'tsho gnas khrod kyi 'gro 'dug sperdzod gsum la'ang he bag chen po yod pa ltar/ mdo dbus mtho sgang gi zhing 'brog gnyis4 la'ang yu/la dang dus kyi dbang gis goms srol mi 'dra ba re yod cing / pho mo'i lus kyi gsang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba'i 'gro lugs bca' stangs sogs la bar khyad cung mi 'dra bar snang / de'i dbang gis ngas gang gleng bar bya ba'ang nga rang chung dus 'tshar longs byung sa'i 'brog khul gyi 'tsho ba'i cha shas shig ste/ na gasnyaman pho resna rnams lang tsho'i me tesnag rab tu smin te/ lajig rten gyi bya bar 'jug rgyur 'os shing 'tsham par slebs skabs/ tshe gang gi gtan grogs kho nar mi sgug par dga' bde'i dang/la la skyedar ba yin pas de la dpyad

/28 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/nga thung ngu zhig byed par spro ba rab tu brtas/ spyir shar phyogs pa'i bud med phal che bar mtshon na nub phyogs pa'i bud med tsho'i lta ba'i langs phyogs las ring du brgal te/ mi tshe gcig gi khyo ga dang ma 'phrad bar rang nyed me tog mar sdod dgos pa las de'i sngon du mi gzhan dang mnyam du 'khrig pa'i las byed mi rung ba dang / de bzhen chang sa brgyabs rjes rang gi khyo ga las gzhan par gang 'dod du 'khrig spyod don du gnyer mi rung bar 'dod pa dang / gal srid rang nyid me tog ma zhig min che rang gi tshe gang gi khyo gar 'bul rung ba'i lag skyes rtsachen de med par 'dod pa yin mod/ nub phyogs pa tshos lang tsho dar zhing na tshod smin pa na pho po'i lus kyi bya bar 'jug pa sno langeg rten gyi snying so gal chen zhig la ngos 'dzin byed la/ 'khrig las kyi don snying rtogs par brtson pa ltar/'grog phyogs kha shas su 'di lta bu'i rgyun srol zhig yod/ yin na'ang / nub phyogs pa tshos nang bsam pa'i dpal yon la brten te mi'i mi che'i nang 'khrig :snad kyi bya ba byed rgyu gal chen du brtsib dang / bod 'brog khul gyi sa khul la lar khor yug dang gnas sta ngas kyi dbang gis de 'a/ bkag rgya de cam mi byed pa ra rang dbang ches cher sgo da pa ni/bsgrub bya zhakhrig spyod kyi las su 'jug stangs gcig mtshungs yin na'ang / der 'dzin nga 'i nang bsam blo'i 'du shes gtan nas mi gcig pa yin/ nga'i pa yul 'brog phyogs der mtshon na pho mo'i bar gyi lus 'brel ni gnas dang dus kyi go skabs byung dang ma byung las/ de la bkag rgya de tsam med par rdza lung dang ri lung / tha na lug ra dang zog lhas sogs su'ang gang 'dod du bya ba der 'jug rkyang byed pa yen zhing / nang na pha ma dang spun srid mang ba'i bud med skor zhig gis rang gi mdza' sa 'bod 'gugs kyis mtshan mo'i dus su sbra gur 'dabs dang / nor lhas su sakhreg spyod dngos la 'jug gi 'phad cing / phyugs 'tsho ba'i skyes pa tshos ri lung nas bud med mnyam

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byedastangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ 129du nyal bo brten pa yin zhing / de ni dngos gnas bkag rgya gang yang med pa zhig red/'grog phyogs 'di lta bu'i sa khul khag tu mo lo bco lnga bcu drug yol ba'i bud med phal che ba gnas la setreng med kyang spe tog ma min la/ gal srid khyed kyis mo 'edzi nyi shu zin pa'i 'brog mo me tog ma zhig bag mar len 'dod tshe de ni ha cang gi dka' tshegs can zhig yin pa ma zad/ khyod kyang 'grog phyogs 'di lta bu zhig tu skyes shing 'tshar 'ephangs byung ba'i mi zhig yin tshe khyod snga sa nas bud med gzhan dang mnyam du nyal 'o brten tshar ba'i gras su gtogs pa gdon me za/ de ni gtso bo pho mo'i lus kyi bya ba byed par rang dbang che ba'i khor yug 'di'i dbang gis yin/ gsar bu lo chung tshos phan tshun la theng mol byed skabs ngas bu mo grangs gan dang 'di la kha lo brtol/ ba yin (yul skad/ bu mo gzhon nu ma'i lang tsho'i me tog blangs par go) zhes ngom so byed cing / khong tsho'i bsam par bu mo lo chung ci tsam gyis mang bar kha lo brtol thub na de ni rang gi gzi brjid dang / ngom so byed rung ba'i byas rjes lta bur btsistabs 'di lta bu'i gleng mol byed pa yang yang thos rgyu yod/yang zhing ba'am am skad du rang phyogs su 'bod pa'i la gzhas shig tu po lo bco lnga nyi shu'i steng du/ mi med pa'i mi zhig gang na yod/ zer ba zhig yod cing de'i don ni mo lo bco lnga nyi shur slebs rjes da dung 'khrig spyod brten ma myong ba'i mi zhig gang na yod de/ med zer ba'i don yin la/ de lta bur brtag skabs zhing ba'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du'ang bud med rnams chang sa brgyab min la ma stos par na tshod smin zhing 'jig rten gyi bya bar 'jug rgyur 'os shing 'tsham par slebs pa na bya ba der 'jug rung ba zhig ma yin nam snyam yang / zhing ba'i 'tsho bar rgyus mnga' de tsam med stabs ngal ba brten med/ 'grog

/30 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/phyogs su dper na khyim tshang phal mo ches da phyid dus su bu mo gzhon nu ma rnams sbra 'dabs su phub pa'i sbra gur chung ngu'i re'i nang du logs su dgar nas nyal 'jug gi yod pa dang / de ni gzhan ci yang min par skyes pa tsho rdzo nyul byed du yong skabs stabs je bder btang ba zhig red/ skyes pa chung ma med mkhan nam chang sa ma brgyab mkhan tsho rgyun par phyi logs su pho nyul byed du 'gro ba dang / mtshan mo re re bzhin khong tshos grang ngar dang char rlung la mi 'dzem par la phar rgyab tshur rgyab dang / ri mtho lung gshongs brgyud de pho nyul du 'gro gi yod/ mtshams rer khong tshos phan tshun la brda btang ste me mang bo dpung bsgrigs nas 'gro ba'ang yod/ mi mang bo dpung bsgrigs nas 'gro ba 'di la dge mtshan dang skyon cha gnyis yod pa'i dge mtshan ni pho nyul du 'gro mkhan gyi skyes pa gzhan dang 'phrad skabs bud med brtsad de 'khrug 'dzing byed dgos 'byung srid nga sa mi mang na pham kha nyakhur mi dgos pa'i bzang cha dang / skyon cha ni mtshan gang por ru sde nyul nas song song ste/ mthar bu mo zhig reg kyang rang gcig pus spyod thabs bral bas yin/de bzhin 'brog phyogs la mtshon na dbyar sa dang dgun sa/ dpyid sa/ ston sa sogs dus tshigs bzhi bor ru yar spo mar sgo byed cing ston sa dang dpyid sa gnyis rgyun ldan gye gnas bcas pa'i khyim gzhi dang cung kha thag nye sar yod pa dang / skabs der phal cher khyim tshang mang che bas bu bu mo rnams phyugs zog dang mnyam du dpyid sa'am ston sa sogs nas 'jog pa yin stabs/ de ni na gzhon pho mo tshor mtshon na pho nyul byed pa'i go ska bas yag 395 shig kyang yin/yin na'ang /'grog phyogs kyi sa khul yin tshul 'di ltar gcig mtshungs yin pa 'i nges pa nad cing / ru yar mar sgo ba'i gnas stangs thad rbad de sdos phyogs yin/ nga'i pha yul lta bur mtshon na 'brog pa tshos dbyar sa nas dgun sa bar du ru bkal tshe phal cher nyin gsum nas bzhi bar nyung mthar 'gro dgos gyen yod

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ 13 /na'ang / 'brog khul kha shas shig tu ha cang mang na nyin gcig las 'grerdzo mi dbostos sa yang 'dug stabs 'dre ga phyongags yin tshad gcig mtshungs min la/ 'brog sdudags yin tshad kyi gshis lugs dang goms srol yang mi mthun nga/ yod/ yin na'ang / 'di dpe mtshon bzang sto zheg yin pa ma brjed/gang ltar nga skyes shing 'tshar longs byung sa'i 'brog phyogs der mtshon na skyes nga/ tsho mtshan mor pho nyul byed du 'gro ba rgyun ldan zhig yin stabs 'de la bkag rgya sesgogs gang yang med cing / mtshan mo zhes pa ni snying 'jags wang khu sem zhig yin pa'i ngos 74na rung yang / 'grog phyogs 'dir mtshan mo sa rub rjes sgo khyi'i zug skad dang rta po'i mig sgra / gsar bu tsho'i sakhun sgra sogs je mthor 'gro dus/ kyang shin tu mang / de ni gsar bu tsho pho nyul du byed du 'gro bas red/'di lta bu'i 'tsho ba dngos kyi nyams myong khrod na ha cang dgod 'chor ba'i gnad don zhig kyang yo/da pa ni/ bud med mang so zhig gis rang nyid dang mnyam du nyal so brten mkhan de sngon chad ngo mi shes na'ang gzhig sbyod kyi bya ba byed 'jug pa dang / skyes pa tshos kyang sngar mthong myong med pa dang / gleng mol serdzogs gtan nas med cing brtseb ni de bas kyang 〈snang mi srid par bud med rtseg thengs gcig gi nyal rogs su brten pa lta bu yin pas/ dgong mor nyal bo brten pa tsam las phyi nyin dngos su gdong thug skabs phan tshun ngo mi shes pa'ang mang sa yod/ gang gis zhe na skyes pa tsho mtshan mo ru sde nyul nas song ste khyim gceg gi bu mo zhig khyer rkyang du nyal yod pa dang stabs sakhel tshe/ phal cher pho nyul du song ba'i don go chod pa dang /dang sa bu mo des min zhes u tshugs byed smred kyang / ga ler rum du 'dzul nas snyan mo'i gtam bshad pa dang kha'i g.yas ga〈snan du 'o byed pa/

/32 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/lus kyi stod smad bar gsum du lag pas yang yang reg pa/ yang min na 'khrig gtam brjod pa dang kha yag ngo bstod byed pa/ btsan tshugs kyis mtshan ma'i g.yas g.yon dang brla sha sogs su rag mnyed sogs byas tshe/ mi sems ni ma gzhi nas rdo bskos shig min pa dang / bu mo tshos kha nas min dang ngo tsha'i gtam mang tsam smra yang nang sems kyi chags pa dang / zhakhrig sbyordzod kyi bya ba dgos pa ni skyes pa dang gcig mtshungs yin stabs/nam zhig bu mo de yang 'khrig spyo da kyi sems pa rab tu g.yo zhing chags sred kyi me lce drag tu 'bar tshe pos mthun byed cing zhakhrig pa'i las sbyin pa yin no/ /yin na'ang /bud med ni phugs bsam la phyogs mkhan zhig dang khong tsho'i chags sems de yang ha cang gting zab pa'i dbang gis dang bo skyes pa cha med rgyus nad cig rum du 'tshang ma thag nas mos mthun byed pa ha lam mi srid de/ khyod gang nas yin pa dang lo dang ming / khyim tshang su tshang gi yin pa sogs dri ba sna tshogs 'dre srid cing / mi che'i skor yang gleng srid pas skyes pa tshos kho mo tsho'i sems la dogs pa skyes pa'i skad cha re bshad tshe 'khrig spod kyi bya ba byed du mi 'jug pa dang / yang na de las gzhan pa'i dus tshod cig gtan rnordel gyis blta chog ces kyang brjod srid/ gang ltar yang bud med mnyam du skad cha bshad shes mi shes dang / tsude med kyi sems gshis la bstun shes mi shes tsam las 'khrig spyod kyi bya ba byed par gtan nas ngo rgol byed pa 'i 'brog mo zhig phal cher nad ces kha tshon bcad kyang mi chog pa med/mtshan mo pho nyul byed du 'gro mkhan skyes pa phal mo cher dmigs yul nges can re med par sde ba'i nang gi bu mo can gyi khyim tshang tshang ma'i sgo 'gram nyul nas 'gro zhing /re zung gis do dgong khyim tshang gan dang 'di tshang gi khyim bdag nang du med pa dang / yang

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ /33na a ma nang du mi 'dug zer ba lta bu rna thos byung tshe de tshang gi bu mo dmigs 'ben du bzung nas 'gro ba yin/ yang skyes pa re 'gas nyin gung zog lug gi rdzi bor song skabs nas ngo shes pa'i bu mosna tshor kha chad bzos tshar 〈snad cing / bu mopha na'i sems la bag chags zab tsete zhig lasdog thub skusad tshe mtshan mor khyim tshang gi sbra 'dabs su slebs ma thag nas bu mo lda sgor bud nas khyi 'bosgog pa dang / sne len yag po byed cing 'di'i rigs rjes phyogs bza' tshang chags 'gro mkhan yang mang / yang yag mo sgo can gyi bu mo skor zhig gis mo lo nyir bzhi nyer lnga yod skabs nas skyes pa tshor khyod ni nga dang mnyam du nyal bo brten mkhan gyi grangs 'di dang gan yin zhes brjod srid cing / khong tshos de ltar brjod don rang nyid kyi mdzes sdug ngom so byas pa zhig dang / skyes pa mang 'o rang gi mo sgo la dung zhing zhakhrig sbyod don gnyer du yong mkhan rgyun 'chad med pa'i skor 'grel ba zhig kya nga red/ de ni thabs mkhas pa'i 'grel srol zhig kyang red/ dper na bud med cig gis gsar bu zhig la khyod dang mnyam du nyal ba 'di nga da bar du gsar bu brgya dang brgyad mnyam du nyal ba'i grangs tag tag yin zhes brjod srid/ bud med re zung gis rang nyid kyi sar yong ba'i skye sa pa der ngom so byed ched de ltar smras nga/ yi/na srid mod/bud sped brgya nyis brgya mnyam du nyal bo brten mkhan gyi skyes nga dang / skyes pa brgya nyes brgya mnyam du nyal bo brten mkhan gyi bud med mang sa 〈snad cing / deng skabs rgya gar du yod pa'i nga'i ngo shes rgad so zhig gis kyang kho rang pha yul du yod skabs bud med tsho'i sar po nyul du song ba'i grangs phal cher nyis brgya'i mi tshad zer nas dngos su brjod myong la/ sngon chad kyi nga'i slob spogs shig gis kyang kho rang phyir pha yul du logs nas zla drug bsdad ring bud med sum cu lhag gi sar pho nyul du song ba yin zed gal srid nga yang pha yul du yod na ngas dgong mo re / bzhin ru sde tsho sde nyul te pho nyul gyi bya ba don

/34 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/du gnyer bzhin par mna' bskyal nas bshad thub/yin na'ang / nang bsam pa'i dpal yon dang phyi dngos pa/'i dpal yon/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i tshan reg sogs cung rjes lus su gyur ba'i 'brog phyogs la lar mtshon na/ pho nyul byed pa'i rigs 'dis deng dus kyi tshan rig gi rjes ma zin pa'i rtags mtshan gsal ba'i skyon cha chen po zhig kyang drud yong gin yod cing / de ni bu mo tshor chang sa ma brgyab pa'i sngon nas mngal sbrum pa lta bu yin/ byis pa mang bo zhig gi a mas rang nyid kyi byis pa'i pha su yin ngos zin gyi med par the tshom gyi gnas su gyar bzhin yod la/ de ni mtshan gcig la skyes pa gnyis nas gsum mnyam du nyal so brten mkhan dang / yang na skyes pa mang so rgyun mi 'chad par kho mo'i sar yong ba'i bud med rigs yin/ 'di lta bu'i gnad don 'ga' 'brog phyogs kyi spyi tshogs khrod slebs pa na/pha ma tshor sems ngal chen po zhig gis gnon zhing / rang nyid kyi bu mo chang sa ma brgyab pa'i sngon du mngal sbrum mi yong ngam snyams te sems khral byed pa dang / bu mo tshor 'jig rten bya ba byed pa'i thad du bkag rgya mi byed thu med du 'gyur/ de'i stabs kyis nam rgyun 'dab lag yo/ngas su rgyas pa'i stag shar khag rtseg gi kha na rlung ltar rgyu ba'i gtam rgyud cig yod pa ni/ khyim tshang re 'ga'i pha ma tshos khong tsho'i bu mo'i sar yong ba'i gsar bu tsho btsan tshugs kyis phyi la 'ded kyin 'dug zer ba 'ode yin mod/ khyim chang zhig gi pha ma gnyis kyis rang nyid kyi bu mor byis pa btsa' yo/nga bar sems khral gyis bkag 'gog byed srid kyang / de tshang gi bu rnams mtshan mor pho nyul byed du 'gro bar bkag 'gog mi byed pa dang / mig gis mthong bzhin du ma mthong khul dang rna bas go bzhin du ma go khul byed pa yin la/ bu rnams kyang mtshan mor pho nyul du 'gro ba tsam las zhogs pa 'i skya rengs ma shar ba'i gong nas khyim mi rnams la gsang stabs kyis/ rkang 'jab

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ 135lag 'jab byas te phyir nang du log yong gi yod/ pho nyul du song ba ha cang gsang ba byed pa dang khyim tshang gi nang du 'di'i skor la lab gleng sogs gtan nas byed mi rung ba yin/yang nga tsho'i 'brog phyogs der mtshon na srol rgyun gyi dbang du song ba'i goms gshis ya mtshan zhig yod pa ni/ sru mo srid pa'i lusar lo red/ bskor ma thub rang gi sdug grong red/ ces brjod srol zhig yod cing de'i don ni/ khyim gcig la bu gnyis yod tshe bu chung ba des bu che ba'i chung mar 'khrig pa spad kyang rung bar bshad pa dang /gal srid bu che ba'i chung mar 'khrig pa spyoted ma thub ched de ni rang gi sdug chungang yin par 'grel bas red/ da dung bu che ba'i chung ma'am sru mor 'khrig pa :rdzod ma thub pa'i rigs la gsar bu gzhan tshos 'phya dmod kyang byed de/ rang dang na tshod mnyam nga 'i gsar bu gzhan tsho dang mnyam du pho nyul du song tshe/ rang gi sru mo la'ang gnyeg spyod brten mi thub par phyi nas bu mo ji ltar 'tshol zhes mthong chung dang brnyas bcos byed srid pa yin/yin na'ang / bu che bas rang gi nu bo'i chung mar de ltar zhakhrig spyod brten pa phar zhog tha na skad cha bcog po tshig gcig bshad kyang de ni dpe mi srid pa'i ngo tsha chen po zhig yin la/ de ltar byed pa gzhan gyis thos tshe phal cher rang gi ma dang sring mor kha btsog bshad pa ltar sdug por brtsib yin/ de bzhin skyes pa zhig gis rang nyid kyi chung ma'i sring mor 'khrig pa skyesgod rung yang / chung ma las lo che ba'i gcen mo lta bur ngo tsha byed pa dang /'dzem byon yang shin tu byed pa yin/ khyim tshang mang bo zhig gi mag pas rang nyid kyi chung ma'i sring chung ma phal cher chang sa ma brgyab bar du bdag nyar byed cing / mag pa btsan po zhig yin tshe phyi logs nas pho nyul byed du 〈snang mkhan gyi skyes pa tshor yang bkag 'gog dang / zhakhrig spyod kyi las byed du mi 'jug pa yin/

/3 6 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsamasa'adir dpe mtshon zhig drangs na/ nga la ma sbun zhig 〈snad/ kho nga las lerdzo gsum gyi che ba yin/ thengs shig khos rang gi nu bo ( pha spun yin pa las nga/ ma gcig nga zhig min/ )kho rang nyid kyi chung ma'i sar zhakhrig pa pyod du btang 'dugade ni kho dang kho'i chung ma gnyis ka mos mthun byung ba zhig red/ phyi nyin der kho'i nu bo des nga la nga'i sru mo dang khong gnyis kyis 'khrig pa spyad ring nga'i phu bos 'grul khang nang nas bsgugs song la/nged gnyis kyis gzeg spyad rjes phu stos da khyod rang gi nyal sar song zer bas nga rang nyid nyal sar song ba yin zer/ 'di lta bu ni 'brog phyogs su rgyun 'byams su song yo/da/de bzhin na gzhon rtsom pa so hu ra 'jam pes brtsams pa 'i rmi lam 'khrug pa'i lo zla zhes pa'i brtsapas sgru nga nang ( sru skal )zer ba zhig yod skor bris 'dug la/ de yang gong gi nga'i pha yul gyi srol rgyun dang gcig mtshungs red 'dug der brten mdo sma da rnga ba'i phyogs su'ang sru mo tsho'i sa nas sru skal len pa'i srol yod pa bsta na 'dug mod/ nga'i pha yul du sru skal zer ba'i tshig de bed spyod byed kyi med snyam/'di srol rgyun gyi bsam blo'i dbang shugs che drags nga la sa bu chung bas rang ge phu bo'i chung mar 'u'ig sgod brten chog bzhin du bu che bas de lta ra byed mi chog pa dang / khyim tshang zhig gi mag4 pas chung ma'i sring mor 'khrig speged brten chog bzhin du spun che bar ngo tsha byed dgos par blta ba ni dgod bro ba'i snang tshurmi tsam las dge mtshan zhig ma mthong mod/ 'di ni nga'i pa yul 'brog phyogs der gna' nas da bar dang da nas yun ring la gnas nges pa'i sro(la rgyun gyi lugs lhusgol zhig red/ yin na'ang / bu chung bas rang gi phu mo'i chung mar 'khrig sgod brten skabs cis kyang gsang rgya byed dgos pa dang / nang du phu bo med pa'i skabs dang bstun te sru mo'i sor song tshe sru mos kyang mos mthun byed pa yin zhing / sru mos byams skyong yang 'thob kyi yod rabs 'dug mod/ mag pa sa de tsam

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ /3 7'dzem mi dbe(sa pa dang / phal cher chung ma'i sring mo nam zhig gnyen rtags brgyab ste gnas la ma song bar rang nyid kyi thob skal du brtsi ba yin no/ /de bzhin 'brog phyogs su 'khrig spod kyi thad la rang dbang ha cang che ste/ khyo ga re 'ga' las don ched phyi ru song skabs sdong nyid kyi chung mar gzhan gyis 'khrig pa sbyod kyi yod pa gzhir bzhag byed pa dang / nang du khyo ga med tshe chung mas kyang zur brten dga' rogs la brda gtong ba lta bu dang / yang khyo ga phyi ru song nas phyi ra nang du ma log tshe bud med gzhan dang nyal bo brten pa chung mas gzhir bzhag byed pa lta bu setegs na gzhon rtsom pa bo shes rab dar rgyas lags kyis nub phyogs 'grim pa'i gtam deb phreng gsum pa'i nang du khyo shug gnyis mnyam du nang nas thon te/ lam sked du chung ma bshang btsong khang du 'gretho ba dang / khye1 ga las kur 'grerdzo zhes bris 'dug pa pal cher 'dra yang / mnyam 'jog dgos sa ni snga ma de rang dbang rang 'thad kyis 'khrig pa'i las byas pa las b.ragang btsong gi rigs gnyer ba min la/ phyi ma de 'tsho ba'i ched du khyo shug gnyis bshang btsong gi las la 'jug par mos mthun byung ba tsam red/'grog phyogs 'dir 'di lta bu'i byed stangs la bkag rgya med pa dang / rgyal khrims dang dgos sa'i gnad la mi khe'/ bar mi dgos pa'i skran kho nar khel bzhin yod stabs/nga tsho'i blo yul las 'das pa'i gnad don 'ga' yang yod de/ de ni skyes pa dam pa lha chos dang 'jig rten mi chose las 'das pa'i gshis spyoted thal cha can dang / las 'bras dang tshe phyi mar gtan nas mi sems pa'i sger sems can khag cig gi bya spyoted red/dper na skyes pa re 'ga' mtshan mo'i dus su pho nyul du song ste bu mo tshor 'dod 'dun med bzhin du btsan tshugs kyis 'khrig spyoted byed 'jug pa dang / btsan tshugs byas kyang

/3 8 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/glags ma 'khel na gcar rdung brnyas gsum yang byed pa yin la/ 'di lta bu'i sbyong ngan gyi rigs mthong rgyu dang thos rgyu mang bo yod mod/ 'di'i skor gsham gyi rtsom yig gzhan du yod pas 'dir de tsam gyis 'thus par byas so/ /zhor 'phros zhiga'abrog phyogs 'dir pha ma gnyis kyis mna' ma'i ming dngos nas mi 'bod par rgyun par mna' ma zhes 'bod dgos pa dang / khyim gcig la bu gsum 〈snad tshe khong tsho'i chung ma rnams la mna' cha/ che ba dang mna' ma 'bring ba/ mna' ma chung ba zhes 'bod pa dang / khyim de'i bu rgan pas kyang nu bo'i chung mar mna' ma zhes 'bod pa las ming nas mi 'bod/ de bzhin nang mi mthongs kyis mna' ma zhes 'bod pa dang / mna' ma'i khyo ga'am skyes pa de las lo chung ba dag ges a sru dang a nee sru mo sogs su 'bod pa yin/ khyim der gnas la yong ba'i mna' ma des kyang pha ma gnyis dang rang nyid kyi khyo ga las lo che ba ba'i bu rgan pa dag gi ming nas thad rkar mi 'bod pa yin no/ /dper na khyo ga'i pha ma gnyis dang phu bo rgan gzhon sogs kyi ming nas thad shar mi 'bod par rgyun par a pa dang a ma zer nas 'bod la/ phu bo che ba dang phu bo 'bring ba lta bur 'bod pa yin no/ /da dung 'brog phyogs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du thun mong ma yin pa 'i khyad chos gzhan zhig yo/da pa ni na gzhon pho mo rnams kyi ngag gi sgyu rtsal rtsom rig ste/ la gzhas kyi lam nas dga' rogs 'tshol ba dang sems nang gi bde sdug phyi ru mngon pa/ gzhan la rang nyid kyi dung sems mtshon par byed pa de red/ la gzhas ni a mdo'i zhing 'brog gnyis

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ /3 9kur dar khyab shin tu che zhing / na gzhon tsho'i rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba'i grub cha gal chen zhig bzung yod/ de bzhen khams phyogs su'ang 'di lta bu gzhas gtong srol yo/da pa dang / dbus gtsang khul du'ang mdza' gzhas zhes bod yul chol kha gsum na yerdzongs su grags pa bzhin na gzhon pho mo tshos phan tshun dung ba mtshon byed kyi gzhas tshig dang /gdangasadabyangs kyang logs su yod pa ra 'dod/ a mdo'i 'a/ gzhas kyis dmangs khrod kyi 'a tsho ba gal chen zhig mtshon par byas yod pa dang / tshig gi sgyu rtsal dang ngag gi rang bzhin 'tsho ba dngos dang kha thag nye ba sogs shes ldan mi sna tshos 'di'i thad nyams zhib re byeng cing / nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong 'phel gtong thub na bzang cha che bar mthong ngo / /lhag par du 'brog phyogs 'ga' re na skyes pa tsho mtshan por pho nyul du song ste/bu mo zhig gi rum du 'dzul rjes phan tshun la gzhas len res byed pa dang / la gzhas kyi lam nas snying gtam brjod pa dang shags 'gyed res byed pas 'khrig pa'i bya ba byed thub min gang lta ra yang / la gzhas len skabs kha sems mthun min la thug skusnad de/la gzhas blangs te phan tshun kha sems ma mthun par shags 'gyed drag po byed dbesnas byung tshe bud med kyis zhakhrig pa'i bya ba dang du len mi srid cing / gal srid skye sa pa de la gzhas la mkhas sheng la gzhas blangs te bud med de pham par byas tshe/ bud nad des kyang der pos mthun byed ceng de ni kho mo'i sems nang du kho'i la gzhas kyi shes yon la brtsibakur dang gdeng lagag thob pa zhig kyang red snyam/(lana'i yan de sngon 'od sbyi tshogs dus deb steng bkod zin pa yin/ )

/40 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/ci zhig la go nas ma zer ram/'brog phyogs su bud med gzhon nu ma phal mo che pha mas kha yod dbang yod kyis gnas la ster ba las rang rang gi gdam ka ltad gan tshang la 'gro 'dod yod dang 'di tshang la mi 'gro zer ba'i srol lugs de tsam med cing / de nee srol rgyun gyi bsam blo'i bkag rgya dang gna' nas da bar gyi bod rigs bud med rnams kyis myangs dang myong bzhin pa'i sdug bsngal zhig red/ yin na'ang / bud med re zung mi tshang skyo bo zhig nas yin zhing mo rang nyid la'ang ya/ga mo sgo med pa'am/ yang na gshis kun spyod skyes pa tshos blor de tsam 'bab pa zhig min tshe mo lo bco lnga zad nas nyi shur slebs kyang da dung gnas yul mi rnyed la/ gal srid pha ma btsan po gnyis sam/ skyes pa tsho pho nyul byed du yong bar bkag 'gog byed mkhan gyi pha ma gnyis yin tshe bud med de'i rigs go rgas su 'dug pa'e rgyu tshang zin pa yin/go rgas ma zer ba ni gnas yul 'grims pa'e dus su slebs na'ang gnas la slong mkhan gyi gnas bdag ma rnyed pa'i bud med la zer ba yin la/ 'brog phyogs su gnas bdag ma rnyed pa'i bud med go rgas ma yang re zung yod/ go rgas ma tshor nang mi gnyen tshan dang phye sde bas kya nga lta tshul de tsam legs rgyu med de/ de ni gang ltar cig la mi dgos pa'i mi lhag ma lta bu zhig red/ yin na'ang / sngon chad 'brog phyogs phal mo cher byis pa slob grwar gtong ba'i lugs srol de tsam sped par mo lo bco lnga bcu drug zin ma thag nas gnas la ster ba yin pas/ mosna 'od ) shu yan 'ordzon yang gnas la 'gro yul ma rnyed pa'i bud med tshor go rgas ma zer ba lta bu'i kha log tshig log rgyag pa tsam las tshe gang bor go rgas mar lhag 'gro ba'i 'brog mo lda tsam mang bo med/

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ /4/de las skabs 'dir nga tshos btsan byol spyi tshogs khrod du snyug kha gtad nas zengs shig dpyad chog ste/ dper na/ btsan byol spyi tshogs khrod na lo'i na tshod zin yang gnas bdag ma rnyed pa'i go rgas ma mang 'o yod la/ tshe gang sor gnas bdag ma rnyed pa'e rigs kyang mang bo yod/ btsan byol spi tshogs ni bod phyi nang gnyis las go rgas ma'i grangs 'bor mang shos de red/ ngas bzlos na bud med de'i rigs rgyu rkyen 'di dag gis go rgas mar gyur 'dug ste/ lta ba mtho ba dang gcigarnam pa med pa dang gnyis/ 'tsho ba'i mnar gcod zebs pa dang gsum mo/ /dper na/ bud med skor zhig lang tsho dar zhing kha ngo skyes 'bras yag dus skye sa pa tshos re 'dun dang du mi len par rang rang gi dmigs 'dun re bsgrub par rtson gyin 'dug cing / khong tsho phal che ba ha cang snang ba mtho ba'i gras yin/ khong tsho'i bsam par skyes pa tsho rtsabazhin skyes shing chu bzhin bzhur gyin yod pas sa sgang chen ngo 'di'i steng na rang la 'tsham zhing ran pa'i skyes pa ni ga dus 'dems 'dems yin pas/ rang 'e chung dus nas chang sa brgyabs te bu phrug skyel spel byed pa ni lo chung dus bde skyid kyi dpal la longs/ su spyod pa 'i 'gal rkyen du gyur yod la/ de las rang gis bsgrub 'dod pa'i bya bzhag la hur brtson gyis zhugs dgos bsam bsdad yod/ khong tshos de ltar bsam gyin skyes pa su 'dra zhig gis gnyen sgeg gi bya ba'i thad du gros byas kyang dang len mi byed/ tha na dga' rogs sgrig pa da/ zhakhrig spyod kyi bya ba byed rgyu de yang don dag med sa nas rang la sdug po btang ba zhig tu bgi yang gcig bshad na snang ba mtho ba'i bud med skor zhig gis skyes pa gzhan gyis rang la ci tsam gyis re ba mang du rgyag pa dang u tshugs mthar skyel byed na de tsam gyis mgo krog krog byed pa de yin/ yin na'ang / khong tsho'i kha ngo skyes 'bras ni nyin rer bsdad kyin rgas 'gro gi yod la/ lang tsho'i stobs kyang

/42 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/de ltar shor 'gro gi yod/ de'i zhor du g.yas g.yon gyi skyes pa tsho yang rang rang gi sa na chang sa rgyag pa dang khyim gzhi 'dzin pa'i las 'a/ brel gyin yod pas/ bud med de'i regs tshe gang bor botho rgas su 'dug pa'i rgyu bskru na bzhin pa yin/de bzhin bud med re zung la rnam pa med/ stabs nyes na sgod pa'ang med/ gal srid khyed rang tsho bud med la rgyus mnga' dang goms 'dris che pa'i mi zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang tshe/ rnam pa med pa'i bud med pha la mo che spyod pa'ang de tsam bzang rgyu med par spyo 'tshub 'tshub dang rlung tsha bo/ 'khrug pa rgyag chog chog sa rtsod 'chor chog chog kha gnyer sna gnyer byed nga ra dga' ba sogs yin/ khong tsho'i rigs la dka' ngal zhig yo/da pa ni skyes pa su zhig rang la 'tsham min lta mi shes pa de yin/ dper na/ khong tshos rang nyid la rnam pa yod med ni de tsam gal chen du mi 'dzin par/ de las khong tshos 'tshol bzhin nga 'i khyo ga de'i steng nas cha rkyen mang so zhig brtsis yong / gal srid dkon mchog dang las dbang nas khong tsho'i gzugs lang tsho dang 'tsham zhing 'os pa'i khyo ga re go sgrig byas yod pa'i dbang du btang yang / khong tshos de tsho dang len mi byed par rang nyid dkon ma〈snag gi bka' dang 'gal nas ches mchomag tu rgyu ra cing rlabs che ba'i khyo ga re gdam rgyu zer ba de red/ gal srid chang sa rgyag pa ni tshong rgyag pa dang gcig mtshungs yin pa'i dbang du btang na de la rigs gsum yod pa las/ rang khe gzhan pham dang gzhan khe rang pham/ phyogs gnyis ka 'dra mnyam sku(nga ba bcas red/ spe su yin rung rang pham gzhan rgyal gyi tshong rgyag 'dod byed ki ma red la stabs legs na gzhan pham rang rgyal gyi tshong rgyag gi red/ yin na'ang / bzang sna(sa ni phan tshun 'dra mnyam gyi tshong brgyab ste phyogs gnyis kur khe gyong med pa bya rgyu de red/ des na de lta bu'i tshong sgo 'gram du rnyebs na 'chor du 'jug mi rung mod/ bud med re zung gis nges pa ra du rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ /43 tshong la bsam blo 'khor ba las tshong yag po rgyag mi shes pa/ra brten mjug mthar rang nyid pham gyin yod/yang bud med re zung kha ngo skyes 'bras 'bring tsam yin na'ang 'tsho ba'i mnar gcod lci sa rdzog yod/ de'i rigs kyi bud med tshos skyes pa go gnas can dang rgyu nor can zhig dang ma 'phrad tshe chang sa rgyag mi srid/ khong tshos nang snga langs dang dgong 'phye nyal gyis rgyu nor gsog pa'am/ slo ba sbyong la hur brtson bcas byas te dang thog rang nyid kye rkang ba'i sga nga nas rang nyid langs thub par brtson pa yin/ 'di btsan byol spyi tshogs khrod du khyab rgya ches che zhing 'di lta bu'i 'tsho ba'i mnar gcod 'og chang sa rgyag ma thub par lhag pa'i bud med go rgas ma dang skyes pa ni grangs kyis mi zin pa'i tshod du yo/da/'on kyang / khong tsho gnad don 'ga'i thad du nor 'phyug 'byung yo da/ de ni brtsedung gtso sor mi 'dzin par rgyu nor dang go gnas sogs 'tsho ba'i gal che'i grub char ngos 'dzin nga / yang mi zer ba ni skyes pa nas bzung 'tsho ba rol mgo brtsams zin pa shes rtogs byung med pa lta bu yin/ dper na/ nga tsho skyes pa nas bzung 'tsho ba rol mgo brtsams pa yin 'a/ 'tsho ba gsar ba'i mgo btsugs zin pa'ang yin/ 'tsho ba gsar ba zer dus chang sa brgyab pa gcig pu ra bo rgyu ma yin nga ra de ni rnam grangs gsar ba zhig gi ma〈sna btsugs pa tsam red/ 'tsho ba ni ma khog nas skyes nyin nas bzung rol mabosto brtsams yo/da la/ de nas brtsis pa'i chang sa ma brgyab pa'i bar du'ang 'tsho ba rol nas yo/nga zhing / chang sa brgyab rjes kyang 'tsho ba rol nas mi tshe skyel dgos/ des na dang thog rgyu nor gya non pa zhig bsags te de rjes chang sa rgyag 'dod kyi bud med tshos 'di ltar bsam gzhig byed kyin pe da la/ gal srid stabs ma legs nga/ra khong tshos bsam pa ltar 'dod blo khengs pa'i rgyu nor cig btsal ma thub na khong tsho mu mthud go rgas mar 'dug dgongam

144 'khrig gtam dmar rjen ma/ a rig 'gyur med kyis brtsams/'byung srid pa'am/ tshe gang bor go rgas mar lhag pa'i rgyu tshang zin pa yen/gnyis thad nas rgyu nor longs spyod can gyi mi rnams kyi rgyu nor dus gtan tu rtag brtan yin mi srid la/ kho tsho rang nyid kyis dka' sdug gis bsags pa'i rgyu nor yang rtag brtan min/ khong tshos bsam par dang thog rgyu nor bsags te bu phrug skye spel gyi dpal 'gyor ldan tshe chang sa rgyag bsam yod/ 'on kyang / khyod rang nyid kyang nam 'chi ma nges pa/sa khyod kyis bsags pa'i rgyu nor gyis khyod la tshe 'di'i bde skyid bskrun min bshad tshod mi thig la/ de ni nad pa las yod pa dga' yang de tsam gal chen min/ gnad don 'di lta bu'i rigs kyis btsan byol du go rgas ma mang nas mang du 'phel bzhin yod/de ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan yang sku(da srid resnad/ rlabs che ba'i dmigs 'dun zhig gi ched du'am/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi ched du bosgo rgas mar gyur bzhin pa'i bud med nyung nyung yin la/ ham bshad cig byas na gtan nas med ces kyang brjod chog go/'brog phyogs na btsan g.yem gyi bya ba rgyun 'byams su gyur yod/'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa zhes pa'i rtsom yig de'i mgo 'jug bar gsum cha tshang tshar gcig bklags rjes/ khyed rang 'brog phrug cig yin na da dung de'i nang du mang bo mang so zhig bshad rgyur lhag bsdad pa'i tshor ba yong srid/ sal sred khyed rang zhing ma 'brog gam/ zhing ba'i khyim rgyud nas skyes pa 'i zhing las pa zhig yin na de ni cung blo jor 'bab dka' ba zhig kyang yin srid/ lhag par du rtsom

'brog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed stangs skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ /45yig de rgya nag dang 'jar pan/ rgya gar dang ko ri ya/ yu rab gling / nub phyogs a me ri ka sogs kyi mi zhig gis bklags yod tshe dnge mi srid pa'i tshul du mgo bo g.yug g.yu/ga byed par nges la/ lam sang deb dang snyu gu khyer nas bod yul du dngos yod spi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi ya mtshar ba'i 'khreg las byed stangs skor la zhib 'jug byed twe 'gro srid/ gang ltar de ni rtsom gzhi bzang bo zhig yin nga/ ngas khag theg byed chog nga/ra ma zad/ dngos yod spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i snang brnyan gson sto zhig yin pa'ang bsnyon du med/des na ngas khyed tshor de las kyang rtsom gzhi bzang bo zhig 'chad chog 'brog phyogs su pho nyul byed pa 'i goms gshis rgyu na 'byams su sku(nga ye da la/ btsan g.yem byed pa'i goms gshis kyang de mtshungs su gyur yod/ khrims lugs ltar na bud med cig la 'dod pa sped bzhin du skyes pa tshos btsan gyis bzung nas 'khrig pa spyod pa ni nag nyes tshabs chen bsags pa yin la/ khrims ra nas de la khrims thag nan mo gcod pa red/ yin na'ang / 'grog phyogs su skyes pa gnyis gsum res nyin gung zog lug gi rdzi sor yong ba'i bu mo re btsan gyis bzung nas mnyam du sbyod la/ mtshan mo nor lug bsrung nas ston sa dang dpyi da sar gcig pur sdo da mkhan gyi bud med rnams la'ang de lta ra byed/ lhag par du ma rabs tha shal gyi bya sprebyud la goms pa'i skyes pa re 'gas bud nad tshor btsan g.yem byas kyang glags ma 'khel na gcar rdung brnyas gsum yang byed par ma zad/ gri dang mgo skor gyis gzhu ba lta bu'i las byed pa bdag gis dngos su mthong zhing thos myong yod/ yin na'ang / khyim tshang gi pha ma gnyom zhing phyi nang gi 'tsho ba zhan pa'i bu mo tshos sdug bsngal 'di'i rigs mi lusar rung nyakhur yin/ de bzhin rang gi chung ma dang mdza' mo sogs gang yang min bzhin du thengs gcig ge zhakhrig spyod tsam gyi ched du skyes pa tshos phan tshun khyo shi nga gserdzon gyi 'thab mo byed dus kyang rinan tu mang bas/

/46 'khrigagatam dmar rjen ma/ a reg 'gyur med kyis brtsams/'de lta bu ni nges par du legs bcos byed 'os pa zhig red/yang re 'gas pho mtshan steng 'gyig khug ( ca lag ldu ga stod kyi 'gyig gi khug mar go ba las 'gyig shubs rang la spo mi rung / de ni 'brog phyogs su 'gyig shubs de tsam dar med pas yin/ )re gyon te de'i steng du dmar phye bskos nas bud med la gnyig sgod byed pa de red/ ngas dngos su de lta bu'i bya sgod ngan pa sgril ba'i skor gyi gtam rnyed gnyis thos myong la/gcig ni dza'i pha yul gyi4 mi zhig gis de ltar spyod ngan 'khrab rjes gzhan la ngom b.rigad byas pa las brgyud thos byung zhing / gzhan de nee hu nan a rig phyogs kyi mi zhig gis de lta ra byas rjes khrims sgor lhung rnye nyes khrims kyang lced mo pog skad 'dugagal srid khyed tshor do snang byung yod na/ gong nu ngas 'grog phyogs kyi pho nyul byed rnya ngas skor la cung zad dpyad pa zhes pa'i rtsom yig nang / 'brog phyogs su lo na ha cang phra ba'i bud med rnams spe tog ma min zhes bris yod/ khyed tshos se mas dang bud med gzhon nu ma de tshos phyi gling ba bzhin rang dbang rang 'thad dang nang bsam pa'i dpal yon la bsten te/ lo chung dus nas 'khrig spyod byas pa red dam/ yang na skyermos pa tshos btsan g.ye/ma byas pa red/ 'di dbya da rin yod pa zhig yin la ngas bsam na 'brog po brgya cha'i lnga bcu nas drug cu/ yang na bdun bcu nas brgyad cu'i bar ni dang thog btsan g.yem byas pa dang / de'i rjes rim gyis de la goms sheng 'dris 'o/stobs su serdzong ba'i gras yin/ gong du bshad pa ltar 'grog mo tsho chung dus nas zog lug gi rdzi stor 'gro dgos nga/ las nang du 'dug sa ched la/ lo ha cang chung na zog lug gi rdzi bor 'gro skabs pha ma gnyen tshan zhig gis 'gro rogs byed srid mod/ cung tsam lag chags rjes rang nyid gcig pur 'gro ba las rdzi rogs sped/ der brten skyes pa tshos rdza mabesgo ri mgo nas bzung ste btsan g.yem byed srid la/ gal srid bu mo lo bcu gsum bcu bzhi yan zin
